ICRAUniversal Online Temporal Calibration for Optimization-Based Visual-Inertial Navigation SystemsWhen a camera and a motion sensor (IMU) are not perfectly in sync in time, the position tracking they do together becomes less accurate, and current fixes only work with specific software setups.
ICRATowards Open-Ended Robotic Exploration Using Vision-Inspired Similarity and Foundation ModelsA robot exploring an unknown space must figure out on its own what objects it has seen before and what is new, without being given a fixed list of categories or task-specific training.
ICRALearning-Based Adaptive Navigation for Scalar Field Mapping and Feature TrackingFinding interesting features in a physical field — like a hotspot or a ridge in temperature or chemical concentration — by flying or sailing fixed patterns wastes time and misses things when the field is noisy or obstacles are present.
ICRABelief Roadmaps with Uncertain Landmark EvanescenceA robot using a saved map to find its position can get lost when landmarks in the map have disappeared since the map was made, and existing planners can't account for that uncertainty well.
ICRAData Augmentation for NeRFs in the Low Data Limit3D scene reconstruction from photos (NeRF) fails or makes things up when trained on too few images, because gaps in coverage have nothing to constrain them.
ICRAEquivariant Filter Design for Range-Only SLAM ↗Tracking a robot's position using only distance measurements to fixed points in the environment is unreliable when you do not know where those points are ahead of time.
ICRASteeredMarigold: Steering Diffusion Towards Depth Completion of Largely Incomplete Depth MapsDepth sensors often leave large continuous areas with no reading at all, and existing software that fills in those gaps fails badly when the missing region is large.
ICRAcoVoxSLAM: GPU Accelerated Globally Consistent Dense SLAMBuilding a detailed 3D map of a large environment in real time is too slow when the computation runs on a standard CPU.
ICRAA Stochastic Cloning Square-Root Information Filter with Accurate Feature Tracking for Visual-Inertial OdometryRobot localization using cameras and inertial sensors is slow and loses accuracy when the timing between sensor readings drifts or when tracked visual features shift over time.
ICRAEnhancing 3D Scene Graphs with Real-Time Room ClassificationSystems that build a structured map of a building's rooms and objects in real time cannot classify which room the robot is in fast enough to be useful on small onboard hardware.
ICRAInsCMPR: Efficient Cross-Modal Place Recognition via Instance-Aware Hybrid Mamba-TransformerMatching a camera image to a location on a laser-scan map is hard because the two sensor types look very different from each other.
ICRARACE: A Fast and Lightweight Urban Exploration and Search Strategy for Multi-Robot SystemsHaving many robots map an unknown building together is slow and uses a lot of computing power, and classic maze-solving methods were not built for teams of robots working from grid maps.
ICRASOLVR: Submap Oriented LiDAR-Visual Re-LocalisationFinding where a camera is relative to a laser-scan map is hard because the two sensors see the world very differently and can be far apart in viewpoint.
ICRATightly Coupled Range Inertial Odometry and Mapping with Exact Point Cloud DownsamplingReducing the number of laser scan points to save processing time introduces small errors that pile up and make maps less accurate.
ICRADiffusion Based Robust LiDAR Place RecognitionLiDAR-based localization inside buildings under construction fails often because many areas look nearly identical — long blank walls, repeated floor layouts — so the sensor cannot tell where it is.
ICRAARS-SLAM: Accurate Robust Spinning LiDAR SLAM for a Quadruped Robot in Large-Scale ScenarioA four-legged robot's body vibrates as it walks, and large outdoor spaces have too much data to process quickly, both of which make laser-based mapping inaccurate or slow.
ICRALVBA: LiDAR-Visual Bundle Adjustment for RGB Point Cloud MappingMethods that combine laser scans with camera images to build colored 3D maps tend to be locally consistent but drift over large areas.
ICRAInteraction-Driven Updates: 3D Scene Graph Maintenance During Robot Task ExecutionA robot working from a fixed map of a room fails when someone moves an object or blocks a view, because the map is never updated.
ICRADistributed Invariant Kalman Filter for Object-Level Multi-Robot Pose SLAMWhen multiple robots try to locate themselves and each other by sharing sensor data, they get inconsistent position estimates because the errors in each robot's data are related in unknown ways, and sharing all that data takes a lot of bandwidth.
ICRAMultiple Rotation Averaging with Constrained Reweighting Deep Matrix FactorizationEstimating the true orientation of many cameras from noisy pairwise measurements is thrown off by bad measurements (outliers), and most methods require ground-truth labels or assumptions about the noise pattern.
ICRAMonoLDP: LED Assisted Indoor Mobile Bot Monocular Depth Prediction and Pose Estimation SystemSmall indoor robots need to know how far away other robots are and communicate with them, but equipping them with heavy or expensive depth sensors is not practical.
ICRAAIR-HLoc: Adaptive Retrieved Images Selection for Efficient Visual LocalisationVisual localization systems always retrieve the same fixed number of reference images to compare against, wasting time on easy cases and sometimes using too few images on hard cases.
ICRAGS-EVT: Cross-Modal Event Camera Tracking Based on Gaussian SplattingEvent cameras can track fast motion in bad lighting, but they need a 3D map to work with — and event cameras alone can't easily build one.
ICRANonlinear Motion-Guided and Spatio-Temporal Aware Network for Unsupervised Event-Based Optical Flow ↗Networks that estimate motion from event cameras ignore the time ordering and spatial structure of the data and wrongly assume objects move in straight lines, which causes errors on longer event sequences.
ICRABEINGS: Bayesian Embodied Image-Goal Navigation With Gaussian SplattingNavigating to a target shown only in an image requires a robot to explore efficiently and predict what it will see next, without needing huge amounts of training data.
ICRARange-Based 6-DoF Monte Carlo SLAM with Gradient-Guided Particle Filter on GPUTracking a robot's 3D position and orientation with a laser scanner requires spreading thousands of guesses across space, but the more directions you need to track, the more guesses you need — making it too slow for big environments.
ICRAA Skeleton-Based Topological Planner for Exploration in Complex Unknown EnvironmentsRobots exploring unknown spaces waste time and compute by repeatedly backtracking because simple path planners lack a big-picture view of where they have and have not been.
ICRAScalable Multi-Session Visual SLAM in Large-Scale Scenes with Subgraph OptimizationWhen a robot revisits a large area across many separate trips and tries to correct its map, the correction step often drifts badly or fails to finish because the map has grown too big to fix all at once.
ICRACommunication-Aware Iterative Map Compression for Online Path-PlanningWhen robots share map data to help each other plan paths, sending the full map uses far more bandwidth than necessary, which is a problem for robots with limited communication links.
ICRAReal-Time 3D Reconstruction via Camera-Lidar (2D) Fusion for Mobile Robots: A Gaussian Splatting ApproachCamera-only mapping systems lose track of where they are when objects move through the scene.
ICRAEstimating Commonsense Scene Composition on Belief Scene GraphsRobots searching a home need to guess where objects they cannot currently see are likely to be, based on partial knowledge of the room.
ICRAVAIR: Visuo-Acoustic Implicit Representations for Low-Cost, Multi-Modal Transparent Surface Reconstruction in Indoor ScenesCameras and depth sensors cannot see transparent surfaces like glass, so robots end up with maps that have holes where glass walls or windows are.
ICRAEnvironmental Map Learning with Multiple-RobotsA group of robots mapping an unknown area together waste time taking readings in spots other robots have already covered, and they can collide if they do not coordinate.
ICRAOpen-Set Semantic Uncertainty Aware Metric-Semantic Graph MatchingUnderwater robots need to recognize places they have visited before, but unknown object types create uncertain labels that break the graph-based matching used for that recognition.
ICRASelf-Reflective Perceptual Adaptation for Robust Ground Navigation in Unstructured Off-Road EnvironmentsOff-road robots fail when sensors are blocked or degraded because they have no way to notice their own perception is poor and adjust their behavior.
ICRAImproving Monocular Visual-Inertial Initialization with Structureless Visual-Inertial Bundle Adjustment ↗A faster way to start up a camera-plus-IMU positioning system (by skipping 3D point reconstruction) is less accurate because it estimates rotation and translation separately instead of jointly.
ICRAA Coarse-to-Fine Event-based Framework for Camera Pose Relocalization with Spatio-Temporal Retrieval and Refinement NetworkEvent cameras that try to figure out where they are in a large area by learning from scratch fail because they have no way to use what is already known about the place.
ICRANon-Parametric GNSS Integer Ambiguity Estimation via Positional Likelihood Field MarginalizationGPS (GNSS) signals that bounce off buildings cause large positioning errors, and figuring out the correct whole-number cycle count (integer ambiguity) needed for centimeter-level accuracy is hard to do reliably in cities.
ICRAEquivariant Filter for Tightly Coupled LiDAR-Inertial OdometryStandard filters (extended Kalman filters) that combine LiDAR and inertial sensors to track a robot's position make approximation errors because the underlying math is not linear, leading to drift in position estimates.
ICRADistributed Certifiably Correct Range-Aided SLAMWhen multiple robots build a shared map using distance measurements between them, there is no guarantee that the positions they compute are actually the globally best answer rather than just a locally good one.
ICRADeep Learning Based Topography Aware Gas Source Localization with Mobile RobotRobots trying to find a gas leak in a cluttered room get confused because walls and objects distort how gas and wind spread.
ICRAGaussian Splatting Visual MPC for Granular Media ManipulationMoving loose granular materials like rice or beans with a robot is hard because millions of particles interact in ways that are expensive to simulate and the results do not transfer to new situations.
ICRABoxMap: Efficient Structural Mapping and NavigationDetailed maps that robots use to navigate take a lot of memory and computing power, making them hard to run on small, cheap devices.
ICRANeural Ranging Inertial Odometry ↗Indoor location tracking using short-range radio signals (UWB) breaks down when signals bounce off walls or when only a few fixed reference points are available, such as in tunnels.
ICRALE-Object: Language Embedded Object-Level Neural Radiance Fields for Open-Vocabulary SceneSystems that build 3D scene maps from images often get object boundaries wrong, or they can only handle a fixed set of known objects rather than anything someone might name.
ICRARapid Autonomous Exploration of Large-Scale Environments for Ground Robots Based on Region PartitioningWhen a robot explores a large unknown space, it wastes time traveling long distances back and forth to reach the next area to scan.
ICRAImproved Bag-of-Words Image Retrieval with Geometric Constraints for Ground Texture Localization ↗A robot with a downward-facing camera that uses floor texture to locate itself needs to find matching images very accurately, and general-purpose image search methods are not precise enough for this.
ICRAMap-SemNav: Advancing Zero-Shot Continuous Vision-and-Language Navigation Through Visual Semantics and Map IntegrationFollowing spoken or written directions to navigate through a real building without any task-specific training data is an unsolved problem because the robot must connect language to space on the fly.
ICRALeg Exoskeleton Odometry using a Limited FOV Depth SensorA leg exoskeleton can only mount a depth camera in a position that gives a narrow view and moves a lot, which makes it hard to track where the exoskeleton is or build a usable map of the ground.
ICRAPoints, Images and Texts: Boosting Point Cloud Completion with Multi-Modal FeaturesFilling in the missing parts of a 3D point cloud from a partial scan is hard because single-source methods either miss fine surface details or lose the overall shape.
ICRAHash-GS: Anchor-Based 3D Gaussian Splatting with Multi-Resolution Hash Encoding for Efficient Scene ReconstructionReconstructing large outdoor scenes with 3D Gaussian Splatting (a method that represents a scene as millions of small fuzzy blobs) uses too much memory.
ICRALarge-Scale Gaussian Splatting SLAMCurrent 3D Gaussian Splatting mapping-and-localization systems need depth cameras and only work indoors, so they cannot handle large open outdoor environments.
ICRASAP-SLAM: Semantic-Assisted Perception SLAM with 3D Gaussian SplattingMost systems that build 3D maps with small colored blobs (Gaussian Splatting) ignore what objects are in the scene, so they spread map detail evenly even where the map is already good.
ICRAEnhancing Autonomous Navigation by Imaging Hidden Objects Using Single-Photon LiDARRobots cannot see obstacles that are around a corner or blocked from direct view, which is a safety risk during navigation.
ICRASemi-Elastic LiDAR-Inertial OdometryWhen a robot estimates its position by combining laser scans and an inertial sensor, it is hard to balance how much to trust each sensor without making the estimate either too rigid or too loose.
ICRAMs. NAMI: Multimodal Semantic Navigation on Relative Metric Intention GraphA robot navigating in an unknown space needs to handle goals described in many forms — a spoken description, a photo, or an object name — but most systems handle only one form.
ICRAVIP-Dock: Vision, Inertia, and Pressure Sensor Fusion for Underwater Docking with Optical Beacon GuidanceUnderwater robots trying to dock at a station often lose sight of the target light beacon due to water interference, causing the docking attempt to fail.
ICRADepth Estimation Based on 3D Gaussian Splatting Siamese DefocusMethods that judge depth from how blurry objects look in photos need a sharp reference image, which is not always available in real use.
ICRALCSPose: Efficient, Accurate and Scalable Markerless 6-DoF Pose Estimation of a Quay Crane Spreader Based on LiDAR and CameraTracking the exact position and angle of a crane spreader in a port without using markers is hard because initial alignment can be off, point cloud matching is slow, and cameras alone cannot give reliable depth.
ICRAJORD: A Benchmark Dataset for Off-Road LiDAR Place Recognition and SLAMNearly all existing test sets for laser-scan-based mapping and place recognition were collected in cities, so there is no standard way to measure how well these methods work in rough, unstructured outdoor terrain.
ICRATaskExp: Enhancing Generalization of Multi-Robot Exploration with Multi-Task Pre-TrainingTeams of robots trained to explore maps in one type of environment fail when placed in a larger or different environment they have not seen before.
IROSBotany-Bot: Digital Twin Monitoring of Occluded and Underleaf Plant Structures with Gaussian SplatsCameras mounted in a fixed position cannot photograph the underside of leaves or buds hidden under other leaves, so those plant parts cannot be tracked without manual handling.
IROSFOCI: Trajectory Optimization on Gaussian SplatsPlanning a safe path for a robot inside a 3D scene built from photos (using 3D Gaussian Splatting) is hard because existing collision checks use rough bounding boxes and ignore how the robot is oriented.
IROSCollaborative Swarm Shape Reconstruction of Tumbling Space Targets via Decentralized Dynamic Factor Graph OptimizationMapping the shape and spin of a tumbling piece of space debris using a team of spacecraft is hard because no single spacecraft has the full picture and there is no central computer to collect everything.
IROSA Tightly Coupled Inertial-Sonar Fusion for Localization of Underwater RobotsUnderwater robots that rely only on an inertial sensor drift off course over time, and sonar alone also drifts, so neither sensor alone gives reliable position tracking.
IROSA Simple Algebraic Solution for Estimating the Pose of a Camera from Planar Point FeaturesFiguring out exactly where a camera is and which way it's pointing, based on which flat surface features it can see, normally requires slow trial-and-error math that struggles when measurements are noisy.
IROSImproved 3D Point-Line Mapping Regression for Camera RelocalizationNetworks that learn to match both point and line features in a scene at the same time tend to pick up false patterns between the two types of features, hurting accuracy.
IROSMEFusion: Memory-Efficient Data Fusion for Real-Time 3D Reconstruction On Resource-Constrained DevicesBuilding a 3D map with object labels from a depth camera in real time uses too much memory and processing power for small embedded computers.
IROSARC-Calib: Autonomous Markerless Camera-to-Robot Calibration via Exploratory Robot MotionsGetting a camera and a robot arm to agree on where things are in space normally requires a human to place special markers or train a model for that specific robot type.
IROSSEI3D: CPU-only 3D Object Tracking Fusing Sparse-flow-filtered Edge and Interior AlignmentTracking the 3D position of an object using a single camera breaks down in low-contrast scenes because the edge detector picks up too many background edges that do not belong to the object.
IROSOnline Hierarchical Policy Learning using Physics Priors for Robot Navigation in Unknown EnvironmentsNeural networks used for online robot navigation in large spaces tend to learn low-frequency patterns poorly and forget earlier areas of the map when new areas are explored.
IROSA Robust Stereo Splatting SLAM System with Inertial-Legged FusionSmall four-legged robots that can't carry heavy sensors need to map their surroundings in detail and stay located even in plain, textureless spaces where cameras alone lose track.
IROSLITE: A Learning-Integrated Topological Explorer for Multi-Floor Indoor EnvironmentsAutonomous robots exploring multi-floor buildings need to find stairs, switch floors, and cover each floor efficiently, but existing methods handle only single floors or treat floor transitions as a special hard-coded case.
IROSEnhancing Object Search in Indoor Spaces via Personalized Object-Factored OntologiesA home service robot searching for objects fails for users who keep things in non-standard places, because it relies on generic knowledge about where objects typically go rather than learning each person's habits.
IROSSaWa-ML: Structure-Aware Pose Correction and Weight Adaptation-Based Robust Multi-Robot LocalizationEach robot's position estimate slowly drifts over time when using camera-plus-IMU tracking, and the errors build up the longer the robots operate.
IROSOpti-Acoustic Scene Reconstruction in Highly Turbid Underwater Environments ↗In murky water, cameras cannot see far enough to map the environment, and sonar alone gives blurry, flat images that miss depth details.
IROSORA-NET: Enhancing Image Feature Matching through Oriented Overlapping Region AlignmentMatching the same point across two photos fails when one camera is rotated or much closer than the other, because the same feature looks very different in each image.
IROSLSW-Net: A Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Framework for 2D LiDAR-Based Environment PerceptionFlat 2D laser scanners produce sparse, low-information scans, and 3D point-cloud processing methods don't work on the very different structure of 2D scan data.
IROSBio-Inspired Hybrid Map: Spatial Implicit Local Frames and Topological Map for Mobile Cobot NavigationMobile robots struggle to navigate reliably in new environments because existing maps either lose consistency at a large scale or don't generalize beyond their training scenes.
IROSSelf-Supervised Enhancement for Depth from a Lightweight ToF Sensor with Monocular ImagesCombining a cheap, low-resolution depth sensor (Time-of-Flight) with a regular camera to get sharp depth maps usually requires expensive ground-truth depth data for training.
IROSSTC-Tracker: Spatiotemporal-Consistent Multi-Robot Collaboration Framework for Long-Term Dynamic Object TrackingMultiple robots trying to track moving objects together often lose track when the object is briefly hidden or seen from a very different angle.
IROSIndoor FireRescue Radar: 4D Indoor Millimeter Wave Dataset and Analysis for Hazardous Environment PerceptionCameras and laser scanners can't see through smoke or darkness in a burning building, so robots responding to fires have no reliable sensor data for detecting people or obstacles.
IROSCategory-level Meta-learned NeRF Priors for Efficient Object Mapping ↗Building accurate 3D maps of multiple objects in real time is slow and the results are blurry when the system has no prior knowledge of what object shapes look like.
IROSDesign and Development of a GPR-Equipped Robot for Full-space External Diseases Detection in Drainage PipelinesDetecting problems in the soil around underground drainage pipes from inside the pipe is difficult because the pipe is narrow, the conditions are harsh, and existing tools cannot measure all directions or locate faults accurately.
IROSImage-Goal Navigation Using Refined Feature Guidance and Scene Graph EnhancementA robot navigating toward a target photo needs to match that photo against what it currently sees and understand the surrounding room context, which simple feature-blending methods do poorly.
IROSEfficient Prediction of Dense Visual Embeddings via Distillation and RGB-D Transformers ↗Robots in homes need to understand a scene in real time and answer questions about it in plain words, not just spot a fixed list of named objects.
IROSDecentralized Gaussian Process Classification and an Application in Subsea RoboticsGroups of underwater robots need to build a shared map of where wireless communication works well, but the data links between them are slow and low-bandwidth.
IROSMotion-Feat: Motion Blur-Aware Local Feature Description for Image MatchingCamera images taken while moving fast or in dim light are blurry, and standard image-matching algorithms fail on blurry images, which breaks robot localization.
IROSMGPRL: Distributed Multi-Gaussian Processes for Wi-Fi-based Multi-Robot Relative Localization in Large Indoor EnvironmentsMultiple robots indoors can't figure out where they are next to each other without GPS, and it costs a lot to use fancy sensors or sync maps together.
IROSImage-Based Relocalization and Alignment for Long-Term Monitoring of Dynamic Underwater EnvironmentsA robot monitoring an underwater reef over months or years needs to recognize the same spots it visited before, but murky water and changing light make that very hard.
IROSInformation Entropy-assisted Hierarchical Framework for Unknown Environments ExplorationWhen a robot explores an unknown building, it often wastes time revisiting areas it has already mapped well instead of heading to places where it would learn the most.
IROSGaussianPU: Color Point Cloud Upsampling via 3D Gaussian SplattingMaking a sparse set of colored 3D points much denser is normally done by splitting the cloud into small patches, which distorts shapes and still cannot fit a large cloud on one GPU at once.
IROSAdaptive Sliding Window Optimization for Multi-Modal LiDAR Inertial Odometry and MappingSystems that track a robot's position using LiDAR and an inertial sensor spend the same computing effort everywhere, even in open areas where the robot's location is already clear.
IROSGSplatVNM: Point-of-View Synthesis for Visual Navigation Models Using Gaussian SplattingA visual navigation system that matches a camera feed to a stored image database fails when the database images are spread too far apart and the robot ends up between them with nothing good to compare against.
IROSSemantic Enhancement for Object SLAM with Heterogeneous Multimodal Large Language Model AgentsIndoor SLAM systems often confuse similar-looking objects in cluttered rooms, which corrupts the map and causes the robot to think it has seen the same object twice when it hasn't.
IROSCM-LIUW-Odometry: Robust and High-Precision LiDAR-Inertial-UWB-Wheel Odometry for Extreme Degradation Coal Mine TunnelsUnderground coal mine tunnels have no GPS, very uniform walls with few distinguishing features, and slippery ground, all of which cause standard position-tracking methods to drift or fail entirely.
IROSDPR-Splat: Depth and Pose Refinement with Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting for Novel View SynthesisBuilding a 3D scene model from only a few photos fails because the estimated camera positions and depth maps are inaccurate, producing blurry or distorted renderings from new viewpoints.
IROSIntensity-Augmented LiDAR-Visual-Inertial Odometry and MeshingSystems that combine laser scanners (LiDAR), cameras, and motion sensors for simultaneous localization and mapping don't use the brightness data that laser scanners also capture, leaving accuracy on the table for camera tracking and 3D map quality.
IROSOne-shot Global Localization through Semantic Distribution Feature Retrieval and Semantic Topological Histogram RegistrationFiguring out where a robot is from a laser scan alone—without any starting guess—is hard because moving objects pollute the scan, feature matching often gives wrong answers, and searching a large map is slow.

Self-driving cars, done leaner and safer 428 papers

The problem

Full self-driving systems that build a heavy top-down picture of everything around the car cost too much computing and can still make unsafe plans.

The approaches

Instead of describing the whole scene in dense detail, describe only the parts that matter; tie seeing, predicting, and planning more tightly together; mix radar with cameras for bad conditions; track how unsure the car is about its own map; and fill in gaps that the laser scanner leaves behind.

How it solves it

Focusing on what matters cuts the computing so it runs live, and tracking its own uncertainty lets the car be careful exactly where it is unsure.

ICRA16cLightstereo: Channel Boost is All You Need for Efficient 2D Cost AggregationAccurate stereo depth estimation normally requires a large 4D data structure (cost volume) that takes too long to compute for real-time use, but simpler 3D alternatives lose accuracy.
ICRA13cUnleashing HyDRa: Hybrid Fusion, Depth Consistency and Radar for Unified 3D PerceptionCameras alone struggle to accurately estimate depth at long range or in bad lighting and weather, which hurts self-driving car perception.

ICRA7cTalk2Radar: Bridging Natural Language with 4D mmWave Radar for 3D Referring Expression ComprehensionSystems that find a specific object in 3D space based on a spoken or typed description almost always use cameras, ignoring radar even though radar works through bad weather and gives its own rich 3D data.
ICRA7cHeRCULES: Heterogeneous Radar Dataset in Complex Urban Environment for Multi-Session Radar SLAMResearchers building radar-based localization systems that work in rain or fog have had no dataset that combines two different radar types together, so they cannot test or develop methods that use both.
IROS7cMCTrack: A Unified 3D Multi-Object Tracking Framework for Autonomous DrivingRobot tracking systems work well on one dataset but fail on another, and current grades don't measure if the speed and acceleration are correct.
ICRA6cMonoCT: Overcoming Monocular 3D Detection Domain Shift with Consistent Teacher ModelsA 3D object detector trained on one camera or environment loses accuracy when used on a different camera or environment, and this gap is a major barrier to real-world deployment.
ICRA6cUniBEVFusion: Unified Radar-Vision Bevfusion for 3D Object DetectionSystems that combine radar and camera data for 3D object detection treat radar like a sparse version of laser scanning, wasting radar's depth information, and they break badly when the camera feed fails.
ICRA5cReal-Time LiDAR Point Cloud Compression and Transmission for Resource-Constrained RobotsRaw 3D laser scan data is too large to send in real time over slow wireless links on small robots.
ICRA5cLearning Based MPC for Autonomous Driving Using a Low Dimensional Residual ModelA self-driving car's controller works poorly when its internal model of how the car moves is not accurate enough.
ICRA5cV2X-DGW: Domain Generalization for Multi-Agent Perception Under Adverse Weather ConditionsAutonomous vehicles and roadside sensors that share laser scan data to detect objects stop working well in rain, fog, or snow if they were only trained on clear-weather data.
ICRA5cAVD2: Accident Video Diffusion for Accident Video DescriptionTraining AI to describe and explain traffic accidents requires lots of accident video, but real accident footage is rare and hard to collect.
ICRA5cDAP-LED: Learning Degradation-Aware Priors with Clip for Joint Low-Light Enhancement and DeblurringAt night, camera images are both dark and blurry, and fixing one problem at a time in sequence leaves the other one unsolved, hurting how well a robot or car can see.
ICRA5cChameleon: Fast-Slow Neuro-Symbolic Lane Topology ExtractionFiguring out how lanes connect at intersections for a car driving without a pre-built map is either too slow and expensive when done with a large vision-language model, or too brittle when done with pure rules.
ICRA5cLidarDM: Generative LiDAR Simulation in a Generated WorldTraining self-driving car software needs huge amounts of realistic sensor data that is expensive and slow to collect on real roads, and existing synthetic data tools often look fake or lack smooth motion over time.
IROS5cDiffSSC: Semantic LiDAR Scan Completion using Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic ModelsLaser scans from self-driving cars are sparse and leave out hidden geometry and object labels, making it hard to understand the full scene.
IROS5cSynthetica: Large Scale Synthetic Data Generation for Robot PerceptionGetting thousands of real pictures of robots picking objects and labeling them is too slow and expensive, so trained systems don't work on new objects.
ICRA4cGen-Drive: Enhancing Diffusion Generative Driving Policies with Reward Modeling and Reinforcement Learning Fine-TuningSelf-driving cars plan poorly in complex traffic because they rely on a single predicted future rather than thinking through many possible ways the scene could unfold.
ICRA4cAn End-to-End Learning-Based Multi-Sensor Fusion for Autonomous Vehicle LocalizationCombining data from several sensors to pinpoint a car's location requires manually setting uncertainty parameters that are hard to tune and often wrong in unusual situations.
ICRA4cTowards Over-Canopy Autonomous Navigation: Crop-Agnostic LiDAR-Based Crop-Row Detection in Arable FieldsFarm robots can't reliably follow crop rows when the plant leaves grow over and hide the gaps between rows, and GPS is too inaccurate or unavailable.
ICRA4cDENSER: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Scene Reconstruction of Dynamic Urban EnvironmentsCurrent 3D scene reconstruction methods struggle to accurately capture moving objects like cars and pedestrians in driving scenes because they do not model how appearance changes over time.
ICRA4cFreeDriveRF: Monocular RGB Dynamic NeRF Without Poses for Autonomous Driving via Point-Level Dynamic-Static DecouplingReconstructing a 3D driving scene from a single moving camera normally requires knowing exactly where the camera was at every moment, which is not always available.
ICRA4cGround-Optimized 4D Radar-Inertial Odometry Via Continuous Velocity Integration Using Gaussian ProcessTracking a vehicle's position using radar and an inertial sensor (IMU) produces drift errors because radar data is noisy and the two sensors don't produce data at the same times.
ICRA4cCo-MTP: A Cooperative Trajectory Prediction Framework with Multi-Temporal Fusion for Autonomous Driving ↗A self-driving car predicting where nearby vehicles will go is limited by what it can see on its own, especially when other vehicles are hidden.
ICRA4cFlatFusion: Delving Into Details of Sparse Transformer-Based Camera-LiDAR Fusion for Autonomous DrivingCombining camera and laser sensor data for self-driving cars is hard to get right because many small design choices each affect accuracy, and no one had studied them all together.
IROS4cDepth Matters: Exploring Deep Interactions of RGB-D for Semantic Segmentation in Traffic ScenesLabeling every pixel in a driving scene using both color and depth images fails because the model pays attention to the wrong spots when combining the two types of data, especially where depth patterns differ from color patterns.
IROS4cCoCMT: Communication-Efficient Cross-Modal Transformer for Collaborative PerceptionSelf-driving cars sharing sensor data with each other send so much data over the network that it's not practical to deploy.
IROS4cBEVDriver: Leveraging BEV Maps in LLMs for Robust Closed-Loop DrivingSelf-driving cars have trouble understanding where things are in 3D space and using language-based reasoning to plan driving paths.
ICRA3cCategorical Traffic Transformer: Interpretable and Diverse Behavior Prediction with Tokenized LatentModels that predict how vehicles will move often collapse to predicting one average path instead of many distinct possible paths, and their internal variables are hard to interpret.
ICRA3cReference-Free Formula Drift with Reinforcement Learning: From Driving Data to Tire Energy-Inspired, Real-World PoliciesMaking a car drift in a controlled way through any set of waypoints is hard because computing the exact path to follow is slow and requires a detailed physics model.
ICRA3cGround-Aware Automotive Radar OdometryEstimating how far and in what direction a car has moved using only a single radar sensor is unreliable because radar returns are sparse and noisy, making it hard to find matching features between scans.
ICRA3cCRAB: Camera-Radar Fusion for Reducing Depth Ambiguity in Backward Projection Based View TransformationCameras alone cannot reliably tell how far away objects are when building a top-down map of the road, which causes false detections.
ICRA3cHierarchical End-to-End Autonomous Driving: Integrating BEV Perception with Deep Reinforcement LearningSelf-driving systems that learn to drive through trial and error (reinforcement learning) often can't explain what they see around the car, which makes them worse at avoiding collisions.
ICRA3cAF-RLIO: Adaptive Fusion of Radar-LiDAR-Inertial Information for Robust Odometry in Challenging EnvironmentsRobots relying on laser scanners or GPS lose track of their position in smoke, tunnels, or bad weather because these sensors stop working reliably.
ICRA3cRMP-YOLO: A Robust Motion Predictor for Partially Observable Scenarios Even if You Only Look OncePredicting where nearby vehicles and people will go becomes much less accurate when their past movement data has gaps or errors, which happens often in real traffic.
ICRA3cGeneralizing Motion Planners with Mixture of Experts for Autonomous DrivingLearned motion planners for self-driving cars often work well on the data they trained on but fail in different or unusual conditions because the model collapses to a few common behaviors.
ICRA3cCoopDETR: A Unified Cooperative Perception Framework for 3D Detection via Object QueryWhen self-driving cars share raw sensor data with each other to improve detection, the data volumes are very large and hard to interpret.
ICRA3cLiDARDustX: A LiDAR Dataset for Dusty Unstructured Road EnvironmentsDatasets for self-driving vehicles focus on city roads, so there is no good test data for sensors working in dusty places like mines, which makes it hard to know how well perception software handles dust.
ICRA3c4DRadDet: Cluster-Queried Enhanced 3D Object Detection with 4D Radar4D radar sensors produce very sparse and noisy point clouds, making it hard for detection algorithms to find and locate objects in 3D.
ICRA3cAnnealed Winner-Takes-All for Motion ForecastingPredicting multiple possible future paths for vehicles or pedestrians is sensitive to how the model is initialized and often produces many near-duplicate paths, requiring an expensive post-processing step to pick the best one.
ICRA3cRenderworld: World Model with Self-Supervised 3D LabelSelf-driving cars need 3D maps of what's around them to predict the future and plan, but getting those 3D labels normally requires expensive lidar sensors or a lot of manual annotation.
ICRA3cWcdt: World-Centric Diffusion Transformer for Traffic Scene GenerationCreating realistic, varied predictions of what all vehicles in a traffic scene will do next is difficult because the future has many possible outcomes that depend on roads, signals, and other agents.
ICRA3cFisheyeDepth: A Real Scale Self-Supervised Depth Estimation Model for Fisheye CameraWide-angle fisheye cameras distort images heavily, and existing self-supervised depth models trained on normal cameras cannot produce physically scaled depth values from them.
IROS3cMulti-Step Deep Koopman Network (MDK-Net) for Vehicle Control in Frenet FrameA car's steering and speed dynamics are nonlinear, so planning its path precisely is either slow to compute or relies on approximations that reduce accuracy.
IROS3cBEV-LIO(LC): BEV Image Assisted LiDAR-Inertial Odometry with Loop ClosureA laser-based robot positioning system slowly drifts off course over time because it never checks whether it has visited a place before.
IROS3cStochasticity in Motion: An Information-Theoretic Approach to Trajectory PredictionSelf-driving cars need to predict where other vehicles are going, but existing methods don't properly separate two different kinds of uncertainty: genuine randomness in how people drive, versus the model simply not having enough data.
IROS3cDriveLMM-o1: A Step-by-Step Reasoning Dataset and Large Multimodal Model for Driving Scenario UnderstandingTests for AI driving systems only check whether the final answer is right, so there is no way to tell whether the system actually reasoned through the situation or just guessed.
IROS3cResLPR: A LiDAR Data Restoration Network and Benchmark for Robust Place Recognition Against Weather CorruptionsRobots that use laser scanners to find their location fail in rain, snow, and fog because weather corrupts the scan data.
IROS3cCoMamba: Real-time Cooperative Perception Unlocked with State-Space ModelsWhen many connected vehicles share sensor data to build a shared view of the road, the standard attention-based fusion method gets slower as the number of vehicles grows because its cost grows with the square of that number.
IROS3cLiteFat: Lightweight Spatio-Temporal Graph Learning for Real-Time Driver Fatigue DetectionChecking if a driver is getting tired is slow and power-hungry, so car systems can't run the check on the computer in the dashboard right now.
IROS3cAGENTS-LLM: Augmentative GENeration of Challenging Traffic Scenarios with an Agentic LLM FrameworkTesting self-driving cars needs thousands of rare driving situations, but experts can only manually create a few, and training data used by other methods does not have enough edge cases.
IROS3cSORT3D: Spatial Object-centric Reasoning Toolbox for Zero-Shot 3D Grounding Using Large Language ModelsIt's hard to point to an exact 3D location in a messy room when someone says "grab the red cup under the table" without training on tons of 3D language examples.
ICRA2cMotion Forecasting via Model-Based Risk MinimizationCombining predictions from several trajectory prediction models by simply averaging their probabilities often makes the result worse because the models do not agree on a common scale or meaning.
ICRA2cComputational Teaching for Driving via Multi-Task Imitation LearningBuilding a computer coach that teaches high-skill driving requires paired recordings of an expert watching and correcting a student, which are very rare and expensive to collect.
ICRA2cMETDrive: Multimodal End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Temporal GuidanceSelf-driving systems that go directly from sensor input to steering commands don't make good use of the vehicle's own recent history — where it steered, how fast it turned — which is useful information for predicting where to go next.
ICRA2cVideoSAM: Open-World Video SegmentationA popular image-segmentation model (SAM) works on single images but can't track objects across video frames or keep the level of detail consistent from frame to frame.
ICRA2cSwept Volume-Aware Trajectory Planning and MPC Tracking for Multi-Axle Swerve-Drive AMRsA robot with multiple steerable axles sweeps out a large area when it turns in a tight space, which standard path planners don't account for and which can cause collisions.
ICRA2cMVCTrack: Boosting 3D Point Cloud Tracking via Multimodal-Guided Virtual CuesTracking a single object in 3D using laser scan data (point clouds) is often inaccurate because the scans are sparse and miss large parts of the object.
ICRA2cBiTrack: Bidirectional Offline 3D Multi-Object Tracking Using Camera-LiDAR DataTracking many objects at once in 3D using both cameras and laser scanners is hard because the two sensors do not agree exactly on object positions, and tracks often break into fragments or get linked incorrectly.
ICRA2cZeroSCD: Zero-Shot Street Scene Change DetectionFinding what has changed between two photos of the same street location requires large sets of labeled image pairs to train a detector, which is costly to collect.
ICRA2cSSF: Sparse Long-Range Scene Flow for Autonomous DrivingTracking which way every point in a 3D sensor scan is moving becomes too slow and memory-heavy at long range because standard methods try to process every location in a dense grid.
ICRA2cLabel Anything: An Interpretable, High-Fidelity and Prompt-Free AnnotatorLabeling every pixel of street-scene images by hand so self-driving cars can learn from them takes enormous time and money.
ICRA2cLearning Better Representations for Crowded Pedestrians in Offboard LiDAR-Camera 3D Tracking-by-detectionAutomatically labeling 3D paths of pedestrians in crowds is hard because laser scans of people are very sparse and existing tools were not tested on crowded scenes.
ICRA2cV2X-DG: Domain Generalization for Vehicle-to-Everything Cooperative PerceptionSelf-driving cars that share sensor data with each other or with roadside units (V2X) train on one dataset but then fail on real roads with different sensors or weather because the data looks too different.
ICRA2cA Data-Driven Aggressive Autonomous Racing Framework Utilizing Local Trajectory Planning with Velocity PredictionLocal path planners for racing cars struggle to pick the right speed before sharp corners, so the car slows down more than needed and loses lap time.
ICRA2cModeling Trust Dynamics in Robot-Assisted Delivery: Impact of Trust Repair StrategiesWe do not know which repair actions — explanation, apology, or denial — best rebuild a person's trust in a delivery robot after it makes a mistake.
ICRA2cPotential Fields as Scene Affordance for Behavior Change-Based Visual Risk Object IdentificationCurrent methods that try to find risky objects on the road by watching how nearby cars change their behavior are spatially imprecise and flip their answers from frame to frame.
ICRA2cTowards Latency-Aware 3D Streaming Perception for Autonomous Driving3D object detection for self-driving cars takes time to compute, so by the time a result is ready the car has already moved and the detections are out of date, but standard tests ignore this delay.
ICRA2cKineto-Dynamical Planning and Accurate Execution of Minimum-Time Maneuvers on Three-Dimensional CircuitsPlanning the fastest possible lap on a 3D track in real time is very hard because the car's physics change constantly and the plan must update when the car drifts off course.
ICRA2cLiDAR-enhanced 3D Gaussian Splatting MappingWhen building 3D maps from camera images alone, the system often gets the camera position wrong and starts with too few data points, making the final map inaccurate.
ICRA2cBridging Spectral-Wise and Multi-Spectral Depth Estimation Via Geometry-Guided Contrastive LearningEstimating depth from cameras works differently for regular color images, near-infrared, and thermal cameras, so separate models are usually needed for each type, and combining them requires special network designs.
ICRA2cGradient-Based Trajectory Optimization with Parallelized Differentiable Traffic SimulationSimulating and optimizing the paths of millions of vehicles at once requires a vehicle model that is both physically realistic and fast enough to run at that scale.
ICRA2cEMATO: Energy-Model-Aware Trajectory Optimization for Autonomous DrivingSelf-driving car planners pick paths based on safety and speed but ignore how much fuel or battery each path uses.
ICRA2cRL-OGM-Parking: Lidar OGM-Based Hybrid Reinforcement Learning Planner for Autonomous ParkingParking a car autonomously in tight real spaces is hard: rule-based planners are stiff, and machine-learning planners trained in simulation often fail in the real world.
ICRA2cFutureNet-LoF: Joint Trajectory Prediction and Lane Occupancy Field Prediction with Future Context EncodingSelf-driving cars must predict where all nearby vehicles and pedestrians will go, but standard models do not use their own initial predictions to improve those predictions.
ICRA2cDeep Height Decoupling for Precise Vision-Based 3D Occupancy PredictionWhen cameras try to predict which parts of 3D space are occupied, image features from different heights get mixed together and confuse the model.
ICRA2cTSCLIP: Robust CLIP Fine-Tuning for Worldwide Cross-Regional Traffic Sign RecognitionA traffic sign detector trained on signs from one country or region fails on signs from other regions, limiting how far a self-driving system can be deployed.
ICRA2cDoppler Former: Velocity Supervision of Raw Radar DataRaw 4D radar sensors measure how fast objects are moving (Doppler velocity), but existing neural networks for self-driving cars ignore that speed signal and leave useful information on the table.
ICRA2cSuperLoc: The Key to Robust Lidar-Inertial Localization Lies in Predicting Alignment RisksLiDAR localization breaks down in places like tunnels or long corridors because the geometry there does not give enough information to pin down position, and current systems only notice the problem after it has already caused a bad estimate.
IROS2cLearning Through Retrospection: Improving Trajectory Prediction for Automated Driving with Error FeedbackSelf-driving car prediction models guess where other vehicles will go one step at a time, with no way to fix mistakes they keep repeating.
IROS2cHARP-NeXt: High-Speed and Accurate Range-Point Fusion Network for 3D LiDAR Semantic SegmentationLabeling every point in a LiDAR scan by object type in real time on vehicle hardware is hard because fast methods lose shape detail and accurate methods are too slow.
IROS2cSparseMeXt: Unlocking the Potential of Sparse Representations for HD Map ConstructionBuilding high-definition maps from car camera feeds using sparse data representations gave much worse results than dense methods, because no one had designed the tools specifically for sparse data.
IROS2cEnhancing Large Vision Model in Street Scene Semantic Understanding through Leveraging Posterior Optimization TrajectoryAs training data for self-driving perception grows, smaller models stop improving but retraining a large vision model from scratch during deployment is too expensive.
IROS2cFedEMA: Federated Exponential Moving Averaging with Negative Entropy Regularizer in Autonomous DrivingWhen many vehicles share and update a shared perception model over time, adapting to new road conditions causes the model to forget what it learned earlier.
IROS2cCooperRisk: A Driving Risk Quantification Pipeline with Multi-Agent Cooperative Perception and PredictionA self-driving car relying only on its own sensors cannot see far enough or around blind spots to accurately judge how dangerous a crowded road section is.
IROS2cTracking Any Point with Frame-Event Fusion Network at High Frame RateTracking specific points on moving objects fails at high speeds or in bad light because standard cameras don't capture frames fast enough.
IROS2cCA-W3D: Leveraging Context-Aware Knowledge for Weakly Supervised Monocular 3D DetectionTraining a camera to detect and locate objects in 3D space normally requires expensive hand-labeled 3D data, and methods that skip those labels tend to miss context across a full scene.
IROS2cConvoyLLM: Dynamic Multi-Lane Convoy Control Using LLMsKeeping a group of self-driving vehicles in a convoy on a busy highway while handling vehicles joining or leaving and avoiding obstacles in real time is too complex for simple rule-based systems.
IROS2cMapDiffusion: Generative Diffusion for Vectorized Online HD Map Construction and Uncertainty Estimation in Autonomous DrivingSystems that build detailed road maps from sensor data produce a single answer and cannot express how unsure they are about occluded or marked-over lanes.
IROS2cJoint Pedestrian and Vehicle Traffic Optimization in Urban Environments using Reinforcement LearningTraffic light control using learning tries to speed up cars but ignores pedestrians waiting at crossings.
IROS2cGSPR: Multimodal Place Recognition Using 3D Gaussian Splatting for Autonomous DrivingSelf-driving cars need to find where they are without GPS, but mixing camera and lidar data in old ways misses how they fit together in time.
IROS2cVaLID: Verification as Late Integration of Detections for LiDAR-Camera FusionLaser sensors sometimes find things that aren't there, and combining laser and camera data in the normal way is complicated and only works for the data set it was trained on.
IROS2cTrajFlow: Multi-modal Motion Prediction via Flow MatchingGuessing where a car will go has many right answers, but most systems need to run many times to get different guesses and work slowly.
IROS2cCooPre: Cooperative Pretraining for V2X Cooperative PerceptionSelf-driving cars can share sensor data with each other to see better, but teaching the system requires expensive labeled data that doesn't exist at scale.
IROS2cRALAD: Bridging the Real-to-Sim Domain Gap in Autonomous Driving with Retrieval-Augmented LearningSelf-driving cars trained on real-world video fail when you test them in simulations, blocking safe testing in virtual worlds.
ICRA1c3D Lane Detection Based on Projection-Consistent Reference Points and Intra- & Inter-lane ContextSystems that detect road lanes in 3D use fixed reference points that often do not align with where the actual lanes appear in the camera image, causing missed or broken lane detections especially on curves.
ICRA1cPedestrian Intention and Trajectory Prediction in Unstructured Traffic Using IDD-PeDSelf-driving car software trained on tidy Western roads fails badly at predicting where pedestrians will go in chaotic, unstructured traffic like that found on Indian roads.
ICRA1cScenario-Based Curriculum Generation for Multi-Agent DrivingCreating varied and difficult traffic training scenarios for self-driving car research by hand is slow and results in a narrow range of situations for the car to learn from.
ICRA1cRMSeg-UDA: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Road Marking Segmentation Under Adverse ConditionsModels that detect road markings from clear daytime images fail badly at night and in rain, and there are no labeled examples of road markings under those bad conditions to retrain with.
ICRA1cA Novel Decomposed Feature-Oriented Framework for Open-Set Semantic Segmentation on LiDAR DataRobots using laser scanners to label objects around them can only recognize object types they were trained on, and will mishandle anything new or unknown.
ICRA1cLoRD: Adapting Differentiable Driving Policies to Distribution ShiftsA learned self-driving system trained in one environment performs worse when moved to a new location, and adapting it tends to make it forget how to drive in the original environment.
ICRA1cDur360BEV: A Real-World 360-Degree Single Camera Dataset and Benchmark for Bird-Eye View Mapping in Autonomous Driving ↗Generating a top-down map of the area around a self-driving car normally requires several cameras arranged around the vehicle, which is complex and expensive.
ICRA1cBandwidth-Adaptive Spatiotemporal Correspondence Identification for Collaborative PerceptionMultiple self-driving vehicles trying to share sensor observations to track the same objects can't send full data to each other because the wireless link is slow and the available speed changes over time.
ICRA1cRLPP: A Residual Method for Zero-Shot Real-World Autonomous Racing on Scaled PlatformsControllers trained purely by trial-and-error in simulation do not transfer well to real race cars, but simple rule-based steering controllers cannot push the car to its limits.
ICRA1cDynamics Modeling Using Visual Terrain Features for High-Speed Autonomous Off-Road DrivingOff-road vehicles driven fast hit sudden changes in grip and resistance — mud, rocks, loose soil — that a planner using only terrain geometry cannot predict.
ICRA1cOff-Road Freespace Detection with LiDAR-Camera Fusion and Self-DistillationDetecting drivable ground reliably in rough off-road terrain is hard because neither a camera alone nor a laser scanner alone handles all the conditions well.
ICRA1cPTZ-Calib: Robust Pan-Tilt-Zoom Camera CalibrationCameras that can pan, tilt, and zoom need to be re-calibrated every time they move to a new angle, but existing methods are either too slow or not accurate enough for real-time use.
ICRA1cRadarMask: A Novel End-to-End Sparse Millimeter-Wave Radar Sequence Panoptic Segmentation and Tracking MethodRadar point clouds are very sparse, and existing methods for labeling every point and tracking every object from radar require hand-crafted post-processing steps that don't work end-to-end.
ICRA1cERetinex: Event Camera Meets Retinex Theory for Low-Light Image EnhancementIn very dark conditions, regular cameras can't capture useful images, and event cameras (which react to brightness changes very fast) can capture structure but have no color information.
ICRA1cActor-Critic Cooperative Compensation to Model Predictive Control for Off-Road Autonomous Vehicles Under Unknown Dynamics ↗Off-road vehicles drive on soft ground (mud, sand, gravel) that deforms unpredictably, making the physics models used for planned control inaccurate and causing the vehicle to drift from its intended path.
ICRA1cTraffic Regulation-aware Path Planning with Regulation Databases and Vision-Language ModelsSelf-driving cars need to follow traffic laws, but connecting what the car's camera sees to the relevant legal rules is not solved in a principled way.
ICRA1cCamera-Lidar Consistent Neural Radiance FieldsWhen building a 3D scene from a camera and a lidar sensor together, depth errors appear because the lidar doesn't capture all its points at the exact same moment as the camera.
ICRA1cThink Deep and Fast: Learning Neural Nonlinear Opinion Dynamics from Inverse Dynamic Games for Split-Second InteractionsWhen an autonomous agent must quickly pick between two conflicting actions — like which way to go around an opponent — it can get stuck or make a poor choice under time pressure.
ICRA1cThermoStereoRT: Thermal Stereo Matching in Real Time via Knowledge Distillation and Attention-Based RefinementEstimating depth from two thermal cameras in real time is too slow for small computers, and there is not enough labeled thermal data to train large models directly.
ICRA1cOpen3DTrack: Towards Open-Vocabulary 3D Multi-Object TrackingSystems that track moving objects in 3D for self-driving cars only work on a fixed list of object types they were trained on, so they fail when they encounter anything new.
ICRA1cLaB-CL: Localized and Balanced Contrastive Learning for Improving Parking Slot DetectionParking-spot detectors perform poorly on rare slot shapes and junction types because the training data has far more examples of common types than rare ones, so the model never learns the rare cases well.
ICRA1c3D Multi-Modal Object Detection Based on Cross-Attention Feature FusionFusing camera images and radar signals for 3D object detection by simply stacking their features together ignores how they relate to each other, so the detector performs worse in bad weather or low light.
ICRA1cHierarchical Spatiotemporal Fusion for Event-Visible Object DetectionRegular cameras degrade in poor light or fast motion, and combining them with event cameras (which record pixel changes rather than full frames) is hard to do well without high computational cost.
ICRA1cLogic-RAG: Augmenting Large Multimodal Models with Visual-Spatial Knowledge for Road Scene UnderstandingLarge AI vision-language models are bad at answering precise questions about where objects are relative to each other in a driving scene.
ICRA1cHPRM: High-Performance Robotic Middleware for Intelligent Autonomous SystemsROS 2, the standard software layer robots use to pass data between parts, is slow and unpredictable when sending large sensor data to multiple receivers at the same time.
ICRA1cA2DO: Adaptive Anti-Degradation Odometry with Deep Multi-Sensor Fusion for Autonomous NavigationRobot location tracking breaks down in bad conditions — darkness, rain, or sensor blockage — because any single sensor can fail, and most systems do not adapt when one goes bad.
ICRA1cMORDA: A Synthetic Dataset to Facilitate Adaptation of Object Detectors to Unseen Real-Target Domain While Preserving Performance on Real-Source DomainA self-driving car detector trained on data from one country performs poorly in a new country where you have no labeled data to retrain it.
ICRA1cScene-Aware Explainable Multimodal Trajectory PredictionModels that predict where vehicles will move are hard to trust because they give no explanation for their predictions and do not reason about all vehicles in a scene together.
ICRA1cImproving Generalization Ability for 3D Object Detection by Learning Sparsity-Invariant FeaturesA 3D object detector trained with one type of LiDAR sensor works poorly when used with a different sensor that produces denser or sparser point clouds.
ICRA1cDreamDrive: Generative 4D Scene Modeling from Street View ImagesCreating realistic driving simulations that are spatially consistent requires expensive manual object labels that are hard to collect at scale.
ICRA1cDiffCP: Ultra-Low Bit Collaborative Perception via Diffusion ModelWhen multiple self-driving vehicles share sensor data to see better together, the amount of data they need to transmit is far more than wireless networks can handle.
ICRA1cMDC-Seg: Multi-Directional Convolution-Based Semantic Segmentation for LiDAR Point CloudsWhen a self-driving car's laser scanner (LiDAR) tries to label each point in a 3D scene, the detection method only looks at a small patch around each point, so it misses wider context and makes more labeling errors.
ICRA1cC-Uniform Trajectory Sampling for Fast Motion PlanningSampling-based motion planners that draw random control inputs (like MPPI) tend to cluster samples in one part of the reachable space and miss other parts, making planning less efficient.
ICRA1cWeathergs: 3D Scene Reconstruction in Adverse Weather Conditions Via Gaussian SplattingBuilding a 3D model of an outdoor scene from photos taken in rain or snow is hard because the reconstruction method mistakes snowflakes, raindrops, or water on the lens for solid objects in the scene.
ICRA1cRadar Teach and Repeat: Architecture and Initial Field TestingOff-road robots navigating without GPS become unreliable when dust, smoke, or fog disables their laser scanners.
ICRA1cOG-Gaussian: Occupancy Based Street Gaussians for Autonomous DrivingRecreating moving street scenes in 3D normally requires expensive laser scanners and hand-labeled object paths, which makes it hard to scale up.
ICRA1cUDSV: Unsupervised Deep Stitching for Tractor-Trailer Surround ViewStitching camera images into one wide view around a tractor-trailer is hard because the trailer bends relative to the tractor, constantly changing the angles between cameras, and the cameras barely overlap.
ICRA1cDirected-CP: Directed Collaborative Perception for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles via Proactive AttentionWhen multiple connected vehicles share sensor data to see better, they waste bandwidth by treating all directions around them as equally important.
ICRA1cOnline Aggregation of Trajectory PredictorsNo single trajectory-prediction model for self-driving cars works best in all conditions, and it is hard to know in advance which one to trust.
ICRA1cPlanning with Adaptive World Models for Autonomous DrivingA self-driving planner trained in one city drives poorly in another city because drivers in different places behave differently, and the planner assumes everyone always behaves the same way.
ICRA1cDiffusion-Based Generative Models for 3D Occupancy Prediction in Autonomous DrivingStandard methods for mapping what space around a self-driving car is occupied fail in areas blocked from the camera's view or in poor visibility, because they only classify each point without understanding the broader scene.
ICRA1cOccRWKV: Rethinking Efficient 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction with Linear Complexity3D maps that label what is in each small cube of space around a robot are too slow to compute in real time because the standard attention calculation grows quadratically with the number of cubes.
ICRA1cLearning Multiple Probabilistic Decisions from Latent World Model in Autonomous DrivingSelf-driving world models that generate future scenes and then pick driving actions tend to be overconfident and get trapped in feedback loops where their own predictions fool them.
ICRA1cOptimizing Efficiency of Mixed Traffic Through Reinforcement Learning: A Topology-Independent Approach and BenchmarkGetting a mix of self-driving and human-driven cars to flow smoothly through real intersections and roundabouts is hard, and there is no good test set that covers the variety of real road layouts.
ICRA1cUnveiling the Depths: A Multi-Modal Fusion Framework for Challenging ScenariosEstimating depth from a single camera breaks down in darkness or bad weather, and thermal (infrared) cameras that work in those conditions lack the detail needed for accurate depth on their own.
ICRA1cIs Discretization Fusion All You Need for Collaborative Perception?When self-driving cars share sensor data with each other, the standard method of sharing fixed-grid feature maps wastes bandwidth on empty areas and loses accuracy at grid boundaries.
ICRA1cSAM-Guided Pseudo Label Enhancement for Multi-Modal 3D Semantic SegmentationWhen adapting a 3D object-labeling model to a new environment without new human labels, the automatically generated training labels are too sparse to be useful.
ICRA1cSMART: Advancing Scalable Map Priors for Driving Topology ReasoningSystems that figure out road layout and lane connections while driving only work for the specific camera setup they were trained on, so they cannot easily be used in different vehicles.
ICRA1c$U2$ Frame: A Unified and Unsupervised Learning Framework for LiDAR-Based Loop ClosingTeaching a robot to recognize places it has visited before using laser sensors requires labeled training data that is very hard to collect and often wrong.
ICRA1cCAFE-AD: Cross-Scenario Adaptive Feature Enhancement for Trajectory Planning in Autonomous DrivingSelf-driving planners trained by copying human driving learn bad habits in closed-loop tests and perform poorly on rare or unusual scenarios because the training data is dominated by common situations.
ICRA1cStructure-Aware Radar-Camera Depth EstimationCombining radar and camera data to measure depth is inaccurate because radar points are sparse and noisy, and matching them to image regions using fixed rectangular boxes picks up the wrong scene structure.
ICRA1cPlanning-Oriented Cooperative Perception Among Heterogeneous VehiclesWhen vehicles share sensor data with each other to improve detection, they share too much data regardless of whether it actually helps the driver plan a safer path, wasting bandwidth and ignoring whether the vehicles use the same kind of sensor.
ICRA1cF2R2: Frequency Filtering-Based Rectification Robustness Method for Stereo MatchingDepth estimation from stereo cameras depends on the two images being precisely aligned, but vibration, physical shocks, or temperature shifts can throw the cameras out of alignment and ruin depth estimates over long deployments.
IROS1cLLA-MPC: Fast Adaptive Control for Autonomous RacingA self-driving race car needs to keep control when the grip between tires and road suddenly changes, but gathering training data or running slow computations is not an option at racing speeds.
IROS1cExAMPC: the Data-Driven Explainable and Approximate NMPC with Physical InsightsA precise but slow robot controller called nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) is too expensive to run in real time, and it gives no easy way to see which physical settings matter most.
IROS1cKnowledge Distillation for Semantic Segmentation: A Label Space Unification ApproachDifferent camera datasets for self-driving cars each use their own set of object categories, so you cannot simply combine them to train a bigger, more accurate model.
IROS1cGABRIL: Gaze-Based Regularization for Mitigating Causal Confusion in Imitation LearningRobots learning by copying human demonstrations often pick up on irrelevant background details instead of the features that actually matter, so they fail when the setting changes slightly.
IROS1cLabel-Efficient LiDAR Panoptic SegmentationTeaching a robot to identify and separate objects in laser-scan data normally requires huge amounts of hand-labeled 3D point clouds, which are slow and expensive to produce.
IROS1cOverlap-Aware Feature Learning for Robust Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for 3D Semantic SegmentationAdapting a 3D scene-labeling model trained in simulation to work on real sensor data breaks down when objects from different categories look similar at the boundaries, and the adapted model is also fragile to noise and deliberate attacks.
IROS1cOn-Board Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for Personalized Motion Control of Autonomous VehiclesSelf-driving cars do not adapt to how each individual driver likes to be driven, and adding per-person customization usually requires a bigger model or slow cloud calls.
IROS1cJPDS-NN: Reinforcement Learning-Based Dynamic Task Allocation for Agricultural Vehicle Routing OptimizationPlanning efficient routes for farm vehicles across oddly shaped fields — while obeying rules about which gates they can enter — is too hard for standard route-planning tools.
IROS1cPursuit-Evasion for Car-like Robots with Sensor ConstraintsIn a game where one robot chases another and sensors don't see the whole world, it's impossible to track the opponent using old methods because you'd need to remember everything forever.
IROS1cLabel-Efficient LiDAR Semantic Segmentation with 2D-3D Vision Transformer AdaptersLabeling 3D point cloud data is expensive, and large vision models trained on ordinary images cannot be directly applied to LiDAR data because the two data types look nothing alike.
IROS1cFSDP: Fast and Safe Data-Driven Overtaking Trajectory Planning for Head-to-Head Autonomous Racing CompetitionsComputing a safe, physically realistic overtaking path in real time during a robot car race is too slow for the limited computers allowed in competition.
IROS1cInterpretable Interaction Modeling for Trajectory Prediction via Agent Selection and Physical CoefficientModels that predict where vehicles will go use black-box attention scores to decide which other vehicles matter, making it hard to understand or trust their decisions.
IROS1cRoadside GNSS Aided Multi-Sensor Integrated System for Vehicle Positioning in Urban AreasGPS in cities is often wrong because buildings bounce or block satellite signals, and fixing this with sensors inside the car alone is not enough since all cars in the same area share the same sky-level errors.
IROS1cMultistream Network for LiDAR and Camera-based 3D Object Detection in Outdoor ScenesDetecting objects in 3D outdoors is hard because laser scans (LiDAR) and color camera images each capture different things, and combining them well is an unsolved problem.
IROS1cPhysGCN-DL: Physics-Informed Graph Convolutional Networks with Diversity-Aware Loss Optimization for Multimodal Pedestrian Trajectory PredictionPredicting where pedestrians will walk is hard because it requires capturing how people influence each other while also producing a range of plausible future paths, not just one.
IROS1cRobust Maritime Object Detection under Adverse Conditions via Joint Semantic Learning without Extra Computational OverheadShip-detection models work poorly in fog, glare, or motion blur because they learn patterns from clear-weather images and those patterns do not transfer well to bad conditions.
IROS1cDense Semantic Bird-Eye-View Map Generation from Sparse LiDAR Point Clouds via Distribution-aware Feature FusionTop-down grid maps made from a car's laser scanner have many empty cells because the scanner only hits some spots, leaving gaps that make path planning unreliable.
IROS1cMultimodal Integrated Prediction and Decision-making with Adaptive Interaction Modality ExplorationsSelf-driving cars in busy traffic need to consider many possible futures (other cars cutting in, yielding, etc.) and pick a safe action that works across all of them, which is very hard to do fast enough.
IROS1cSound Source Localization for Human-Robot Interaction in Outdoor EnvironmentsOutdoor robots cannot reliably find the direction of a specific person speaking when there is loud background noise and other sounds present.
IROS1cControllable Traffic Simulation through LLM-Guided Hierarchical Reasoning and RefinementTraffic simulators cannot reliably create specific complex scenarios from plain text descriptions, limiting how well they test self-driving systems.
IROS1cGS-SDF: LiDAR-Augmented Gaussian Splatting and Neural SDF for Geometrically Consistent Rendering and ReconstructionA photo-realistic 3D scene representation method (Gaussian splatting) produces broken or floating geometry because it has no built-in understanding of solid surfaces.
IROS1cIMM-MOT: A Novel 3D Multi-object Tracking Framework with Interacting Multiple Model FilterTracking multiple moving objects in 3D fails when an object changes its motion pattern, because a single motion model cannot handle different behaviors.
IROS1cEnhanced Motion Forecasting with Plug-and-Play Multimodal Large Language ModelsPredicting what other vehicles will do next in traffic is expensive to adapt to new scenarios because it requires retraining the prediction model.
IROS1cZero Shot Domain Adaptive Semantic Segmentation by Synthetic Data Generation and Progressive AdaptationA model trained to label pixels in one type of image (such as daytime city roads) stops working well when used on a different visual style (such as foggy or night scenes), and sometimes no images from the new style are available to retrain with.
IROS1cAnnotation-Free Curb Detection Leveraging Altitude Difference ImageFinding road curbs with a laser scanner is slow when processing raw 3D point clouds, and training a detector usually requires expensive hand-labeled data.
IROS1cA Simple yet Effective Test-Time Adaptation for Zero-Shot Monocular Metric Depth EstimationA depth estimation model trained on many images can tell which pixels are closer or farther but not the actual distances in meters, and retraining it to produce real distances risks breaking its ability to work on new scenes.
IROS1cCOARSE: Collaborative Pseudo-Labeling with Coarse Real Labels for Off-Road Semantic SegmentationOff-road driving scenes are hard to label in detail, so there is very little annotated data and models trained elsewhere do not transfer well.
IROS1cFPGA Hardware Neural Control of CartPole and F1TENTH Race CarThe math-heavy control method called Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) runs too slowly on a regular computer to be used for fast robotic control that must update thousands of times per second.
IROS1cPB-MOT: Pose-aware Association Boosted Online 3D Multi-Object TrackingTracking multiple moving cars in real time fails at far distances, doesn't notice which way they're pointing, and gets confused when they overlap or block each other.
IROS1cELMAR: Enhancing LiDAR Detection with 4D Radar Motion Awareness and Cross-modal UncertaintyWhen a robot uses both laser (LiDAR) and radar to find objects, the sensors don't quite align, and the radar's speed data gets ignored.
IROS1cDom, cars don't fly! - Or do they? In-Air Vehicle Maneuver for High-Speed Off-Road Navigation ↗Fast ground robots go airborne over hills but nothing steers them while in the air, so they land badly or crash.
IROS1cLEGO-Motion: Learning-Enhanced Grids with Occupancy Instance Modeling for Class-Agnostic Motion PredictionSystems that predict where moving things will go by looking at grid squares independently miss how nearby cars or people affect each other, leading to predictions that do not obey physics in crowded traffic.
IROS1cDirect, Targetless and Automatic Joint Calibration of LiDAR-Camera Intrinsic and ExtrinsicCurrent LiDAR-camera calibration tools need special targets and cannot fix the camera lens distortion and camera-to-LiDAR position at the same time automatically.
IROS1cModeling Human-like Driving Behavior Based on Maximum Entropy Deep Inverse Reinforcement LearningComputers can't easily figure out what rewards make people drive the way they do, especially when thinking both seconds ahead and minutes ahead.
IROS1cImpact of Temporal Delay on Radar-Inertial OdometryTime mismatches between radar and motion-sensor readings mess up self-driving car position estimates, but people ignore this.
IROS1cEfficient Multimodal 3D Object Detector via Instance-Level Contrastive DistillationCombining laser and camera data to find objects in 3D is tricky because the two sensors see things at different rates and the camera's distant view gets lost in the math.
IROS1cSLOOP: Aligned Coordinate System-aided LiDAR LOOP Closure Detection based on Semantic Node Graph MatchingFinding when a robot revisits the same place using semantic maps requires comparing descriptors first, then checking geometry, which is clunky and slow at scale.
IROS1cWHALES: A Multi-Agent Scheduling Dataset for Enhanced Cooperation in Autonomous DrivingResearchers testing self-driving car teamwork don't have large datasets that show real communication limits and different numbers of cars working together.
IROS1cParkDiffusion: Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Multi-Modal Trajectory Prediction for Automated Parking using Diffusion ModelsPredicting where cars and people will go during parking must handle many different types of movement and make sure predicted paths actually work.
IROS1cCoPAD: Multi-source Trajectory Fusion and Cooperative Trajectory Prediction with Anchor-oriented Decoder in V2X ScenariosSelf-driving cars see things differently at different moments, making path prediction unreliable without help from nearby cars and road sensors.
IROS1cMambaMap: Online Vectorized HD Map Construction using State Space ModelSelf-driving cars can't see behind obstacles or very far away, so they miss information about the road map even when they've seen it before in earlier moments.
IROS1cLiDAR-Inertial Odometry in Dynamic Driving Scenarios using Label Consistency DetectionLiDAR position tracking fails in busy driving because moving cars in the scene throw off the map-matching step.
IROS1cDelving into Mapping Uncertainty for Mapless Trajectory PredictionSelf-driving cars build maps on the fly, but these maps have errors in shape and position that hurt the car's ability to predict other cars' movements, yet it is unclear when and how to account for this uncertainty.
IROS1cDriveGen: Towards Infinite Diverse Traffic Scenarios with Large ModelsSelf-driving car training uses limited real data, so the car only learns to handle situations it has seen before, leaving it weak on edge cases and unusual scenarios.
ICRACurb Your Attention: Causal Attention Gating for Robust Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous DrivingModels that predict where other vehicles will go can be thrown off by nearby vehicles that actually have no effect on the vehicle being predicted, making the predictions wrong.
ICRAMPI-Mamba: Cross Propagation Mamba for Multipath Interference CorrectionA type of depth camera (indirect time-of-flight) gets confused when light bounces off multiple surfaces before returning, producing wrong depth readings, and existing correction methods trained on fake data work poorly on real scenes.
ICRADual-Conditioned Temporal Diffusion Modeling for Driving Scene GenerationCreating long, realistic driving videos for training self-driving systems is expensive and existing AI video generators often produce frames that flicker or jump between shots.
ICRAStands on Shoulders of Giants: Learning to Lift 2D Detection to 3D with Geometry-Driven ObjectivesTraining a system to detect vehicles in 3D requires expensive laser scanner (LiDAR) data and hand-labeled 3D boxes, while ordinary camera images with 2D labels are plentiful.
ICRATrackOcc: Camera-Based 4D Panoptic Occupancy TrackingCamera-based driving perception systems either build a full 3D picture of the scene or follow individual objects over time — but not both at once.
ICRAConTrack3D: Contrastive Learning Contributes Concise 3D Multi-Object TrackingTracking many moving objects in 3D often loses track of them when they move in unexpected ways, because the system assumes constant speed and direction.
ICRASCAM-P: Spatial Channel Attention Module for Panoptic Driving PerceptionSelf-driving cars need to detect objects, find drivable areas, and identify lanes all at once in real time on low-power hardware, which is hard to do accurately without using too much computing power.
ICRAME-PATS: Mutually Enhancing Search-Based Planner and Learning-Based Agent for Tractor-Trailer SystemsPlanning safe, physically valid paths for trucks towing trailers is hard because the vehicle can only move in certain ways, obstacles can be complex, and the paths need to be planned far ahead.
ICRAEnhancing the Utilization of Color Information in Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation3D point cloud labeling systems mostly use shape information and largely ignore color, which hurts accuracy in scenes where objects look similar in shape but differ in color.
ICRASE-STDGNN: A Self-Evolving Spatial-Temporal Directed Graph Neural Network for Multi-Vehicle Trajectory PredictionSystems that predict where vehicles will go stop working well when traffic conditions change — different road types, densities, or weather — because the model was only trained on certain conditions.
