ICRALab2Car: A Versatile Wrapper for Deploying Experimental Planners in Complex Real-World EnvironmentsExperimental self-driving path planners built in the lab cannot be safely run on real cars because they may produce paths that are physically impossible or dangerous.
ICRALiDAR-EDIT: LiDAR Data Generation by Editing the Object Layouts in Real-World ScenesCreating realistic training data for self-driving lidar sensors is difficult because existing tools either give little control over where objects appear or cannot create scenes that look very different from real recorded data.
ICRAGenerating Causal Explanations of Vehicular Agent Behavioural Interactions with Learnt Reward Profiles ↗To explain why vehicles behave the way they do around each other, you need to know what each driver is optimizing for — but that is not directly observable.
ICRAMARF: Cooperative Multi-Agent Path Finding with Reinforcement Learning and Frenet Lattice in Dynamic EnvironmentsPlanning paths for multiple car-like vehicles that cannot turn in place is hard because the paths must follow the vehicles' physical turning limits while also avoiding each other in a changing environment.
ICRAMFSeg: Efficient Multi-Frame 3D Semantic SegmentationLabeling every point in a sequence of laser scans is slow because past scans are repeatedly processed even though most of their information was already extracted.
ICRAPanoptic-Depth ForecastingRobots that predict what a scene will look like in the near future can label objects and their outlines but currently cannot also predict how far away those objects will be, which they need for safe movement.
ICRATrajSSL: Trajectory-Enhanced Semi-Supervised 3D Object DetectionWhen training a 3D object detector with mostly unlabeled data, the automatically generated labels are often wrong — either detecting things that are not there or missing real objects — which teaches the detector bad habits.
ICRACA-IoU: Central-Gaussian Angle-IoU for Robust Bounding Box RegressionThe math used to train object detectors to draw tight boxes around objects converges slowly and is thrown off by box proportions that don't actually matter for getting the location right.
ICRADigital Beamforming Enhanced Radar OdometrySmall, single-chip radar sensors used on robots produce blurry point clouds because the standard signal processing method (FFT) has limited ability to tell apart objects close together in angle.
ICRACoarse-to-Fine Cross-Modality Generation for Enhancing Vehicle Re-Identification with High-Fidelity Synthetic DataTraining a system to recognize the same vehicle across different cameras is hard because collecting large sets of labeled real-world vehicle photos raises privacy concerns and often misses partial views.
ICRAORB-SfMLearner: ORB-Guided Self-supervised Visual Odometry with Selective Online AdaptationDeep learning methods for tracking a camera's movement through a scene are less accurate than classical feature-based methods and struggle when the environment looks different from training data.
ICRADomain Adaptation-Based Crossmodal Knowledge Distillation for 3D Semantic Segmentation ↗Labeling 3D laser scan data to teach robots what objects they are seeing is very time-consuming and expensive.
ICRADiscrete Contrastive Learning for Diffusion Policies in Autonomous DrivingCreating realistic simulated drivers that cover the full range of human driving styles is hard because that space of styles is very wide and hard to capture.
ICRABoosting Cross-Spectral Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Thermal Semantic SegmentationTeaching a system to label objects in heat-camera images without labeled heat-camera training data is hard, especially at night when regular cameras give little useful information.
ICRATime-Correlated Model Predictive Path Integral: Smooth Action Generation for Sampling-Based ControlA class of real-time robot controllers (MPPI) produces jerky, erratic commands because the random samples it draws at each time step are completely independent of the ones drawn a moment earlier.
ICRAEfficient 3D Perception on Multi-Sweep Point Cloud with Gumbel Spatial PruningStacking several laser scans on top of each other improves detection of far-away objects but creates a huge number of points, most of them redundant, making processing much slower.
ICRAFuel-Optimal Operational Speed Planning for Autonomous Trucking on HighwaysPlanning how fast a self-driving truck should go across an entire highway route — fast enough to meet delivery deadlines but using as little fuel as possible — is a hard math problem with no good public way to test solutions.
ICRADualdiff: Dual-Branch Diffusion Model for Autonomous Driving with Semantic FusionGenerating realistic multi-camera driving videos that correctly show both moving objects (cars, pedestrians) and complex backgrounds (roads, buildings) from mixed inputs like 3D maps and text is very hard because foreground and background need different treatment.
ICRATS-DETR: Traffic Sign Detection Based on Positive and Negative Sample AugmentationTraffic sign detectors often confuse similar-looking signs and miss rare ones because the training data has far more examples of common signs than rare ones.
ICRALearning Direct Solution in Moving Horizon Estimation with Deep Learning MethodsEstimating a system's state in real time by solving an optimization problem over a recent window of sensor data (Moving Horizon Estimation) gets too slow when the window is long or the system changes fast.
ICRATDFANet: Encoding Sequential 4D Radar Point Clouds Using Trajectory-Guided Deformable Feature Aggregation for Place RecognitionRecognizing a previously visited location using radar alone is unreliable because radar point clouds are sparse, noisy, and low-resolution, especially in bad weather.
ICRARLCNet: A Novel Deep Feature-Matching-Based Method for Online Target-Free Radar-LiDAR CalibrationFinding the precise spatial relationship between a radar and a LiDAR on the same vehicle is unreliable because radar data is extremely sparse and noisy compared to LiDAR.
ICRAStochastic Trajectory Prediction Under Unstructured ConstraintsPredicting future paths that follow social rules is hard because those rules are not written down as math equations that a computer can use directly.
ICRATask-Oriented Pre-Training for Drivable Area DetectionTeaching a model to find drivable road areas normally needs a large, expensively hand-labeled dataset.
ICRADrive with the FlowSelf-driving car models crash more often in dense traffic because they only look at the current moment and miss how nearby vehicles are moving over time.
ICRAFast LiDAR Data Generation with Rectified FlowsGenerating realistic fake laser scanner data for training robots takes too many steps through a neural network, making it too slow for large-scale use.
ICRAEfficient Path Planning in Complex Environments with Trust Region Continuous Belief Tree SearchA popular sampling-based planner called CBTS requires manually setting a fixed time budget per move, and no single setting works well in both open areas and tight spots with complex cost rules.
ICRABETTY Dataset: A Multi-Modal Dataset for Full-Stack AutonomyExisting self-driving datasets only cover perception tasks and do not include the full chain of sensor data and software outputs needed to train or test a complete autonomy system under extreme conditions.
ICRALACNS: Language-Assisted Continuous Navigation in Structured SpacesSelf-driving in cities today depends on expensive, pre-built detailed maps that are often unavailable or out of date.
ICRAMulti-Scale Convolutional Networks with Class-Normalized Logit Clipping for Robust Sea State Estimation from Noisy Ship Motion DataClassifying how rough the sea is from a ship's motion data is hurt by incorrect labels, because real ocean conditions are hard to measure precisely and labels are often wrong.
ICRALow-Rank Adaptation-Based All-Weather Removal for Autonomous NavigationImage restoration models trained to remove rain, fog, or snow fail on weather types they were not trained on, and retraining them from scratch on new conditions takes too much compute.
ICRASurfaceaug: Toward Versatile, Multimodally Consistent Ground Truth SamplingAdding fake extra training examples (data augmentation) for object detectors that use both cameras and laser scanners is hard because changes to one sensor's data quickly become inconsistent with the other.
ICRADigital Twins Meet the Koopman Operator: Data-Driven Learning for Robust AutonomyOff-road self-driving vehicles do not have enough real-world training data because terrain varies so much, so their motion models are poor.
ICRACapacitated Agriculture Fleet Vehicle Routing with Implements and Limited Autonomy: A Model and a Two-Phase Solution ApproachPlanning routes for a team of farming robots that share attachable tools and have limited battery life has no well-defined way to find a good solution.
ICRABeyond Simulation: Benchmarking World Models for Planning and Causality in Autonomous DrivingThe standard tests for software that simulates traffic do not check whether the simulation actually responds correctly when the self-driving car changes its own behavior, which is the main thing that matters for training.
ICRAVisual-Linguistic Reasoning for Pedestrian Trajectory PredictionSelf-driving systems have trouble using the rich visual and scene meaning in their camera footage to predict where pedestrians will walk next.
ICRAH3O: Hyper-Efficient 3D Occupancy Prediction with Heterogeneous SupervisionFiguring out which 3D cells around a car are occupied is slow because current methods use expensive operations to move information from camera images into 3D space, and the training labels are often fuzzy or incomplete.
ICRAROD: RGB-Only Fast and Efficient Off-Road Freespace DetectionDetecting safe driving surfaces off-road accurately usually requires a laser scanner (LiDAR), which adds cost, weight, and latency.
ICRATowards Robust Autonomous Driving: Conditional Multimodal Large Language Models for Fine-Grained PerceptionVision-language AI models are not precise enough about the exact location and identity of individual objects in a scene, which is critical for safe self-driving.
ICRAIROAM: Improving Roadside Monocular 3D Object Detection Learning from Autonomous Vehicle Data DomainCameras mounted on the roadside see the world from a very different angle than cameras on cars, so detectors trained on car-camera data do not work well on roadside cameras.
ICRASemantic-Supervised Spatial-Temporal Fusion for LiDAR-Based 3D Object DetectionCombining laser scanner data from multiple time steps to detect objects in 3D is difficult because moving objects shift position between frames, creating misaligned data.
ICRAUnlock the Power of Unlabeled Data in Language Driving ModelTraining a vision-language model to understand driving scenes requires large amounts of human-labeled data, which is expensive to produce.
ICRARoBiFusion: A Robust and Bidirectional Interaction Camera-LiDAR 3D Object Detection FrameworkCombining camera and laser sensor data to detect objects in 3D works well at a late processing stage but misses useful detail from earlier stages, and mixing early features crudely introduces errors from small sensor alignment mistakes.
ICRADecentralized Vehicle Coordination: The Berkeley DeepDrive Drone Dataset and Consensus-Based ModelsSelf-driving cars need to handle intersections and shared roads where there are no traffic lights or signs, but researchers lack real video data of how human drivers negotiate these situations.
ICRACohere3D: Exploiting Temporal Coherence for Unsupervised Representation Learning of Vision-Based Autonomous DrivingCamera-based driving systems need to recognize the same car or pedestrian across many frames, but lighting and angle changes make that hard when no human labels are available.
ICRACausal Contrastive Learning with Data Augmentations for Imitation-Based PlanningDriving models trained by copying expert behavior often learn to react to the wrong cues — for example, braking because the previous frame showed braking rather than because the road ahead requires it.
ICRAKFCalibNet: A KansFormer-Based Self-Calibration Network for Camera and LiDARAligning a camera and a LiDAR without a calibration target is inaccurate when the two sensors see only a small area in common, because there are few shared features to match.
ICRAPRIDEV: A Plug-and-Play Refinement for Improved Depth Estimation in VideosDepth-estimation models trained on still photos flicker and produce artifacts when applied to video, and the existing video-specific fixes require knowing the camera's motion or having optical flow computed first.
ICRAOcc-LLM: Enhancing Autonomous Driving with Occupancy-Based Large Language ModelsLarge language models used for driving couldn't directly read 3D occupancy grids — the spatial maps that show what cells around a car are blocked — and they confused common static objects with the rare moving ones.
ICRAComplementary Information Guided Occupancy Prediction via Multi-Level Representation FusionCamera-based systems that predict which 3D cells in a scene are occupied were not using the full range of information available in 2D images, so their predictions were less accurate than they could be.
ICRAExplore the LiDAR-Camera Dynamic Adjustment Fusion for 3D Object DetectionCamera images and LiDAR point clouds describe the world in very different ways, so combining them for detecting objects in 3D is unreliable.
ICRATowards Accurate Semi-Supervised BEV 3D Object Detection with Depth-Aware Refinement and Denoising-Aided AlignmentTraining a camera-only 3D object detector requires a lot of labeled data; when using unlabeled images to reduce that need, the automatically generated labels are often wrong and the depth information gets lost.
ICRACDMFusion: RGB-T Image Fusion Based on Conditional Diffusion Models via Few Denoising Steps in Open EnvironmentsCombining a normal color camera image with a thermal image into one sharp, detailed image is hard to do well and fast enough for real use.
ICRAEvaluating Global Geo-Alignment for Precision Learned Autonomous Vehicle Localization Using Aerial DataSelf-driving cars that locate themselves using satellite or aerial maps get less accurate when the aerial image and the car's own sensor data are not precisely aligned during training.
ICRAOPRNet: Object-Centric Point Reconstruction Network for Multimodal 3D Object Detection in Adverse WeathersRain, fog, and snow scatter laser pulses so the 3D point cloud a self-driving car's LiDAR produces becomes too thin to reliably detect distant objects.
ICRAA Comprehensive LLM-powered Framework for Driving Intelligence EvaluationThere is no good way to measure how intelligently a self-driving car behaves in complex traffic, the way a human passenger or driver would judge it.
ICRALMH-MOT : A Light Multiple Hypothesis Framework for 3D Multi-Object TrackingTracking many objects at once in 3D from sensor data fails in crowded scenes because objects hide each other and sensors miss detections.
ICRAUnveiling the Black Box: Independent Functional Module Evaluation for Bird's-Eye-View Perception ModelInside large end-to-end self-driving perception models it is unclear whether each internal module has learned what it is supposed to, because there is no way to measure a module's quality without retraining the whole model.
ICRACoL3D: Collaborative Learning of Single-view Depth and Camera Intrinsics for Metric 3D Shape RecoveryTurning a single photo into a correctly scaled 3D shape is not possible without knowing the camera's focal length and other internal settings, which are usually missing.
ICRAThe Devil is in the Quality: Exploring Informative Samples for Semi-Supervised Monocular 3D Object DetectionTraining a 3D object detector for self-driving using mostly unlabeled images fails because the automatically generated training labels for those images are often wrong, and using bad labels hurts the model.
ICRAParking-SG: Open-Vocabulary Hierarchical 3D Scene Graph Representation for Open Parking EnvironmentsSelf-parking car systems fail in real parking lots that have no clear markings or standard layouts.
ICRATri-AutoAug: Single Domain Generalization for Bird's-Eye-View 3D Object Detection Through Pixel-2D-3D FeaturesA 3D object detector for self-driving cars trained on one city or sensor setup often fails badly when tested somewhere new, because it has only seen one kind of data.
ICRABi-Stream Knowledge Transfer for Semi-Supervised 3D Point Cloud Object DetectionTraining a 3D object detector with few labeled examples is hard because the automatically generated labels for unlabeled data are often wrong, and current methods throw away uncertain labels that still hold useful signal.
ICRAAutonomous Navigation in Ice-Covered Waters with Learned Predictions on Ship-Ice InteractionsA self-driving ship in icy water cannot avoid all ice, so it needs to predict how the ice will move when the ship pushes through it and plan the least damaging path.
ICRADiff-Refiner: Enhancing Multi-Agent Trajectory Prediction with a Plug-and-Play Diffusion RefinerDiffusion-based trajectory predictors waste most of their computation steps turning pure random noise into a rough trajectory before they can start refining it, which hurts both speed and accuracy.
ICRASteering Prediction via a Multi-Sensor System for Autonomous RacingRacing cars that use only flat 2D laser scans lack the time-varying detail needed to predict steering accurately at high speed.
IROSDiverse and Adaptive Behavior Curriculum for Autonomous Driving: A Student-Teacher Framework with Multi-Agent RLSelf-driving car software trained only on scripted traffic scenarios gets good at those specific cases but struggles with the full range of real traffic, including rare or dangerous situations.
IROSLGDD: Local-Global Synergistic Dual-Branch 3D Object Detection Using 4D Radar4D millimeter-wave radar point clouds are sparse and noisy, degrading 3D object detection accuracy in autonomous driving.
IROSMultiNash-PF: A Particle Filtering Approach for Computing Multiple Local Generalized Nash Equilibria in Trajectory GamesWhen several robots or vehicles share a space, there are often multiple equally valid ways the interaction could play out, and planners that find only one solution miss important options.
IROSCG-Net: Urban Trajectory Forecasting with Bipartite Graphs for Agents, Scene Context and Candidate CenterlinesPredicting where vehicles and pedestrians will go at busy city intersections is hard because there are many possible road paths and many interacting agents at once.
IROSKDMOS:Knowledge Distillation for Motion SegmentationDetecting which objects are moving in a laser scan in real time is hard because accurate models are too slow and fast models miss too many moving objects.
IROSFusion Scene Context: Robust and Efficient LiDAR Place Recognition Across SeasonA robot using laser scans to recognize a place it has visited before fails in different seasons because the scene looks different even though the structure is the same.
IROSFeature-aligned Fisheye Object Detection Network for Autonomous DrivingStandard object detection networks produce misaligned internal feature maps when used on wide-angle fisheye camera images, causing objects to be poorly located.
IROSA 4D Radar Camera Extrinsic Calibration Tool Based on 3D Uncertainty Perspective N PointsAligning a 4D radar with a camera is unreliable because standard calibration math ignores the specific way radar sensors introduce measurement error in their coordinate system.
IROSIMVPR: Implicit BEV-Enhanced Multi-View Aggregation for Visual Place RecognitionMerging camera views from multiple directions into a single place description is hard to do well without expensive explicit 3D feature construction.
IROSLayer Decomposition and Morphological Reconstruction for Task-Oriented Infrared Image EnhancementInfrared cameras struggle to see objects like bicycles that do not give off heat, especially in bad weather, which makes automatic detection and segmentation unreliable.
IROSSN-LiDAR: Semantic Neural Fields for Novel Space-time View LiDAR SynthesisMethods that generate realistic LiDAR scans from new viewpoints do not also label what each point in the scan represents, which limits how useful those synthetic scans are for training perception systems.
IROSDynamicity Adaptation for Multi-object Tracking and Segmentation: Toward Improved Association CorrectionTracking and segmenting multiple moving objects fails when things get occluded or change shape quickly, because appearance-based matching stops being reliable.
IROSUDSH: An Unsupervised Deep Image Stitching and De-Occlusion Method for Heavy Occlusion SceneCombining overlapping photos into one image fails when objects block parts of the scene, because current methods cannot tell which pixels are blocked and end up with errors and missing content.
IROSSynthDrive: Scalable Real2Sim2Real Sensor Simulation Pipeline for High-Fidelity Asset Generation and Driving Data SynthesisTraining self-driving car detectors to handle rare objects is hard because existing simulation tools either look fake or only cover a few object types.
IROSROA-BEV: 2D Region-Oriented Attention for BEV-based 3D Object Detection3D object detectors that work from camera images often miss objects that look similar to the background because the image feature extractor pays equal attention to everything.
IROSDSFormer-RTP: Dynamic-stream Transformers for Real-time Deterministic Trajectory PredictionPredicting where pedestrians will walk fast enough for a delivery robot to react in real time is too slow with existing methods that try to model time and crowd interactions all at once.
IROSOpportunistic Collaborative Planning with Large Vision Model Guided Control and Joint Query-Service OptimizationSelf-driving vehicles sometimes encounter objects their on-board software has never seen, but powerful cloud vision models are too slow and costly to consult constantly.
IROSMultiple Object Tracking with Dynamic Adaptive Object Motion EstimationTracking multiple vehicles or pedestrians in a self-driving car fails when objects speed up, slow down, or get briefly hidden, because standard trackers assume constant speed and can't adapt.
IROSOn learning racing policies with reinforcement learningSelf-driving race cars push tires to their grip limits, and standard model-based controllers can't keep up with the best human drivers or reach top speed safely.
IROSMATRICS: A Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Traffic-Aware Intelligent Lane-Change SystemSelf-driving cars decide when to change lanes based only on what's around them, without considering how their choice affects the flow of all traffic on the road.
IROSCoordinated Energy-Trajectory Economic Model Predictive Control for Autonomous Surface Vehicles under DisturbancesBoat-like autonomous vehicles on open water need to stay on course and save fuel at the same time, but standard planning methods do not balance those two goals well under wave and current disturbances.
IROSLightweight Temporal Transformer Decomposition for Federated Autonomous DrivingTeaching a car to drive from video requires large, slow neural networks that are too expensive to train privately across many devices at once.
IROSEfficient Instance Motion-Aware Point Cloud Scene PredictionSelf-driving cars need to predict where objects will be in the next moment, but most methods treat the whole scene as one blob and miss the movement of individual objects, making predictions less accurate.
IROSSAMap: Semantic Alignment for HD Map Detection Domain Generalization Under Varying Weather and LightingMap-prediction models trained in good weather break down in rain, fog, or darkness because the images look very different from what the model was trained on.
IROSPCMF2-Net: A Pyramid Cross-Modal Feature Fusion Network for Off-Road Freespace DetectionDetecting where a robot can safely drive off-road is hard because the ground has no clear edges, and combining camera images with laser scan data (LiDAR) in a useful way is difficult.
IROSImagine-2-Drive: Leveraging High-Fidelity World Models via Multi-Modal Diffusion PoliciesSelf-driving models that predict the future one step at a time pile up mistakes, and they can't handle tricky driving moves that have many valid options.
IROSUnsupervised Anomaly Detection Improves Imitation Learning for Autonomous RacingBad camera images (blurry, broken) in training data hurt self-driving models, but paying people to find and label bad images is expensive.
IROSQuaternion Approximate Networks for Enhanced Image Classification and Oriented Object DetectionStandard image-recognition networks treat a rotated object as something new, wasting parameters and hurting accuracy for tasks where object angle matters.
IROSIGDrivSim: A Benchmark for the Imitation Gap in Autonomous DrivingA self-driving car trained by copying human drivers sees different information than the human did, so it learns bad habits that make it less safe.
IROSRobust and High-Fidelity 3D Gaussian Splatting: Fusing Pose Priors and Geometry Constraints for Texture-Deficient Outdoor ScenesTurning outdoor laser and camera data into a high-quality 3D scene model breaks down when surfaces lack clear markings or have repeated patterns, because camera positions are then estimated poorly.
IROSAdjacent-view Transformers for Supervised Surround-view Depth EstimationMethods that estimate distance from cameras placed all around a car treat each camera separately and miss information that neighbouring cameras share about the same scene.
IROSDiffusion-FS: Multimodal Free-Space Prediction via Diffusion for Autonomous DrivingCars need to know which regions ahead are safe to drive through, but getting labeled outlines of drivable corridors from a single front camera is expensive and the output options are often too simple.
IROSVision-Driven 2D Supervised Fine-Tuning Framework for Bird's Eye View PerceptionUpdating a top-down (bird's eye view) map perception system for a new location normally requires a LiDAR sensor to provide ground-truth labels, which is expensive and limits where the system can be adapted.
IROSOptimizing for Ride Comfort: A Model Predictive Control Framework with Frequency-Domain Analysis of the Acceleration SequenceSelf-driving car controllers watch how hard or suddenly they accelerate right now but ignore whether the rhythm of accelerations over time will feel uncomfortable to passengers.
IROSRDN: An Efficient Denoising Network for 4D Radar Point Clouds4D radar sensors—which also measure velocity—produce very noisy and sparse point clouds, which hurts how well a robot can perceive its surroundings and track its own position.
IROSReal-Time Consistent Monocular Depth Recovery System for Dynamic EnvironmentsA single camera cannot reliably tell how far away things are when the scene has moving objects, and the depth estimates jump around from one video frame to the next.
IROSNon-Overlap-Aware Egocentric Pose Estimation for Collaborative Perception in Connected AutonomyWhen two robots are trying to figure out their positions relative to each other, they fail if they are looking at different areas with no shared landmarks, and sending full camera images to compare uses too much wireless bandwidth.
IROSM-Predictive Spliner: Enabling Spatiotemporal Multi-Opponent Overtaking for Autonomous RacingA self-driving race car competing against several other cars at once needs to predict where each car is going and keep track of which car is which in order to safely pass them.
IROSHeterogeneous Mixed Traffic Control and CoordinationIntersections without traffic lights cause long waits and wasted fuel when a mix of vehicle sizes from cars to large trucks all try to cross at the same time.
IROSESCoT: An Enhanced Step-based Coordinate Trajectory Planning Method for Multiple Car-like RobotsPlanning paths for many car-like robots at once often leads to conflicts and failures, especially when the space is crowded.
IROSUnidirectional Point-Voxel Fusion for Enhanced 3D Single Object TrackingTracking a single object in 3D laser scan data is hard because sparse point-based methods miss texture detail while volume-based methods pick up too much background noise.
IROSDuLoc: Life-Long Dual-Layer Localization in Changing and Dynamic Expansive ScenariosLiDAR-based localization in large areas breaks down over time because the pre-built map goes stale as the real environment changes.
IROSPosePilot: Steering Camera Pose for Generative World Models with Self-supervised DepthVideo-generation models used to simulate driving scenes cannot accurately control what camera angle the generated video shows, making it hard to produce realistic scenes from new viewpoints.
IROSDashGaze: Driver Gaze Through DashcamTracking where a driver is looking to monitor road safety normally needs expensive eye-tracking hardware or a dedicated camera aimed at the driver's face.
IROSAlong-Edge Autonomous Driving on Curvy Roads Based on Frenet Frame: A Stable Hierarchical Planning FrameworkSelf-driving cars that need to follow the edge of a winding road struggle because tight curves and obstacles cannot be handled well by a single planner.
IROSSelf-localization on a 3D map by fusing global and local features from a monocular camera ↗A single camera trying to find its position on a 3D map makes mistakes when people or vehicles are moving through the scene, because standard image feature detectors only look at small patches and miss the overall layout.
IROSVPOcc: Exploiting Vanishing Point for 3D Semantic Occupancy PredictionCameras see faraway objects as smaller than nearby ones, and this perspective distortion makes it hard to correctly map which 3D space is occupied when using only camera images.
IROSMV2: A Large-Scale 360-degree Multi-View Maritime Vision Dataset for Object Detection and SegmentationDatasets for teaching computers to see objects on the water are mostly taken from one camera angle, so they do not cover what a ship needs to see all around itself.
IROSSAC(λ): Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Sparse-Reward Autonomous Car Racing using Imperfect DemonstrationsTeaching a racing car to drive fast using trial-and-error learning is very slow when the only reward signal is completing a lap, and using recorded human laps to speed things up causes the car to copy the human's mistakes.
IROSConsistent Feature Alignment for Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation in Monocular 3D Object DetectionTeaching a camera-only 3D object detector by copying knowledge from a laser scanner (LiDAR) detector is hard because the two sensors produce very different internal signals that do not match up well.
IROSMulti-PrefDrive: Optimizing Large Language Models for Autonomous Driving Through Multi-Preference TuningTraining a driving AI by only saying 'this choice is right, that one is wrong' does not teach it that some wrong choices are worse than others.
IROSGTAD: Global Temporal Aggregation Denoising Learning for 3D Semantic Occupancy PredictionSelf-driving car perception systems that build a 3D map of what is around the car only look at a few recent frames, missing useful context from further back in the drive.
IROSMulti-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Transformer-based Spatio-temporal Fusion for Autonomous Driving in Mixed TrafficSelf-driving cars sharing roads with human drivers need to make safe decisions together, but tracking how all nearby vehicles interact over time is hard.
IROSDPGLA: Bridging the Gap between Synthetic and Real Data for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in 3D LiDAR Semantic SegmentationTraining a LiDAR segmentation model on simulated scans and running it on real scans gives poor results because the model's self-generated labels during fine-tuning use a fixed confidence cutoff that becomes wrong as the model changes.
IROSSelf-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation for Dynamic Objects with Ground PropagationTraining a depth camera to estimate distance from a single image without labels fails for moving objects like cars and people because the math used for training assumes everything in the scene is still.
IROSSimWorld: A Unified Benchmark for Simulator-Conditioned Scene Generation via World ModelSelf-driving perception models need training images of rare dangerous situations that are hard to collect in the real world, and there is no good way to check whether generated images actually help the model.
IROSReusing Attention for One-stage Lane Topology UnderstandingSelf-driving systems that first detect road lanes and then separately figure out how they connect are slow and let errors in the first step hurt the second.
IROSSOLO-SMap: Semantic-Aided Online LiDAR Odometry and 3D Static Mapping for Dynamic ScenesMoving objects like cars and people cause laser-scan mapping systems to drift and leave ghost shapes in the map, making the map unreliable for navigation.
IROSExpliDrive: Bridging Model Predictive Control and Transformers for Interactive Autonomous DrivingSelf-driving systems plan paths without fully accounting for how the car's moves will affect what other nearby cars do, so they miss important interactions.
IROSRoadsideSplat: Robust 3D Gaussian Reconstruction from Monocular Roadside SurveillanceBuilding a 3D model of a road scene from a single fixed roadside camera fails because standard depth-estimation tools mix up vehicles and the road behind them.
IROSET-Former: Efficient Triplane Deformable Attention for 3D Semantic Scene Completion From Monocular CameraFilling in a full labeled 3D map of a scene from a single regular camera is expensive in GPU memory and gives no sense of how confident the predictions are.
IROSJAM: Keypoint-Guided Joint Prediction after Classification-Aware Marginal Proposal for Multi-Agent InteractionPredicting where multiple cars or pedestrians will all go at the same time is hard because rare but important movement patterns are often missed.
IROSDriveBLIP2: Attention-Guided Explanation Generation for Complex Driving ScenariosVision-language AI models cannot reliably pick out the specific objects in a busy driving scene that actually matter for a driving decision, so their explanations miss the key details.
IROSMambaSFLNet: A Mamba-based Model for Low-Light Image Enhancement with Spatial and Frequency FeaturesImproving dark images requires understanding patterns spread across the whole image at once, but doing that efficiently without a heavy model is difficult, especially when also trying to recover sharpness and contrast.
IROSLarge-Scale Mixed-Traffic and Intersection Control using Multi-agent Reinforcement LearningControlling many intersections in a city with a mix of self-driving and human-driven vehicles is too complex for current AI traffic methods, which only handle small isolated intersections.
IROSTopoLiDM: Topology-Aware LiDAR Diffusion Models for Interpretable and Realistic LiDAR Point Cloud Generation ↗AI methods that generate fake LiDAR point clouds of outdoor scenes produce outputs with wrong global structure, such as disconnected road surfaces or floating objects, because they work in a compressed hidden space that ignores shape topology.
IROSWFDA: Wavelet-Based Frequency Decomposition and Aggregation for Underwater Object DetectionDetecting objects underwater is hard because images are blurry and unevenly lit, and the processing has to be fast enough for a small robot to do it in real time.
IROSBoRe-Depth: Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation with Boundary Refinement for Embedded SystemsEstimating depth from a single camera on a small onboard computer produces blurry edges around objects, and most accurate models are too large to run fast on such hardware.
IROSHPLaw: Heterogeneous Parallel LiDARs for Adverse Weather in V2VWhen multiple self-driving cars share sensor data to see better together, their sensors are often different models, and current methods for handling that are only tested in clear weather — they break in rain, fog, or snow.
IROSTEM3-Learning: Time-Efficient Multimodal Multi-Task Learning for Advanced Assistive DrivingDriving-assistance systems that watch the driver and the road at the same time were either too slow to run in real time or only used one type of sensor data.
IROS4D-ROLLS: 4D Radar Occupancy Learning via LiDAR SupervisionSelf-driving cars need to know what space around them is occupied, but cameras and laser scanners fail in rain, fog, or smoke.
IROSCross-Level Fusion: Integrating Object Lists with Raw Sensor Data for 3D Object TrackingSmart sensors send out pre-processed object lists that lose geometric detail, but combining those lists with raw camera data in a tracker is hard because the two representations don't line up well.
IROSVISC: mmWave Radar Scene Flow Estimation using Pervasive Visual-Inertial SupervisionTracking how things move in 3D using millimeter-wave radar normally requires expensive laser scanners for training data, and cheap cameras plus motion sensors alone cannot handle moving objects or stay accurate over time.
IROSInspiring External Human-Machine Interface Designs for Autonomous Personal Mobility Vehicle: Causal Discovering the Influence of Passengers' Personality Traits on User ExperienceIt is not clear how different communication styles from a self-driving vehicle affect passengers differently depending on their personality.
IROSSLTNet: Efficient Event-based Semantic Segmentation with Spike-driven Lightweight Transformer-based NetworksLabeling every pixel in an event camera image by category is too computationally heavy for small, power-limited devices.
IROSOn Learning Closed-Loop Probabilistic Multi-Agent SimulatorTesting self-driving cars requires realistic simulations where many vehicles interact with each other, but existing tools can't easily control driving styles or generate truly varied, believable traffic.
IROSTopology-Driven Trajectory Optimization for Modelling Controllable Interactions Within Multi-Vehicle ScenarioWhen planning paths for several vehicles at once in tight spaces, standard optimizers are sensitive to the starting guess and cannot be told which vehicle should pass first.
IROSSaliency-Guided Domain Adaptation for Left-Hand Driving in Autonomous SteeringSelf-driving steering models trained on roads where traffic keeps right do not work well on roads where traffic keeps left.
IROSHAMF: A Hybrid Attention-Mamba Framework for Joint Scene Context Understanding and Future Motion Representation LearningPredicting where nearby vehicles will move is less accurate when scene understanding and trajectory prediction are done one after the other rather than together.
IROSCoDifFu: Diffusion-Based Collaborative Perception with Efficient Heterogeneous Feature FusionWhen multiple self-driving cars share sensor data to detect objects together, small position errors and different sensor types make the combined data noisy and hard to merge.
IROSEfficient End-to-end Visual Localization for Autonomous Driving with Decoupled BEV Neural MatchingMatching a car's camera views to a pre-built map to find its position is fragile because it depends on hand-tuned thresholds and breaks down in bad sensor conditions.
IROSHierarchical Question-Answering for Driving Scene Understanding Using Vision-Language ModelsVision-language models that describe driving scenes in full detail are too slow for real-time use because they generate long text answers for every scene regardless of what is needed.
IROSOpen-Set LiDAR Panoptic Segmentation Guided by Uncertainty-Aware LearningLidar perception models trained on known object types cannot flag objects they have never seen before, which is dangerous in real driving where unexpected things appear.
IROSAVP Scene Graph: Hierarchical Visual Language Mapping and Navigation for Autonomous Valet ParkingSelf-parking car systems that use pre-made maps cannot understand spoken or typed instructions like 'park near the elevator' because those maps store geometry, not meaning.
IROSAutonomous Vehicle Controllers From End-to-End Differentiable SimulationSelf-driving car controllers trained only on recorded driving data do poorly in new situations, and training from scratch with trial-and-error (reinforcement learning) needs too many practice runs.
IROSMovSAM: A Single-image Moving Object Segmentation Framework Based on Deep ThinkingFinding which objects in a photo are in motion is normally done by comparing multiple frames over time, so it cannot be done from a single still image.
IROSLR2Depth: Large-Region Aggregation at Low Resolution for Efficient Monocular Depth EstimationEstimating depth from a single camera image accurately requires looking at large regions of the image, but doing so at full resolution is too slow.
IROSAuto-calibration of Camera Intrinsics and Extrinsics using Lidar and MotionCalibrating a camera's internal settings and its position on a vehicle without a checkerboard target is hard, especially for fine lens-distortion parameters that need many precise measurements.
IROSIterative Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Optimization via Surrogate DiffusionMethods that align a camera and a laser scanner in a single pass are not accurate enough because they have no way to go back and refine the answer.
IROSThe Sampling-Gaussian for Stereo MatchingWhen computers measure depth using two cameras, the math for finding answers tends to produce messy, multi-peaked results that aren't accurate.
IROSUsing High-Level Patterns to Estimate How Humans Predict a Robot will BehaveRobots need to guess what a person next to them thinks the robot will do, but people don't think about exact paths—they think about rough ideas like "going left" or "stopping".
IROSCoherent Online Road Topology Estimation and Reasoning with Standard-Definition MapsRobots driving themselves produce unreliable lane predictions because roads are complex and the sensor data alone isn't consistent.
IROSLanes Are Not Enough: Enhancing Trajectory Prediction in Intralogistics Through Detailed Environmental ContextRobots in warehouses can't predict where other robots will go because lane-based methods from traffic don't match warehouse layouts with racks and shelves.
IROSLaneMind: Seeing Lanes Like Human DriversLane-detection systems trained on average conditions fail in hard situations like dark roads or bright glare, and they struggle with winding roads because they do not model the actual shape of the lane center.
IROSFocusing on Projection-Stable Patch: Cross-View Localization with Geometric-Semantic AlignmentFiguring out a ground-level location by matching photos from cars with satellite imagery is hard because shadows, buildings, and angle changes hide the true shape of the scene.
IROSSILM: A Subjective Intent Based Low-Latency Framework for Multiple Traffic Participants Joint Trajectory PredictionPredicting where cars and pedestrians will go is uncertain and slow because current systems do not account for what each person or driver is actually trying to do—their intention.
IROS3D-UnOutDet: A Fast and Efficient Unsupervised Snow Removal Algorithm for 3D LiDAR Point CloudsSnow and ice create fake points in lidar scans, breaking self-driving perception, but training systems to ignore snow requires expensive hand-labeled snowy data that is hard to collect.
IROSMIAT: Maneuver-Intention-Aware Transformer for Spatio-Temporal Trajectory PredictionPredicting where a car will go is hard because you don't know if the driver is about to change lanes, speed up, or turn, and ignoring those intentions makes the prediction miss by a lot.
IROSSpatial-Temporal Graph Contrastive Learning with Decreasing Masks for Traffic Flow ForecastingPredicting traffic volume is hard because sensor data has missing chunks, and you need to see both short-range patterns (in one block) and long-range patterns (across the whole city) at once.
IROSService Discovery-Based Hybrid Network Middleware for Efficient Communication in Distributed Robotic SystemsSelf-driving cars with multiple chips need to send data back and forth quickly and reliably, but the current system wastes bandwidth by sending the same message many times.
IROSBeacon: A Naturalistic Driving Dataset During Blackouts for Benchmarking Traffic Reconstruction and ControlThere's no real-world data showing how cars actually behave at intersections when traffic lights fail, so we can't test how self-driving cars and robots should handle these chaos situations.
IROSTowards Autonomous Indoor Parking: A Globally Consistent Semantic SLAM System and A Semantic Localization SubsystemAutonomous vehicles in complex indoor parking lots need globally consistent semantic maps and robust localization using heterogeneous sensors including surround cameras, IMU, and wheel encoders.
IROSVoxEKF-RIO: A 4D Radar Inertial Odometry Based on Incremental Voxel Map and Iterated Kalman FilterRadar that sees in 4D produces sparse, noisy data that makes it hard to track where a robot is moving, especially in bad weather when cameras and light sensors fail.
IROSEFFOcc: Learning Efficient Occupancy Networks from Minimal Labels for Autonomous DrivingDeep learning networks that predict which spaces are occupied take a lot of computer power and need tons of expensive labeled training data to work.
IROSA Coarse-to-Fine Approach to Multi-Modality 3D Occupancy GroundingWhen a car's self-driving system tries to find an object by drawing a box around it, the whole box might not be the object—some parts might be empty air.
IROSGeneralizable Image Repair for Robust Visual ControlWhen a self-driving car's cameras are blurry, dirty, or in weird lighting, the control system gets confused and performs poorly because it was only trained on clean pictures.
IROSREOcc: Camera-Radar Fusion with Radar Feature Enrichment for 3D Occupancy PredictionCamera-only vision fails in bad weather or dark, and radar alone is sparse and noisy, but combining them isn't straightforward.
IROSSimulating Automotive Radar with Lidar and Camera InputsReal radar data for autonomous cars is scarce and expensive, slowing down radar research.
IROSAccelerating Real-World Overtaking in F1TENTH Racing Employing Reinforcement Learning MethodsAutonomous racing cars struggle to pass other cars reliably when they're actually racing.
IROSCollaborative Dynamic 3D Scene Graphs for Open-Vocabulary Urban Scene UnderstandingBuilding rich, labeled 3D maps of busy cities with multiple robots when nobody knows where the robots start is really hard.
IROSGDTS: Goal-Guided Diffusion Model with Tree Sampling for Multi-Modal Pedestrian Trajectory PredictionIt's hard to predict where pedestrians will walk when they have multiple possible destinations, and current methods are slow because they repeat the same calculations many times.
IROSDiFuse-Net: RGB and Dual-Pixel Depth Estimation using Window Bi-directional Parallax Attention and Cross-modal Transfer LearningPhone cameras with dual-pixel sensors don't have enough stereo information to estimate depth well, and there aren't many training examples of dual-pixel depth.
IROSMinkOcc: Towards real-time label-efficient semantic occupancy prediction3D semantic occupancy prediction needs lots of hand-labeled 3D data, which is expensive to collect, so scaling up is impractical.
IROSSAFormer: Spatially Adaptive Transformer for Efficient and Multi-Resolution Occupancy PredictionFiguring out what space around a self-driving car is free or blocked eats up too much computing power and memory when processing high-resolution 3D data from cameras.
IROSModular Decision-Making and Drivable Areas for Multi-Agent Autonomous RacingRacing robots need to decide when to pass or follow other robots while planning safe paths in real time.
IROSA Multi-Modal Benchmark for Long-Range Depth Evaluation in Adverse Weather ConditionsThere's no good test data to check if depth cameras and lasers work well at far distances in fog or rain, which matters for self-driving cars.
IROSDualAD: Dual-Layer Planning for Reasoning in Autonomous DrivingSelf-driving cars either follow fixed rules that can't think through new dangers or learn from data that fails on rare but critical accidents.
IROSVisual Localization with Offline Google Satellite Map-Assisted for Ground Vehicles in GNSS-Denied EnvironmentCars can't use GPS in cities with tall buildings or tunnels, so they slowly drift off track when following camera-based position estimates.
IROSL2COcc: Lightweight Camera-Centric Semantic Scene Completion via Distillation of LiDAR ModelBuilding a 3D map of what's around a car using only cameras needs so much computing that self-driving cars can't do it on the hardware they carry.
IROSBench4Merge: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Merging in Realistic Dense Traffic with Micro-Interactive VehiclesTesting self-driving car merging only uses rule-based fake traffic that does not behave like real drivers, so the real world catches planners off guard.
IROSDrive&Gen: Co-Evaluating End-to-End Driving and Video Generation ModelsRobots that drive themselves have no clear way to test whether they work, and AI programs that generate videos have no way to check if they produce realistic driving scenes.
IROSSTAGE: A Stream-Centric Generative World Model for Long-Horizon Driving-Scene SimulationMaking long videos of driving scenes with AI causes errors to pile up across frames, and different parts of each frame get out of sync with each other.
IROSComDrive: Comfort-Oriented End-to-End Autonomous DrivingSelf-driving cars trained by copying humans make jerky, uncomfortable motions even when they don't crash.
IROSLI-SLAM: Lightweight and Incremental Semantic Visual Localization and Mapping for Autonomous Valet ParkingSelf-parking robots fail underground because garage pillars look the same, lighting changes, and there's no good way to map these spaces.
IROSCrossBEV-PR: Cross-modal Visual-LiDAR Place Recognition via BEV Feature DistillationMatching a phone camera photo to a 3D laser map is hard because one is flat pictures and the other is bumpy point clouds.
IROSCRUISE: Cooperative Reconstruction and Editing in V2X Scenarios using Gaussian SplattingMaking realistic training data for self-driving cars that talk to each other and to road cameras is hard and there's no way to edit or change the scenes.
IROSAdaptive Large-Scale Novel View Image Synthesis for Autonomous Driving DatasetsCreating fake pictures of driving scenes from new angles is hard because the depth is wrong, cars move, cameras see too wide, and it takes too much computer memory.
IROSESFUSION: Enhanced LiDAR-camera Fusion Architecture for HD Mapping at IntersectionMaking detailed road maps at busy intersections is hard because laser and camera each see different things and have blind spots.
IROSVehicle Drifting Planning and Control Framework for Flexible U-turns in Space-limited EnvironmentsSelf-driving cars can't make tight U-turns in small spaces because their normal steering rules don't work when space is tight.
IROSDifferential-Flatness-Based Tracking Control for Tractor-Trailers in Reversing ManeuversWhen a tractor-trailer backs up, the physics are unstable—small control errors grow and make the rig veer off course.
IROSUSVTrack: USV-Based 4D Radar-Camera Tracking Dataset for Autonomous Driving in Inland WaterwaysThere is no data set for training robots to see and track other boats on inland rivers using radar and cameras together.
IROSMoving Object Segmentation via 3D LiDAR Data: A Learning-Free Real-time Online AlternativeFinding moving things in 3D laser scans requires heavy AI models that are slow and don't work well across different laser types.
IROSEfficient Distributional Reinforcement Learning with Monotonic Approximation for Driving Decision-MakingUsing distributions of outcomes to teach a self-driving car is slow because it takes too much computing.
IROSLearning Predictive Control with Online Modeling for Agile Maneuvering of Autonomous VehiclesSelf-driving cars must turn sharply and accelerate hard while the road conditions are always changing, and old control methods can't keep up.
IROSReal-Time Incremental Mapping and Degeneration-Aware Localization for Multi-Floor Parking Lots Based on IPM ImageParking garage GPS doesn't work, and normal camera-based navigation gets confused by bad light and repetitive columns.
IROSTASeg: Text-aware RGB-T Semantic Segmentation based on Fine-tuning Vision Foundation ModelsThermal and regular cameras together should give better scene understanding, but the network gets confused when objects look alike in both views.
IROSCausal-Planner: Causal Interaction Disentangling with Episodic Memory Gating for Autonomous PlanningSelf-driving cars can't decide what to do safely in traffic because it's hard to tell which other cars actually affect the decision and which are just nearby.
IROSOpenNav: Open-World Navigation with Multimodal Large Language ModelsRobots can't follow natural language directions to places that don't match the preset motion commands they know.
IROSBEVPointNet3D: Fusing Bird's Eye View and Point Cloud Features for Robust 3D Lane DetectionDetecting lane lines in 3D fails on hills and steep terrain because methods assume flat ground and ignore what the LiDAR point cloud tells you about height.
IROSIndustrial-Grade Sensor Simulation via Gaussian Splatting: A Modular Framework for Scalable Editing and Full-Stack ValidationCamera and LiDAR simulations based on neural networks render slowly and you can't easily edit the scene, making it hard to test self-driving cars at scale.
IROSSimpler Is Better: Revisiting Doppler Velocity for Enhanced Moving Object Tracking with FMCW LiDARLiDAR sensors can tell when an object is moving toward or away from you (Doppler effect), but existing tracking methods don't use this information effectively.
IROSClass-Aware PillarMix: Can Mixed Sample Data Augmentation Enhance 3D Object Detection with Radar Point Clouds?Methods that mix radar data points to create more training examples don't work well because radars spread points unevenly and small objects get lost in the mix.
IROSCalibMutiL: Online Calibration Of LiDAR-Camera Based On Multi-level Visual Feature FusionWhen online, fixing the angle and position between a laser scanner and camera does not work well across different scenes because single-level features do not have enough detail.

Decide what to do

Language models that plan the job 54 papers

The problem

People give robots open-ended goals in plain language, but older planners could not handle that flexibility, writing out every step by hand is fragile, and language-model planners tend to chase finishing the job while ignoring safety.

The approaches

Use the same kind of AI that powers chatbots (large language models) to break a spoken goal into an ordered list of robot steps. The plans are not trusted directly; the AI must write them in a strict, checkable form, each step is tested to make sure it is physically doable, and the plan is checked against safety rules before the robot acts.

How it solves it

The AI supplies the flexible understanding of the goal while the strict checking catches its mistakes and unsafe steps before the robot acts on them.

Turning seeing-and-talking AI into doing AI 85 papers

The problem

The big AI models that can look at a scene and describe it in words cannot actually move a robot, and they are weak at judging distance and 3D layout.

The approaches

Retrain these models so their output is robot movements, not just words (vision-language-action models), sharpen their sense of depth and space, let them keep improving by trial and error on the robot, and point them at concrete jobs like handing over surgical tools or following spoken directions.

How it solves it

It keeps the model's broad grasp of scenes and words but adds the missing ability to act and to reason about real 3D space.

Getting several robots to work together 145 papers

The problem

A team of different robots doing a long shared job is much harder to coordinate than one robot, and simple automatic planning falls apart at that scale, especially for swarms of drones holding formation while dodging obstacles.

The approaches

Language-model planning that hands out jobs across the team but is checked against real physical limits; keeping robots in sight of one another; sharing location information; learning to hold formation while avoiding moving obstacles; and having the team reorganize itself when one robot breaks.

How it solves it

Grounding the plan in real limits keeps the team's plan achievable, and self-reorganizing keeps the mission going after a failure.

Move the body

Teaching legs and humanoids to move 271 papers

The problem

Legged and human-shaped robots need to walk, balance, climb, and stay steady without an engineer hand-designing a target for every task, they waste energy, and a skill learned inside a computer often fails on the real machine because of small unmodeled things like joint friction.

The approaches

Train the robot inside a computer copy of the world and then get it to still work on the real machine (sim-to-real); build one flexible controller that handles many tasks; give the robot an inner guess of what it will feel next; reuse the robot's own natural swing to save energy; and pin down the hidden real-world troubles that break computer-trained walkers.

How it solves it

Practicing in a computer is fast and free, one shared controller cuts per-task hand-tuning, the inner guess keeps the robot steadier, and closing the hidden gaps lets the learned skill survive on real ground.
