ICRA3cCage: Causal Attention Enables Data-Efficient Generalizable Robotic ManipulationRobot manipulation policies that learn from demonstrations fail in new environments when they have seen only a small number of examples and the visual surroundings look very different.
ICRA3cHSRL: A Hierarchical Control System Based on Spiking Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robot NavigationNavigating through busy real-world spaces requires making fast, smooth decisions even when the robot cannot see the full scene, which standard AI controllers handle poorly.
ICRA3cNaviDiffusor: Cost-Guided Diffusion Model for Visual NavigationNavigation systems either need retraining to work in new places, or rely on hand-written rules that break down in varied conditions.
ICRA3cGoal-Guided Reinforcement Learning: Leveraging Large Language Models for Long-Horizon Task DecompositionTeaching a robot through trial and error is very slow when a task requires many steps in the right order, because randomly exploring a large space of possible actions rarely hits on a good sequence.
ICRA3cTransformerMPC: Accelerating Model Predictive Control via TransformersModel predictive control (MPC) — a method that repeatedly solves an optimization problem to pick the next robot action — is slow because it checks every possible constraint at every step, even when most constraints are not relevant.
IROS3cMamba Policy: Towards Efficient 3D Diffusion Policy with Hybrid Selective State Models3D robot manipulation models based on diffusion have very large neural network backbones that make them too slow and memory-hungry for practical deployment.
IROS3cZero-Shot Semantic Segmentation for Robots in AgricultureLabeling crop and weed pixels in field images by hand is expensive, yet robots need to tell them apart to remove weeds without training data.
IROS3cBuilding Knowledge from Interactions: An LLM-Based Architecture for Adaptive Tutoring and Social ReasoningRobots using AI language models forget what they learned in past talks, so they can't give personalized tutoring or coaching because they lose context.
IROS3cFlowMP: Learning Motion Fields for Robot Planning with Conditional Flow MatchingAI planners that learn smooth robot paths by gradually refining a random starting path often produce jerky motions because they only model position, not how position changes over time.
IROS3cContext-Aware Deep Lagrangian Networks for Model Predictive ControlRobot arms that lift different objects need to adjust their model of how physics works, but one model cannot handle all kinds of loads.
IROS3cHierarchical Decision-Making for Autonomous Navigation: Integrating Deep Reinforcement Learning and Fuzzy Logic in Four-Wheel Independent Steering and Driving SystemsFour-wheel steering vehicles are hard to control autonomously because pure learning methods cannot guarantee safe wheel motions that avoid slippage and damage.
IROS3cMotionScript: Natural Language Descriptions for Expressive 3D Human MotionsVideo datasets of human motion use vague or generic labels that miss the subtle style and feeling of how someone moves.
ICRA2cSAS-Prompt: Large Language Models as Numerical Optimizers for Robot Self-ImprovementImproving a robot's skill at a task like table tennis normally requires a lot of hand-tuning or large amounts of labeled training data.
ICRA2cGeneralizable Imitation Learning Through Pre-Trained RepresentationsA robot trained to copy human actions from video fails when the object looks different — different color, texture, or lighting — even if the task is the same.
ICRA2cDeformpam: Data-Efficient Learning for Long-Horizon Deformable Object Manipulation Via Preference-Based Action AlignmentGetting a robot to handle flexible objects like cloth or rope through many steps is hard because errors build up over time and collecting enough training data is expensive.
ICRA2cInstance Segmentation-Based Hazard Detection with Lunar South Pole LightingAt the lunar south pole, sunlight hits the ground at an extremely low angle, casting long shadows that make it very hard for a rover's camera to spot dangerous rocks.
ICRA2cBayesian Optimal Experimental Design for Robot Kinematic CalibrationMeasuring and correcting small geometric errors in a robot arm's joints requires many careful measurements, which is slow and resource-intensive.
ICRA2cA Hybrid Approach to Indoor Social Navigation: Integrating Reactive Local Planning and Proactive Global PlanningA service robot moving through a busy building needs to plan a long route while also dodging people who step into its path unpredictably, and no single method handles both well.
ICRA2cExtended Friction Models for the Physics Simulation of Servo ActuatorsStandard friction models in robot simulators do not capture how servo motors actually resist motion, so robots trained or tested in simulation behave differently when run on real hardware.
ICRA2cFrom Cognition to Precognition: A Future-Aware Framework for Social NavigationA mobile robot moving through a crowd can cause near-misses and slowdowns because it only reacts to where people are right now, not where they are about to be.
ICRA2cSpace-Aware Instruction Tuning: Dataset and Benchmark for Guide Dog Robots Assisting the Visually ImpairedAI vision models that generate spoken guidance for blind users give bad directions because they do not reliably understand three-dimensional space — they confuse left/right, near/far, and other spatial relationships.
ICRA2cFast Policy Synthesis with Variable Noise Diffusion ModelsRobot policies that use diffusion models — which generate actions by slowly refining random noise — are too slow to produce actions in real time because they need many processing steps per action.
ICRA2cThe Mini Wheelbot: A Testbed for Learning-based Balancing, Flips, and Articulated DrivingSmall, unstable, one-wheeled robots are useful for studying learning-based control, but there is no compact hardware platform that can automatically reset itself after falling so that training can run without human help.
ICRA2cPTQ4RIS: Post-Training Quantization for Referring Image SegmentationImage segmentation models that respond to text descriptions are too large and slow to run on small edge devices, and the usual method for shrinking them (reducing number precision) causes a big drop in accuracy.
ICRA2cNeuro-Symbolic Imitation Learning: Discovering Symbolic Abstractions for Skill Learning ↗Imitation learning methods teach robots short individual skills but have no way to chain those skills together into long multi-step tasks.
ICRA2cMILE: Model-Based Intervention LearningTeaching a robot by having a human take over the controls now and then wastes all the useful information contained in the moments when the human chose NOT to take over.
ICRA2cLaMOT: Language-Guided Multi-Object TrackingThere was no standard way to track multiple objects using free-text descriptions of each target, and no large dataset to develop or test such a system.
ICRA2cMonoDiff9D: Monocular Category-Level 9D Object Pose Estimation via Diffusion Model ↗Figuring out the exact position, orientation, and size of an object from a single regular camera — without a CAD model or known shape — is very hard because one image does not give direct depth information.
ICRA2cPhysPart: Physically Plausible Part Completion for Interactable ObjectsGenerating the missing geometry of an object part — like a drawer or a hinge — requires the result to fit precisely and also move correctly, which purely shape-focused generators do not guarantee.
ICRA2cAutonomous Wheel Loader Navigation Using Goal-Conditioned Actor-Critic MPCWheel loaders that use separate planning and control layers to reach a target position are slower than needed because the two layers are not designed together.
ICRA2cIntegrating Model-Based Control and RL for Sim2Real Transfer of Tight Insertion PoliciesGetting a robot to push a peg into a hole with sub-millimeter accuracy is too precise for pure reinforcement learning to learn reliably and then work on a real robot.
ICRA2cGesturing Towards Efficient Robot Control: Exploring Sensor Placement and Control Modes for Mid-Air Human-Robot InteractionControlling a robot with mid-air hand gestures requires knowing which sensor location and which control style — moving your hand to a position versus sweeping it to set a speed — actually works best.
ICRA2cVisual-Based Forklift Learning System Enabling Zero-Shot Sim2Real Without Real-World DataTeaching a forklift to pick up pallets automatically is risky to do on real hardware, and there is no safe way to collect training data without actually running the forklift.
ICRA2cRipGAN: A GAN-Based Rip Current Data Augmentation MethodAutomatically detecting rip currents in beach video is limited by the small number of labeled images available, because labeling them requires expert knowledge and is expensive.
ICRA2cSCA3D: Enhancing Cross-Modal 3D Retrieval via 3D Shape and Caption Paired Data AugmentationFinding a 3D shape that matches a text description is hard because there are very few examples of 3D shapes paired with text descriptions to train on.
ICRA2cRetrieval-Augmented Hierarchical in-Context Reinforcement Learning and Hindsight Modular Reflections for Task Planning with LLMsAI agents using large language models (LLMs) have a hard time planning long sequences of steps because they waste effort reviewing entire past attempts and cannot reuse what they learned before.
ICRA2cDiffusion-Based Self-Supervised Imitation Learning from Imperfect Visual Servoing Demonstrations for Robotic Glass InstallationInstalling heavy glass panels with a robot requires very precise movements, but the demonstration data collected by having the robot follow visual cues is noisy and inconsistent.
ICRA2cRaggeDi: Diffusion-Based State Estimation of Disordered Rags, Sheets, Towels and BlanketsFiguring out the exact shape of a crumpled piece of cloth is very hard because cloth can fold in countless ways and hide parts of itself.
ICRA2cDiverse Motion Planning with Stein Diffusion Trajectory InferenceWhen multiple valid paths exist for a robot arm, standard planners tend to find just one and get stuck if it is blocked, missing other good options.
ICRA2cMiniVLN: Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation by Progressive Knowledge DistillationThe best navigation models that follow spoken or written instructions are too large and slow to run on small robots with limited computing power.
IROS2cArc-Length-Based Warping for Robot Skill Synthesis from Multiple DemonstrationsWhen a person teaches a robot by physically guiding it through a motion, pauses and speed changes make the recorded paths hard to combine consistently using standard time-based alignment methods.
IROS2cMarineGym: A High-Performance Reinforcement Learning Platform for Underwater RoboticsTraining underwater robot controllers by trial and error is slow because existing simulators are too slow and there is no standard set of tasks to compare results.
IROS2cM2P2: A Multi-Modal Passive Perception Dataset for Off-Road Mobility in Extreme Low-Light ConditionsOff-road robots need to see in complete darkness, but standard cameras fail and active sensors like radar or headlights reveal the robot's position, which isn't always acceptable.
IROS2cLuSeg: Efficient Negative and Positive Obstacles Segmentation via Contrast-Driven Multi-Modal Feature Fusion on the LunarA lunar rover needs to spot both raised rocks and sunken craters in real time from camera and depth data, but no dataset or model existed for this task.
IROS2cDiffGen: Robot Demonstration Generation via Differentiable Physics Simulation, Differentiable Rendering, and Vision-Language ModelGetting large numbers of robot manipulation demonstrations from simulation either needs a lot of trial-and-error training or requires someone to hand-write reward functions describing what success looks like.
IROS2cAdvancing Object-Goal Navigation through LLM-enhanced Object Affinities TransferRobots trained to find objects in one set of rooms fail in new rooms because simple rules about which objects appear near each other don't hold up and learned rules overfit to training rooms.
IROS2cIDAGC: Adaptive Generalized Human-Robot Collaboration via Human Intent Estimation and Multimodal Policy LearningHuman-robot collaboration systems were locked into one fixed mode and could not switch on their own between physical hand-over-hand work and remote guidance.
IROS2cMORE: Mobile Manipulation Rearrangement Through Grounded Language ReasoningWhen a robot uses a large language model to plan how to move objects around a room, the plan gets less reliable as the number of objects grows because the model loses track of what is where.
IROS2cAdapting Robot's Explanation for Failures Based on Observed Human Behavior in Human-Robot CollaborationWhen a robot explains why it failed, giving the same level of detail to everyone wastes time for people who already understand and leaves confused people still confused.
IROS2cG3 CN: Gaussian Topology Refinement Gated Graph Convolutional Network for Skeleton-Based Action RecognitionTelling apart similar actions (like two different dance moves with the same pose) from skeleton positions alone is hard because the graph structure connecting bones gets muddled by noise and ambiguity.
IROS2cMALMM: Multi-Agent Large Language Models for Zero-Shot Robotic ManipulationA language model telling a robot what to do for a long task often makes mistakes and makes up things that don't work, and it can't fix problems partway through.
IROS2cMAER-Nav: Bidirectional Motion Learning Through Mirror-Augmented Experience Replay for Robot NavigationRobots trained with deep reinforcement learning can only drive forward and get stuck in tight spaces because they never learned to back up.
IROS2cEmpirical Analysis of Sim-and-Real Cotraining of Diffusion Policies For Planar Pushing from PixelsIt's unclear how much fake simulation data, how good the simulation looks, and how different the simulation is from real life affect learning to push objects.
IROS2cSocially-Aware Robot Navigation Enhanced by Bidirectional Natural Language Conversations Using Large Language ModelsRobots avoid people in crowds but can't talk to explain where they're going or ask people to move.
IROS2cVLM Can Be a Good Assistant: Enhancing Embodied Visual Tracking with Self-Improving Vision-Language ModelsRobots tracking a moving target lose it and can't recover because they don't understand space well enough and can't learn from mistakes.
ICRA1cHri-Free: Cognitive Robotic Simulation for Evaluating Embodied Social Attention ModelsTesting whether a robot pays attention to the right people and things normally requires running live experiments with human participants, which is slow and expensive.
ICRA1cShadow Program Inversion with Differentiable Planning: A Framework for Unified Robot Program Parameter and Trajectory OptimizationTuning a robot program means adjusting both high-level settings (like timing or distances) and the exact motion path at the same time, but no optimizer can do both together using gradients.
ICRA1cA Reinforcement Learning-Based Social Robot for Personalized Learning in Children with AutismTeaching imitation skills to children with autism is hard because every child responds differently, so a one-size teaching plan often fails.
ICRA1cLearning Task Specifications from Demonstrations as Probabilistic AutomataProgramming a robot to follow a long multi-step task is tedious, and it is even harder to capture the order in which steps should happen just by watching someone do the task.
ICRA1cRobot Planning Under Uncertainty for Object Assembly and Troubleshooting Using Human Causal ModelsWhen a robot can only see part of a scene, it needs good prior knowledge about how parts connect to avoid wasting time on wrong guesses during assembly or repair.
ICRA1cIncremental Few-Shot Adaptation for Non-Prehensile Object Manipulation Using Parallelizable Physics SimulatorsPushing and sliding objects without gripping them requires knowing how each object moves, but writing those physics rules by hand for every new object is slow and error-prone.
ICRA1cFostering Trust Through Gesture and Voice-Controlled Robot Trajectories in Industrial Human-Robot Collaboration ↗Factory workers without robotics training find it hard and mentally taxing to guide a robot's exact path using a standard teach pendant during maintenance tasks.
ICRA1cLearning Dynamic Weight Adjustment for Spatial-Temporal Trajectory Planning in Crowd NavigationA robot navigating through crowds needs to balance being safe (staying away from people) with being efficient (moving quickly), but fixed tradeoff settings work well only for some crowd densities and fail for others.
ICRA1cTowards Effective Utilization of Mixed-Quality Demonstrations in Robotic Manipulation via Segment-Level Selection and OptimizationWhen a robot learns from recorded human demonstrations, poor-quality segments mixed in with good ones hurt what the robot learns.
ICRA1cRobo-DM: Data Management for Large Robot DatasetsLarge robot datasets that mix video, sensor numbers, and text are slow to store, transfer, and load during training, which slows down research.
ICRA1cLearning Object Properties Using Robot Proprioception via Differentiable Robot-Object InteractionFiguring out the physical properties of an object a robot is touching — like how heavy or springy it is — usually requires cameras or extra sensors that aren't always present.
ICRA1cDeep Learning-Based Friction Compensation in Low Velocity for Enhanced Direct Teaching in Collaborative ManipulatorsWhen a person physically guides a robot arm to teach it a motion, friction in the joints at slow speeds makes the arm feel sticky and the recorded path inaccurate.
ICRA1cOptimizing Underwater Robot Navigation: A Study of DRL Algorithms and Multi-Modal Sensor FusionUnderwater robots have trouble navigating reliably in 3D space because they cannot locate themselves well and visibility is poor.
ICRA1cSocial-MAE: Social Masked Autoencoder for Multi-Person Motion Representation LearningTeaching a model to understand how groups of people move together is hard when labeled training data is scarce.
ICRA1cROS2WASM: Bringing the Robot Operating System to the WebRunning ROS 2 — the standard software platform for robot programming — requires a complex local install that is hard to share, reproduce, or use in a classroom.
ICRA1cSEAL: A Sample-Efficient Adjustment-Learning Method for Table Tennis Robot ServeTeaching a robot to serve a table tennis ball to any spot on the table requires collecting a large number of training examples, which is time-consuming and impractical.
ICRA1cPoints2Plans: From Point Clouds to Long-Horizon Plans with Composable Relational DynamicsRobots given a verbal instruction need to carry out many steps in sequence using only a partial 3D scan of the scene, which requires connecting low-level sensor data to high-level task reasoning.
ICRA1cAutomated Hybrid Reward Scheduling Via Large Language Models for Robotic Skill LearningTraining a robot with multiple reward signals (e.g., one for speed, one for balance) works poorly when all signals are added together with fixed equal weight, because some matter more at different stages of learning.
ICRA1cTREND: Tri-Teaching for Robust Preference-based Reinforcement Learning with DemonstrationsTeaching a robot using human comparisons (which of two behaviors is better) works poorly when many of the comparisons are wrong or inconsistent, which is common when humans or automated raters label large amounts of data.
ICRA1cDynamic Non-Prehensile Object Transport via Model-Predictive Reinforcement LearningTeaching a robot arm to carry an object on a tray without gripping it — like a waiter — is hard when you only have a small number of real-world demonstrations and no computer model of the physics.
ICRA1cGPU-Accelerated Subsystem-Based ADMM for Large-Scale Interactive SimulationSimulating the physics of many interacting objects at once accurately is too slow to run in real time on current hardware.
ICRA1cAgile Mobility with Rapid Online Adaptation via Meta-Learning and Uncertainty-Aware MPPIFast wheeled robots need physics models that match how the robot actually moves right now, but conditions like tire wear or surface friction change constantly and differ across robot types.
ICRA1cSystematic Comparison of Projection Methods for Monocular 3D Human Pose Estimation on Fisheye ImagesWide-angle fisheye cameras distort images so much that standard pose estimation methods trained on normal cameras fail to correctly find human body positions, and nobody had compared the available fix methods head to head.
ICRA1cOne-Shot Imitation Under Mismatched ExecutionTeaching a robot by showing it one human video fails when the robot and human move differently, and collecting matched pairs of human and robot videos doing the same task is too expensive.
ICRA1cLearning-Based Dynamic Robot-to-Human HandoverRobot handover policies that assume the person is standing still produce slow and awkward handoffs when the person is moving.
ICRA1cInducing Matrix Sparsity Bias for Improved Dynamic Identification of Parallel Kinematic Manipulators using Deep LearningFiguring out the physical parameters (masses, inertias) of a Delta-style parallel robot arm from motion data is inaccurate with standard neural networks because they ignore what is already known about the robot's structure.
ICRA1cA Modeling and Control Strategy for the Gaze-Guided Teleoperation of Robotic Manipulators via Smart GlassesPeople who cannot use their arms need to control robot arms with only their eyes, but raw eye-gaze signals are too shaky and noisy to guide a robot reliably.
ICRA1cEnhanced View Planning for Robotic Harvesting: Tackling Occlusions with Imitation Learning ↗Fruit-picking robots often can't see the target crop clearly because leaves or other fruit are in the way.
ICRA1cKnowledge-Driven Visual Target Navigation: Dual Graph NavigationFinding a specific object in an unknown indoor space requires reasoning about where things tend to be, but most methods either need detailed maps or are too slow for low-power devices.
ICRA1cRouting Manipulation of Deformable Linear Object Using Reinforcement Learning and Diffusion PolicyThreading a rope through a series of holes is tricky because the rope is flexible and the friction between the rope and the surface changes in ways the robot cannot measure.
ICRA1cOmniShape: Zero-Shot Multi-Hypothesis Shape and Pose Estimation in the Real WorldFiguring out the full 3D shape and orientation of an unknown object from a single camera view — with no prior information about what the object looks like — is an unsolved problem.
ICRA1cFlora: Sample-Efficient Preference-Based Rl Via Low-Rank Style Adaptation of Reward FunctionsTeaching a robot to match a person's style preferences — using only a few comparison labels — tends to break the reward function the robot was already trained on.
ICRA1cReinforcement Learning on Reconfigurable Hardware: Overcoming Material Variability in Laser Material Processing ↗Laser welding quality drops when the metal surface is rougher or smoother than expected, and existing automated systems cannot adapt in real time on physical hardware.
ICRA1cThe Radiance of Neural Fields: Democratizing Photorealistic and Dynamic Robotic SimulationRobot simulators that look realistic enough to train vision-based navigation policies are hard to build, and existing ones use fake-looking humans on scripted paths rather than realistic crowds.
ICRA1cOptimizing Complex Control Systems with Differentiable Simulators: A Hybrid Approach to Reinforcement Learning and Trajectory PlanningTraining a robot with reinforcement learning on high-dimensional tasks takes a very long time because the agent wastes many trials exploring bad actions and ignores the gradient signals that a physics simulator can provide.
ICRA1cData-Efficient Learning from Human Interventions for Mobile RobotsTraining a robot to navigate reliably needs a lot of human demonstrations, which takes a long time and a lot of effort to collect.
ICRA1cA Helping (Human) Hand in Kinematic Structure Estimation ↗Figuring out how an object's parts move relative to each other — for example, how a drawer slides — is very hard when the robot's camera view is partly blocked or the object has little texture.
ICRA1cXMoP: Whole-Body Control Policy for Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Neural Motion PlanningMotion-planning networks trained for one robot arm fail when used on a different arm with different joints or degrees of freedom.
ICRA1cM2Distill: Multi-Modal Distillation for Lifelong Imitation LearningWhen a robot learns new manipulation tasks one after another, it tends to forget how to do earlier tasks because learning new tasks shifts the internal representations it built up before.
ICRA1cSubassembly to Full Assembly: Effective Assembly Sequence Planning Through Graph-Based Reinforcement LearningDeciding in what order to put together many parts is very hard because the number of possible orderings explodes as the part count grows.
ICRA1cSALON: Self-supervised Adaptive Learning for Off-road NavigationOff-road robots struggle to navigate new terrain types because they would normally need large amounts of labeled data collected on each new terrain.
ICRA1cImpedance Primitive-Augmented Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Sequential TasksTeaching a robot to do a series of contact tasks (like pushing and then turning a valve) requires both careful force control and the ability to string steps together, and both are hard to learn at once.
ICRA1cEmbodiment-agnostic Action Planning via Object-Part Scene FlowRobot movement policies are almost always built for one specific robot body and cannot use videos of humans doing the same task as training data.
ICRA1cBack to the Cartesian: Pilot Study for Assessing Human Stiffness in 3D Cartesian Space by Transforming from Muscle Space in a Peg-In-Hole Scenario for Tele-ImpedanceRemote-control systems that copy a human arm's stiffness to a robot arm could not yet measure that stiffness in full 3D space.
ICRA1cComponent-Aware Unsupervised Logical Anomaly Generation for Industrial Anomaly DetectionTeaching a machine to spot logical defects in factory parts — like a screw in the wrong place — is hard because real defective samples are rare and existing tools produce fake-looking examples.
ICRA1cThe Influence of Counterbalance System on the Dynamic Characterization of Heavy Industrial Robots ↗When measuring the physical properties of heavy industrial robot arms to improve their accuracy, engineers forgot to account for the built-in spring-and-gas system that helps lift the arm, so the calculated joint forces came out wrong.
ICRA1cSkills Made to Order: Efficient Acquisition of Robot Cooking Skills Guided by Multiple Forms of Internet DataTeaching a robot contact-heavy cooking skills like stirring or cutting is hard because internet videos show what people do but not the forces and touches the robot needs to reproduce the action.
ICRA1cMJPR: Multi-Modal Joint Predictive Representation in Deep Reinforcement LearningRobots or agents that learn from multiple sensor types (like camera and touch) are slow to learn because existing methods do not make each sensor type fill in what the others miss.
ICRA1cHierarchical Visual Policy Learning for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation in Densely Cluttered ScenesPacking objects in a crowded scene requires many steps in sequence, and objects block each other's view, making it hard for a learning algorithm to figure out which action to take and when.
ICRA1cInference-Time Policy Steering Through Human InteractionsOnce a generative robot policy is trained, there is no good way for a person to steer it toward a specific sub-goal during a task without breaking what the policy learned.
ICRA1cNeural Dynamics Augmented Diffusion PolicyTeaching a robot to manipulate objects by copying expert demonstrations requires many demonstrations to cover all the ways objects might be arranged, which is expensive to collect.
ICRA1cLearning From Imperfect Demonstrations With Self-Supervision for Robotic ManipulationTeaching robots by copying human demonstrations typically throws away failed attempts, wasting the partial useful information they contain, while reinforcement learning alternatives need reward signals that are hard to define for real tasks.
ICRA1cDark-DENet: A Lightweight Enhancement Network for Low-Light Object DetectionObject detectors miss or misidentify things when the scene is dark, which is a common problem for robots working in dim environments.
ICRA1cFoundation Feature-Driven Online End-Effector Pose Estimation: A Marker-Free and Learning-Free ApproachFiguring out the exact position and angle of a robot's hand in camera images normally requires either sticking markers on the hand or training a model for each robot type, both of which are impractical in practice.
ICRA1cEnergy Efficient Planning for Repetitive Heterogeneous Tasks in Precision AgricultureA farm robot that must first look at a patch and then act on it (e.g., spot then remove weeds) needs to plan many such observe-then-act cycles under a battery limit, and the weed locations are not known in advance.
ICRA1cCTSAC: Curriculum-Based Transformer Soft Actor-Critic for Goal-Oriented Robot ExplorationReinforcement learning for robot exploration learns slowly, forgets earlier skills as it learns new ones, and the behaviors that work in simulation often break down on a real robot.
ICRA1cDepth Restoration of Hand-Held Transparent Objects for Human-to-Robot HandoverDepth cameras cannot measure the distance to transparent objects accurately, and the problem gets worse when a hand is also blocking part of the view.
ICRA1cLeveraging LLMs for Mission Planning in Precision AgricultureFarmers or field workers without coding skills cannot easily tell an autonomous agricultural robot to carry out a multi-step data collection task.
IROS1cScalable Learning of High-Dimensional Demonstrations with Composition of Linear Parameter Varying Dynamical SystemsTeaching a robot arm a motion by showing it examples requires fitting a math model to the demonstrations, but the standard fitting method becomes too slow and unreliable when the motion involves many joint angles at once.
IROS1cDeep Reinforcement Learning-Based Trajectory Tracking Framework for 4WS Robots Considering Switch of Steering ModesRobots where all four wheels steer independently need to switch between different steering patterns (such as crab-walk or spin-in-place) while following a path in tight spaces, and no existing controller handles this automatically.
IROS1cFLAME: A Federated Learning Benchmark for Robotic ManipulationTeaching robot arms using data spread across many separate sites — without sharing the raw data for privacy reasons — has no standard dataset or test setup to measure progress.
IROS1cThe Impact of Autonomy Levels and System Errors on Cognitive Load and Trust in Human-Robot Collaborative TasksIt is not known how often a robot arm makes mistakes before operators stop trusting it and become mentally overloaded.
IROS1cLarge Language Model-Based Robot Task Planning from Voice Command TranscriptionsA service robot needs to turn spoken commands into step-by-step actions, but speech recognition makes mistakes and commands often leave out details the robot needs.
IROS1cMulti-Agent Inverse Reinforcement Learning in Real World Unstructured Pedestrian CrowdsLearning what motivates people to move the way they do in dense crowds requires solving a math problem that grows unmanageable when many people interact at once.
IROS1cMetaFold: Language-Guided Multi-Category Garment Folding Framework via Trajectory Generation and Foundation ModelA robot that can fold many different types of clothes needs to understand both what the user wants and how the fabric will move, which is very hard to handle with one model.
IROS1cRH20T-P: A Primitive-Level Robotic Manipulation Dataset towards Composable Generalization Agents in Real-world ScenariosRobots cannot reliably combine basic motion skills into new multi-step tasks because there is no large labeled dataset that breaks manipulation actions into well-defined primitive steps.
IROS1cDynamic Modeling and Efficient Data-Driven Optimal Control for Micro Autonomous Surface VehiclesSmall autonomous boats are hard to steer accurately because their motion through water is complex and they are easily pushed off course by currents and waves.
IROS1cBody-Hand Modality Expertized Networks with Cross-attention for Fine-grained Skeleton Action Recognition ↗Action recognition from skeleton data misses fine hand movements because the signal from coarse body motion dominates when hands and body are processed together in one network.
IROS1cAdaptive Manipulation using Behavior TreesSome manipulation tasks, like tightening a valve until it stops, depend on feel rather than sight, so a robot cannot know in advance which strategy to use or when to switch.
IROS1cLearning Goal-Directed Object Pushing in Cluttered Scenes With Location-Based Attention ↗Pushing an object to a specific goal position and orientation while avoiding other objects in the way requires thinking many steps ahead, which is hard to learn without a pre-planned route.
IROS1cMake Your AUV Adaptive: An Environment-Aware Reinforcement Learning Framework For Underwater TasksUnderwater robots trained with standard reinforcement learning struggle when water currents change because the training never explicitly fed current conditions into the decision-making.
IROS1cTransformer-Based Spatio-Temporal Association of Apple FruitletsTracking tiny apple buds across photos taken on different days from different angles is very hard because the buds are small, look alike, and do not photograph cleanly in 3D.
IROS1cDyna-LfLH: Learning Agile Navigation in Dynamic Environments from Learned HallucinationIt's hard to train robots to move through rooms with lots of moving things because old planning math doesn't work and you need tons of real examples to learn.
IROS1cFlowNav: Combining Flow Matching and Depth Priors for Efficient NavigationNavigation models using diffusion (a slow guess-and-refine method) take too long to run on real robots and don't understand the scene well enough.
IROS1cEnhancing Context-Aware Human Motion Prediction for Efficient Robot Handovers ↗The best models that guess what a human will do next are so complex that robots can't run them fast enough to hand over objects in real time.
IROS1cVerifyLLM: LLM-Based Pre-Execution Task Plan Verification for RobotsWhen a language model writes a step-by-step plan for a robot, the plan can have logical gaps or wrong order of steps that only become obvious when the robot fails mid-task.
IROS1cThe Impact of VR and 2D Interfaces on Human Feedback in Preference-Based Robot LearningWhen training a robot by asking people which of two robot behaviors they prefer, it is not known whether the interface people use — a VR headset versus a flat 2D screen — changes the quality of their answers or the behavior the robot learns.
IROS1cUF-RNN: Real-Time Adaptive Motion Generation Using Uncertainty-Driven Foresight PredictionA robot trained only on successful examples has no idea what to do when it gets into an unusual or uncertain situation, because it was never trained on failures.
IROS1cToSA: Token Merging with Spatial AwarenessVision models (Vision Transformers) speed up by grouping similar image patches together, but early in the network the patches don't yet carry meaningful content, so grouping by similarity alone loses spatial structure and degrades understanding.
IROS1cDiffusion-Based Approximate MPC: Fast and Consistent Imitation of Multi-Modal Action DistributionsWhen a neural network tries to copy a motion planner by minimizing average error, it blurs together multiple valid solutions and picks none of them well.
IROS1cNon-differentiable Reward Optimization for Diffusion-based Autonomous Motion PlanningMotion planners that learn by copying example paths are not directly trained to avoid collisions or reach goals, so they can generate paths that look plausible but are actually unsafe.
IROS1cElastic Motion Policy: An Adaptive Dynamical System for Robust and Efficient One-Shot Imitation LearningTeaching a robot arm from examples usually needs many demonstrations, and the robot still fails when the scene changes or someone bumps it.
IROS1cDiff-IP2D: Diffusion-Based Hand-Object Interaction Prediction on Egocentric VideosPredicting where hands will move and which parts of objects they will touch, one step at a time, causes errors to pile up over time.
IROS1cLS-HAR: Language Supervised Human Action Recognition with Salient Fusion, Construction Sites as a Use-CaseRecognizing what workers are doing on a construction site is hard for robots because combining skeleton data with video is complex and there is very little labeled training data for that setting.
IROS1cCost Function Estimation Using Inverse Reinforcement Learning with Minimal ObservationsTeaching a robot what to optimize by watching a human do a task requires many demonstrations and is slow to converge.
IROS1cRobust Instant Policy: Leveraging Student's t-Regression Model for Robust In-context Imitation Learning of Robot ManipulationWhen a language model is used to generate robot motion trajectories by looking at a few demonstrations, it sometimes produces completely wrong trajectories that ruin the task.
IROS1cUncertainty-Aware Knowledge Distillation for Compact and Efficient 6DoF Pose Estimation ↗Estimating the exact position and orientation of an object in 3D with a small, fast model is hard because small models lose accuracy compared to large ones.
IROS1cMicrofluidics-Based Analysis of Controlled Mixing and Bubble Formation in Soda Solutions for EducationStudents studying fluid behavior at the microscale have few affordable, hands-on experiments that let them see and measure how fluids mix and bubbles form in tiny channels.
IROS1cLearning Generalizable 3D Manipulation With 10 DemonstrationsTeaching a robot to pick something up by showing it a few examples only works if the object is in exactly the same place; move the object and the robot fails because it only memorized those specific positions.
IROS1c3D Hierarchical Panoptic Segmentation in Real Orchard Environments Across Different SensorsCounting fruit in an orchard from 3D sensors is hard because you need to know what things are (fruit or branches), which fruit belongs to which tree, and the data comes from different kinds of sensors.
IROS1cPlanning under Uncertainty from Behaviour Trees ↗Robot decision plans written by hand experts fail because they don't account for small errors adding up over time and making choices less effective.
IROS1cSocial Robot Haru Assisting Dynamic Group Discussion with Autonomous Eye Gaze BehaviorSocial robots cannot look at the right person or know when to speak in a multi-person conversation.
IROS1cRecoveryChaining: Learning Local Recovery Policies for Robust ManipulationRobot manipulation plans fail when the real robot shakes, doesn't see things clearly, or behaves slightly differently than expected, and there's no way to recover when plans go wrong.
IROS1cAction Tokenizer Matters in In-Context Imitation Learning ↗Compressing robot actions into codes for learning from examples makes moves jerky and creates shakes when the robot runs them.
IROS1cEnhancing Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Robot Navigation Generalization through Scenario AugmentationRobots trained in one environment fail in new environments because they memorized that specific setting instead of learning general navigation rules.
IROS1cMaskSem: Semantic-Guided Masking for Learning 3D Hybrid High-Order Motion RepresentationTeaching systems to recognize human actions from skeleton data learn only simple speed patterns and ignore the most important body parts.
IROS1cDesign and Development of the MeCO Open-Source Autonomous Underwater VehicleUnderwater robot research is limited because good research submarines cost too much and most aren't open for people to modify.
IROS1cOne-Shot Robust Imitation Learning for Long-Horizon Visuomotor Tasks from Unsegmented DemonstrationsTeaching robots long multi-step tasks needs lots of pre-split videos and the robot falls apart if things get pushed or hidden.
IROS1c3D-MoRe: Unified Modal-Contextual Reasoning for Embodied Question AnsweringBuilding big datasets of 3D room scenes with written questions and descriptions costs a lot of time and money to do by hand.
IROS1cEdit Distance Based Intention Estimation for Teleoperated AssemblyWhen a human is steering a robot to put together parts, figuring out what they're trying to do is hard when they make mistakes or the system misunderstands their moves.
IROS1cA Probabilistic Programming Approach to Intention Estimation in Human-Robot Teleoperated Assembly TasksWhen task instructions change, the system has to be retrained, which costs time and money and requires collecting and labeling lots of videos.
IROS1cHAPI: A Model for Learning Robot Facial Expressions from Human PreferencesRobot faces either have stiff preset expressions or fake-looking computer-made ones that don't match what humans find realistic or likable.
IROS1cMuSPaCSA: Multi-Scale Parallel-Channel Self-Attention Network for Point Cloud Classification and SegmentationNew attention-based methods for 3D point clouds are slow and can't easily adapt to different viewing distances.
IROS1cSAVR: Scooping Adaptation for Variable food properties via Reinforcement LearningRobot feeding must pick the right amount from foods that vary wildly in texture and stickiness; fixed robot movements don't work for all foods.
IROS1cManipulate-To-Navigate: Reinforcement Learning with Visual Affordances and Manipulability PriorsA mobile robot needs to move something out of its way to get through, but treating moving obstacles and path-finding as separate problems leaves the robot confused about when to push and when to navigate.
IROS1cMotion Planning and Control with Unknown Nonlinear Dynamics through Predicted ReachabilityA robot must navigate to a target but the rules governing how it moves are completely unknown, so standard planning methods cannot predict where the robot can reach.
IROS1cET-Plan-Bench: Embodied Task-level Planning Benchmark Towards Spatial-Temporal Cognition with Foundation ModelsWe don't have good ways to test whether language models can actually understand where things are, what order things happen in, and what causes what when a robot is planning tasks.
IROS1c3D-AMTA: Occlusion-Aware Real-Time 3D Hand Pose Estimation with Auto Mask and Token-Specific AttentionMeasuring hand position from a camera photo is hard when fingers hide each other, and doing it fast enough for a robot to react is nearly impossible on small computers.
IROS1cLightPlanner: Unleashing the Reasoning Capabilities of Lightweight Large Language Models in Task PlanningSmall language models can't think through hard multi-step tasks, so robots need huge models that can't fit in small computers.
IROS1cHigh-Precision and High-Efficiency Trajectory Tracking for Excavators Based on Closed-Loop DynamicsHydraulic excavators are hard to control precisely because oil pressure delays commands and all the levers affect each other, so existing control methods fail or need way too much training data.
ICRAEfficient Imitation Without Demonstrations via Value-Penalized Auxiliary Control from ExamplesTraining a robot from only a few examples of what the finished task looks like takes a very large number of practice trials because the robot gets almost no feedback until it completes the full task.
ICRAThe Experiment Orchestration System (EOS): Comprehensive Foundation for Laboratory AutomationRunning automated multi-step science experiments across many different lab devices is disorganized because there is no single open software tool that handles scheduling, device control, and result tracking together.
ICRASecond-Order Stein Variational Dynamic OptimizationPlanning a robot's movement path in real time is hard because fast gradient-based methods get stuck in local minima, while sampling-based methods that avoid local minima add too much noise.
ICRALearning Optimal Design Manifolds to Design More Practical Robotic SystemsWhen you optimize a robot's shape and motion together, you get one answer, but you have no way to see what other shapes work equally well or which of those is easiest to build.
ICRAOn-Robot Reinforcement Learning with Goal-Contrastive RewardsTeaching a robot by trial-and-error on real hardware takes too many attempts because the robot gets almost no feedback signal telling it whether it is doing well.
ICRACLIMB: Language-Guided Continual Learning for Task Planning with Iterative Model BuildingRobot task planners need a complete hand-written rulebook (called a PDDL domain model) describing every action and condition, which takes a lot of human effort and often misses rules that only show up when the robot actually tries things.
ICRAHBTP: Heuristic Behavior Tree Planning with Large Language Model ReasoningPlanning robots' actions as behavior trees works well formally, but searching through all possible action sequences gets too slow for complex tasks, while plans from large language models alone can be wrong.
ICRABrain-Inspired Spatial Continuous State Encoding for Efficient Spiking-Based NavigationSpiking neural networks use on-off pulses instead of continuous numbers, which makes it hard for them to keep track of where a robot is or where it needs to go.
ICRATowards Real-Time Generation of Delay-Compensated Video Feeds for Outdoor Mobile Robot TeleoperationVideo from a remote robot arrives late over a network, so the operator sees where the robot was, not where it is, which makes safe control difficult.
ICRAHEROES: Unreal Engine-based Human and Emergency Robot Operation Education SystemFirst responders and rescue teams have no realistic, varied computer environment to practice mass-casualty scenarios with both humans and robots together.
ICRAPromi: an Efficient Prototype-Mixture Baseline for Few-Shot Segmentation with Bounding-Box AnnotationsTeaching a robot to pick out a specific object in an image normally requires expensive hand-drawn pixel masks, which are impractical to collect at scale.
ICRACANVAS: Commonsense-Aware Navigation System for Intuitive Human-Robot InteractionRobots struggle to follow vague human instructions like rough sketches or casual spoken directions because they lack the everyday common sense needed to fill in the gaps.
ICRAManual, Semi or Fully Autonomous Flipper Control? A Framework for Fair ComparisonRobots that use flippers to climb over rough terrain can be steered manually, semi-automatically, or fully automatically, but there was no fair way to compare which mode works best.
ICRAHow Sound-Based Robot Communication Impacts Perceptions of Robotic FailureWhen a robot talks using spoken words and then fails at a task, people's trust in it drops sharply — but simpler sound-based communication had not been tested as an alternative.
ICRACOLLAGE: Collaborative Human-Agent Interaction Generation Using Hierarchical Latent Diffusion and Language ModelsGenerating realistic motion sequences of two people working together on a shared task is hard because such data is scarce and the motions are complex.
ICRAWatch Less, Feel More: Sim-to-Real RL for Generalizable Articulated Object Manipulation via Motion Adaptation and Impedance ControlReinforcement learning policies trained in simulation to open doors or drawers fail on real objects because raw camera or point cloud inputs differ too much between simulation and reality.
ICRAFLEX: A Framework for Learning Robot-Agnostic Force-Based Skills Involving Sustained Contact Object ManipulationRobots trained to push or slide objects on one robot arm cannot reuse that skill on a different arm without collecting a lot of new training data.
ICRADiffusion Meets Options: Hierarchical Generative Skill Composition for Temporally-Extended TasksPlanning long sequences of robot actions that must satisfy formal rules (like always check A before doing B) from imperfect recorded data is slow and hard to correct when something goes wrong.
ICRAORLA*: Mobile Manipulator-Based Object Rearrangement with Lazy APlanning the fastest order to pick up and place many objects with a wheeled robot arm is very slow because both the arm's reach and the robot's wheel travel must be minimized together.
ICRAManipulability Transfer and Tracking Control: Bridging Domain Adaptation with Predictive FeasibilityWhen you record how a human arm moves and try to replay that motion on a robot arm with different joints, the robot often gets stuck in positions it cannot actually reach.
ICRAInteractive Motion Planning for a 7-DOF RobotWhen a person remotely controls a 7-joint robot arm, there is an extra degree of freedom (compared with a 6-joint arm) that existing remote-control software does not let the operator adjust, making it hard to get the arm into the right position.
ICRAAn EEG Conformer Model for Error Feedback During Human-Robot InteractionDetecting in real time when a person's brain signals a mistake — useful for controlling an exoskeleton — is unreliable because error signals are rare, people react at slightly different times, and lab test conditions differ from real continuous use.
ICRANon-Prehensile Shape Manipulation of Elastoplastic Objects With Reinforcement LearningGetting a robot to push soft, deformable objects — like food — into a target shape without picking them up is very hard because the objects change shape unpredictably.
ICRAStiffness Regulation Co-Pilot in Bilateral Teleimpedance Control: A Preliminary User Study ↗When a person controls a remote robot arm that can vary its stiffness, they struggle to do the main task and also manage the stiffness setting at the same time.
ICRARobot Policy Transfer with Online Demonstrations: An Active Reinforcement Learning Approach ↗When a robot learns from pre-recorded demonstrations and then tries to do a new task or use a different body, its behavior breaks down because the recordings don't cover what it actually encounters.
ICRAImplicit Contact Diffuser: Sequential Contact Reasoning With Latent Point Cloud DiffusionMaking a robot perform many steps of contact-heavy manipulation in a row requires planning through discrete contact changes and continuous motion at the same time, which is too complex to search over directly from sensor data.
ICRALearning to Predict the Future from Monocular Vision for Efficient Human-Aware NavigationA robot navigating around people using only one camera cannot directly measure depth or track people's exact positions, making it hard to predict whether its path will collide with someone.
ICRAAutomated Planning Domain Inference for Task and Motion PlanningGetting a robot to plan and carry out multi-step tasks requires someone to hand-write a detailed rule book of what each action requires and what it changes — this is slow and does not scale to new tasks.
ICRAHigh-Quality 3D Creation From a Single Image Using Subject-Specific Knowledge PriorCreating a 3D model from a single photo produces shapes and surface details that do not closely match the object in the photo because the AI uses general knowledge rather than knowledge specific to that object.
ICRALearning to Prune Branches in Modern Tree-Fruit OrchardsPruning fruit trees by robot requires navigating dense branches and placing a cutting tool at the exact right spot and angle, which is very hard to do in the real world.
ICRASHIRE: Enhancing Sample Efficiency using Human Intuition in REinforcement LearningTraining robots through trial-and-error (reinforcement learning) takes far too many attempts before the robot learns anything useful.
ICRAPhysical Simulation with Force Feedback Aids Robot Factors DesignPeople who design products or devices often cannot tell whether a robot will be able to physically operate their design until after a real prototype is built and tested.
ICRADABI: Evaluation of Data Augmentation Methods Using Downsampling in Bilateral Control-Based Imitation Learning with ImagesTeaching a robot to do tasks by copying expert demonstrations requires many demonstrations, and getting enough is slow and tiring for the human expert.
ICRAWhenever, Wherever: Towards Orchestrating Crowd Simulations with Spatio-Temporal Spawn DynamicsCrowd simulations get the individual pedestrian behavior right but produce unrealistic crowd patterns because they do not model when and where people enter a scene.
ICRAA Hybrid User Interface Combining AR, Desktop, and Mobile Interfaces for Enhanced Industrial Robot ProgrammingProgramming industrial robots for complex assembly tasks is hard, and systems that use only one type of interface — like augmented-reality glasses — create their own usability problems.
ICRACrowdSurfer: Sampling Optimization Augmented with Vector-Quantized Variational AutoEncoder for Dense Crowd NavigationMobile robots moving through dense crowds in real time struggle to find safe paths quickly without trying to predict exactly where every person will go.
ICRASingle-Shot Metric Depth from Focused Plenoptic CamerasRegular cameras can estimate depth but not the real physical distance, while special light-field cameras can give true distances but there are no public test datasets and no method to get a dense depth map from a single shot.
ICRALearning Diverse Robot Striking Motions with Diffusion Models and Kinematically Constrained Gradient GuidanceTeaching a robot to make fast, varied striking motions (like in table tennis) without access to a good simulator or a large pile of real-world data is very difficult.
ICRAChemistry3D: Robotic Interaction Toolkit for Chemistry ExperimentsNo simulation environment lets researchers test robots doing real chemistry tasks, because existing tools cannot model liquids, transparent containers, or the color and temperature changes that happen during reactions.
ICRAHuman Activity Recognition by Using Enhanced Radar Point Cloud 2D Histograms and Doppler Feature FusionRecognizing what a person is doing using radar signals is hard because the standard way of turning radar data into images loses important detail about where and how fast the person is moving.
ICRAODYSSEE: Oyster Detection Yielded by Sensor Systems on Edge ElectronicsCounting and locating oysters underwater without disturbing them is difficult because very few labeled training images exist and underwater visibility is poor.
ICRASample-Efficient Unsupervised Policy Cloning from Ensemble Self-Supervised Labeled VideosTraining a robot from video footage normally needs either reward signals or recordings that include what actions were taken, both of which are hard to get.
ICRAFine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Object Detection with Fined-Grained Prompts: Task, Dataset and Benchmark ↗Tests for object detectors use broad category labels, so they cannot measure whether a detector can find objects described by specific visual properties like color, texture, or condition.
ICRALearning a High-Quality Robotic Wiping Policy Using Systematic Reward Analysis and Visual-Language Model Based CurriculumTraining a robot to wipe surfaces well using trial-and-error (reinforcement learning) fails to converge because the reward for wiping quality and the reward for finishing fast work against each other.
ICRAExpert-Enhanced Masked Point Modeling for Point Cloud Self-Supervised LearningPre-training 3D point cloud models on one dataset and then using them on a different dataset often hurts performance because the two datasets contain different types of objects.
ICRABridging In-Situ and Satellite Data: Enhancing Gas Concentration Estimation Through Integration of Data-Driven and Physics-Based ModelingEstimating air pollution (specifically nitrogen dioxide) levels across large areas from satellite images is inaccurate where there are no ground sensors to check against.
ICRAReinforcement Learning for Adaptive Planner Parameter Tuning: A Perspective on Hierarchical ArchitectureAutomatically adjusting the settings of a navigation planner while the robot moves is hard, and doing it without a structured design leads to poor performance in tight or complex spaces.
ICRASynthesizing Depowdering Trajectories for Robot Arms using Deep Reinforcement LearningProgramming a robot arm to blow loose powder off complex 3D-printed parts requires manual path planning for every new shape.
ICRA3D Dense Captioning via Prototypical Momentum DistillationModels that describe every object in a 3D scene tend to overfit when training data is limited, and existing approaches need large numbers of parameters.
ICRAVQA-Driven Event Maps for Assistive Navigation for People with Low Vision in Urban Environments ↗People with low vision need help spotting city hazards like construction or potholes from smart glasses, but building a separate detector for each hazard type is slow and hard to maintain.
ICRAClosed Loop Interactive Embodied Reasoning for Robot ManipulationRobot manipulation systems break down when objects have properties you cannot see (like weight) or when something unexpected pushes or disturbs the robot mid-task.
ICRALatent Embedding Adaptation for Human Preference Alignment in Diffusion PlannersA motion planner trained on average behavior will not match what each individual user actually wants, and retraining the whole model for each user is too expensive.
ICRAUPTor: Unified 3D Human Pose Dynamics and Trajectory Prediction for Human-Robot InteractionRobots navigating around people need to predict both where a person's whole body will be and where they will walk next, but most methods only predict one of the two.
ICRAMBE-ARI: A Multimodal Dataset Mapping Bi-Directional Engagement in Animal-Robot InteractionResearchers studying how animals and robots respond to each other have no shared labeled dataset of signals from both sides of that interaction.
ICRAAn Adversarial Learning Framework for Reliable Myoelectric Force Estimation Under FatigueAs muscles tire, the electrical signals they produce change in ways that break grip-force prediction systems used in powered exoskeletons and prosthetics.
ICRAA Kinematics Optimization Framework with Improved Computational Efficiency for Task-Based Optimum Design of Serial Manipulators in Cluttered EnvironmentsDesigning the best arm shape and joint layout for a robot working in a cramped space takes too long because testing each design requires running a full motion planner.
ICRATeleoperating a 6 DoF Robotic Manipulator from Head Movements ↗Controlling all six directions of a robot arm using only head movements is difficult because a person's head does not move far enough to command a wide robot workspace.
ICRAA Comparative Study Between a Virtual Wand and a One-to-One Approach for the Teleoperation of a Nearby Robotic Manipulator ↗It was unclear whether translating head rotations into amplified arm movement is actually better than mapping the operator's hand position directly to the arm for everyday teleoperation.
ICRALamPro: Multi-Prototype Representation Learning for Enhanced Visual Pattern RecognitionImage recognition systems that learn from labeled data ignore that objects in the same category can look very different from each other, and they do not use negative feedback — cases where a label was wrong — to fix their internal representations.
ICRAUltraFastCrackSeg: A Lightweight Real-Time Crack Segmentation Model with Task-Oriented PretrainingFinding cracks in structures in real time on cheap hardware is too slow with current deep-learning image models.
ICRADP-Habitat: Bridging the Gap Between Simulation and Reality for Visual Navigation in Dynamic Pedestrian EnvironmentsNavigation simulators used to train robots use static rooms or unrealistically simple people, so robots trained in them perform poorly in real spaces where people move around.
ICRAComparison of Three Interface Approaches for Gaze Control of Assistive Robots for Individuals with TetraplegiaPeople with paralysis in all four limbs need a good way to control a robot arm, but no one had compared the main interface options head-to-head.
ICRAThrough the Clutter: Exploring the Impact of Complex Environments on the Legibility of Robot MotionRobot arms designed to move in ways that are easy for a person to predict have only been tested in clear, empty workspaces, not the messy ones found in real workplaces.
ICRAAcoustic Wave Manipulation Through Sparse Robotic ActuationFocusing or canceling sound waves using only a few actuators is hard because the sound field is only partially visible and the physics governing waves is complex.
ICRAPlug-and-Play Multi-Domain Fusion Adaptation for Cross-Subject EEG-Based Motor Imagery ClassificationBrain-computer interfaces that decode imagined movements from brain signals (EEG) work well for one person but drop in accuracy for new people, and collecting enough data from each new user is expensive.
ICRAComparison of User Interface Paradigms for Assistive Robotic ManipulatorsIt is not clear whether a touchscreen display or physical hand controls work better for older adults trying to operate an assistive robot in a tight, cluttered space.
ICRAA New Framework for Repetitive Control of Robot Manipulators via Operator-Theoretic Robust StabilizationProving that a controller designed to repeat the same motion precisely will remain stable on a robot arm with uncertain dynamics has no rigorous theoretical basis.
ICRAFeasibility-Aware Imitation Learning from Observations Through a Hand-Mounted Demonstration Interface ↗When humans show a robot how to move, they often make motions that the robot physically cannot copy, which wastes data and makes the learned policy worse.
ICRAFitnessAgent: A Unified Agent Framework for Open-Set and Personalized Fitness EvaluationExercise evaluation software is trained on a fixed list of movements and cannot assess a new exercise or judge performance by a person's custom goals without being retrained.
ICRAProbabilistic Latent Variable Modeling for Dynamic Friction Identification and EstimationFriction inside robot joints behaves differently at high speed versus low speed and keeps reversing direction, and no existing model captures all those effects well enough to predict joint forces accurately.
ICRARobotic Mushroom Harvesting with Real2Sim2Real and Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) Based PlanningPulling mushrooms out of the ground without breaking them requires a specific twisting-and-lifting motion, but mushroom flesh is soft and tears in complex ways that are hard to predict or program by hand.
ICRAOnline Design Optimization of Passive Exoskeletons Using Fast Biomechanics Simulation and Reinforcement LearningDesigning a wearable support brace today means building and physically testing many prototypes, which is slow and expensive, and current computer methods ignore how the person actually moves during the task.
ICRALoFSORT: Sample Online and Real-time Tracking in Low Frame Rate ScenariosTracking multiple people in video becomes unreliable when the camera only captures fewer than 10 frames per second, because existing trackers assume smooth, fast-updating motion.
ICRAOne-Shot Video Imitation via Parameterized Symbolic Abstraction GraphsTeaching a robot to handle soft or moving objects from a single video is hard because the video does not show invisible physical properties like how much force was used.
ICRAMatchMaker: Automated Asset Generation for Robotic AssemblyTeaching assembly robots in simulation is slow because someone must manually find or build pairs of 3D parts that fit together correctly and work in the physics simulator.
ICRAA Data-Efficient Progressive Learning Framework for Robot Scooping TaskTeaching a robot to scoop different foods with different spoons in different settings requires a lot of training data that is hard to collect.
ICRAHuman-Robot Cooperative Distribution Coupling for Hamiltonian-Constrained Social NavigationMoving a robot safely through crowds requires modeling both the physical forces between people and the robot and the unpredictable ways people choose to move, which are hard to capture together.
ICRAFeature Extractor or Decision Maker: Rethinking the Role of Visual Encoders in Visuomotor PoliciesIt is widely assumed that the vision part of an end-to-end robot policy just extracts image features and is separate from deciding what action to take, but no one has tested whether this is true.
ICRALDM-ISP: Enhancing Neural ISP for Low Light with Latent Diffusion ModelsCamera image processing software fails to recover sharp details and correct colors when photos are taken in very low light, because the signal is nearly buried in noise.
ICRAASCENT: Autonomous Skill Learning Toward Complex Embodied Tasks With Foundation ModelsBuilding simulation environments, designing tasks, and writing reward signals to train robot skills requires large amounts of manual work from researchers.
ICRALearning Wheelchair Tennis Navigation from Broadcast Videos with Domain Knowledge Transfer and Diffusion Motion PlanningThere is no direct robot data for a wheelchair robot that needs to move to the right court position during a tennis match, and broadcast TV footage only shows a partial view of the court.
ICRASurface Roughness Estimation for Terrain PerceptionOutdoor robots need to know how rough the ground is from a camera image to decide where it is safe to drive, but no training data or dedicated method existed for this.
ICRALearning Three-Dimensional Bin Packing with Adjustable-Order Semi-Online SettingWhen a robot packs boxes into a bin and items arrive in a fixed order, the packing quality suffers because the order is rarely ideal.
ICRATSPDiffuser: Diffusion Models as Learned Samplers for Traveling Salesperson Path Planning ProblemsPlanning a route that visits many locations while avoiding obstacles is slow because estimating safe travel costs between all pairs of locations is expensive.
ICRATrustworthy Robot Behavior Tree Generation Based on Multi-Source Heterogeneous Knowledge GraphWriting out the step-by-step decision logic a robot follows to complete a complex task is slow by hand and error-prone when done automatically with language models.
ICRASpeedtuning: Speeding Up Policy Execution with Lightweight Reinforcement LearningA robot that learns by watching human demonstrations moves at the same slow pace as the human, with no good way to speed up without collecting new data.
ICRARobot-Based Automatic Charging for Electric Vehicles Using Incremental Learning and Biomimetic ControlA robot that plugs a charging cable into an electric vehicle needs to find the port precisely and insert the plug gently, both of which are hard due to camera errors and unpredictable contact forces.
ICRAEffective Tuning Strategies for Generalist Robot Manipulation PoliciesWhen you take a general-purpose robot manipulation model and fine-tune it for a new task, the results vary wildly depending on choices that nobody has studied carefully.
ICRAPhysics-Aware Robotic Palletization With Online Masking InferenceStacking boxes onto a pallet requires knowing which placements are physically stable, but writing rules for this by hand is hard and does not generalize well to new box shapes or weights.
ICRAMaster Rules from Chaos: Learning to Reason, Plan, and Interact from Chaos for Tangram AssemblyTeaching a robot to assemble arbitrary tangram puzzles is hard because each puzzle has a different target shape and no pre-built model or labeled training data exists for it.
ICRANeural Encodings for Energy-Efficient Motion PlanningNeural path planners use more than half the run time and a third of the energy on modern chips, making them too slow and power-hungry for real deployment.
ICRATransferring Visual Knowledge: Semi-Supervised Instance Segmentation for Object Navigation Across Varying Height ViewpointsWhen a robot's camera is at a different height than the camera used to train its object-detection model, detection quality drops sharply, and collecting new labeled images for each camera height is expensive.
ICRASynerGuard: A Robust Framework for Point Cloud Classification via Local Geometry and Spatial Topology ↗AI systems that classify 3D point clouds can be fooled by small, crafted changes to the input data, and current defenses either miss important features, require examples of attacks in advance, or make the system worse on normal inputs.
ICRARM-Planner: Integrating Reinforcement Learning with Whole-Body Model Predictive Control for Mobile ManipulationRobots that both drive and use an arm in cluttered, unknown spaces need to coordinate the whole body, but learning this from scratch with sparse rewards trains very slowly.
IROSFABRIC: FAbricating Bodily-Expressive Robots for Inclusive and Low-Cost DesignBuilding a robot that can do expressive full-body movements like sign language is expensive and requires programming skills that most people do not have.
IROSRT-HCP: Dealing with Inference Delays and Sample Efficiency to Learn Directly on Robotic PlatformsLearning-based robot controllers that think slowly cannot keep up with fast physical control loops, leaving gaps where the robot acts without new instructions.
IROSKineDepth: Utilizing Robot Kinematics for Online Metric Depth EstimationA single camera cannot tell you how far away things actually are — it only gives relative distances — so robots normally need an extra depth sensor to know real-world distances.
IROSRoboSwap: A GAN-driven Video Diffusion Framework For Unsupervised Robot Arm SwappingTeaching a robot to copy demonstrations from videos is limited because there are very few videos showing the same task done by different robot arms.
IROSA Smooth Analytical Formulation of Collision Detection and Rigid Body Dynamics With ContactSimulating robots touching and pushing objects produces abrupt jumps in the math that break the gradient-based methods used to plan and learn robot movements.
IROSUnderstanding and Imitating Human-Robot Motion with Restricted Visual FieldsRobots sharing space with people need to predict how people will move, but people can only see what is directly in front of them — ignoring that limited field of view makes predictions less accurate.
IROSA Rubber-sheet Transformation Model for Personalized Human-Robot ProxemicsRobots do not know how close different people want them to get, and that preference varies by age, gender, height, and direction of approach.
IROSVecNav: Vector Goal Robot Navigation from In-the-wild VideosTraining a robot to navigate using a single camera normally requires large sets of specially collected and calibrated videos, which are expensive to produce.
IROSAssessing Trust and Cognitive Load in Teleoperated Robotic Systems Across Different Information ConditionsIt is not clear whether giving robot operators more feedback actually helps them trust the robot and stay mentally in control, or whether too much information makes things worse.
IROSCushionCatch: A Compliant Catching Mechanism for Mobile Manipulators via Combined Optimization and LearningCatching a thrown object with a robot arm on a wheeled base requires the arm to move fast to intercept the object and then absorb the impact gently, and doing both in real time is very hard.
IROSAdaptive Neural Uncalibrated Visual Servo with Zero-shot Transfer of Extrinsics and ScenesNeural controllers that steer a robot by watching a camera break when the camera position or scene scale is unknown because they were trained assuming known values.
IROSDEEP-SEA: Deep-Learning Enhancement for Environmental Perception in Submerged Aquatics ↗Underwater photos are blurry and color-shifted because water scatters and absorbs light, making it hard to spot sea life or navigate safely.
IROSAlignCAPE: Support and Query Feature Aligning for Category-Agnostic Pose EstimationWhen a robot estimates the pose of an object it has never seen before, it compares a reference image to the current camera view, but the two images often don't line up well because global context is ignored.
IROSPet-NODE Modeling: Embedding Priors and Time-Series Features into Neural ODEModeling how a mobile robot actually moves under real-world disturbances and sensor noise is hard: pure physics models are too simple, and pure data-driven models need a lot of data and give no physical insight.
IROSGraph2Scene: Versatile 3D Indoor Scene Generation with Interaction-aware Scene GraphBuilding varied and realistic 3D indoor training environments for AI agents is hard — methods that scan real rooms lack variety, and text-prompt methods can't control fine details like where objects sit relative to each other.
IROSEnhanced Robotic Navigation in Deformable Environments using Learning from Demonstration and Dynamic ModulationRobots navigating around soft obstacles like curtains or foam can't tell which parts they can push through and which parts are rigid and must be avoided, so they either get stuck or damage the obstacle.
IROSSheepDA-YOLO: Cross-Domain Adaptive Mean Teacher with Dual-Path Decoupling for Sheep Behavior RecognitionA model trained to recognize sheep behavior in one pen performs poorly in a different pen with different lighting or layout, and labeling new pens by hand is expensive.
IROSAutonomous Human-Robot Interaction via Operator ImitationSocial robots that interact with people in expressive, varied ways usually need a human operator controlling them live, which is not practical at scale.
IROSSampling-Based Motion Planning with Discrete Configuration-Space SymmetriesWhen an object or environment has repeating symmetry, standard path-planning methods waste time exploring paths that are equivalent by symmetry and find worse paths than needed.
IROSCrowdQuery: Density-Guided Query Module for Enhanced 2D and 3D Detection in Crowded ScenesObject detectors based on transformers struggle in crowded scenes because they can't tell overlapping objects apart in either camera images or 3D space.
IROSNeural MP: A Neural Motion PlannerStandard motion planners take minutes to find a collision-free path in a cluttered environment because they search from scratch every time with no memory of past solutions.
IROSLBE-DDIK: Is One Model Good Enough to Learn-By-Example the Inverse Kinematics of Multiple Serial Robots?Figuring out what joint angles to use to reach a target position (inverse kinematics) normally requires training a separate AI model for each robot arm, which is slow and wasteful.
IROSEfficient and Accurate Low-Resolution Transformer TrackingAccurate video object trackers that use transformers are too slow for many real-time uses, but simply feeding them smaller images makes their accuracy drop sharply.
IROSHybrid Control Approach for Walking-Assembly Integrated Space Robots in On-Orbit AssemblyA robot assembling structures in orbit needs to save battery when moving between locations but be precise when placing parts, and switching between those two goals in real time is hard.
IROSReal-time Iteration Scheme for Diffusion Policy ↗Diffusion-based robot control policies are too slow to use in real time because they require many iterative denoising steps to produce each action.
IROSExtraction of Robotic Surface Processing Strategies from Human DemonstrationsTeaching a robot to sand surfaces is hard because the right motion pattern depends on the shape of the part, and copying one person's movements directly does not capture that adaptable strategy.
IROSVERAGMIL: Virtual Environment for Scooping Granular Foods with Imitation Learning ModelsThere is no good simulation or easy recording setup for teaching robots to scoop foods like rice or beans, which makes it hard to study this type of task.
IROS3DWSNet: A Novel 3D Wavelet Spiking Neural Network for Event-based Action RecognitionEvent cameras capture motion very efficiently, but existing brain-inspired (spiking) neural networks for recognizing actions from these cameras do not separate fine detail from broad motion patterns, so they miss useful information.
IROSVRobotix: A Scalable and Cost-Effective Virtual-Reality-Based Robotic Manipulation Dataset Generation FrameworkCollecting large amounts of varied robot training data requires real robots and lab time, which is expensive and hard to scale.
IROSUncertainty-aware Planning with Inaccurate Models for Robotized Liquid HandlingModels that predict how liquid will behave during robot pouring are always somewhat wrong, and a planner that ignores this gets poor results on new containers or liquids.
IROSSubject-Embedded Vision Transformer with Transfer Learning for Cross-Subject Dynamic Hand Gesture Recognition Using HD-sEMGMuscle signal (sEMG) patterns for the same hand gesture vary a lot between people, so a model trained on one person works poorly on another, and methods that wait for the gesture to finish add unwanted delay.
IROSEffiTune: Diagnosing and Mitigating Training Inefficiency for Parameter Tuner in Robot Navigation SystemMethods that automatically tune a navigation system's settings train slowly because they collect too many easy, repeated examples and too few from the hard spots where the robot actually struggles.
IROSRRT*former: Environment-Aware Sampling-Based Motion Planning using TransformerStandard sampling-based path planners (like RRT*) pick random points in space without considering obstacles or the history of earlier samples, wasting many samples in useless areas and producing longer paths.
IROSAAOPL: Automated Articulated Object Parameter Learning for Open-World RoboticsRobots need to know how hinged objects like doors and drawers move before they can open them, but measuring those properties without a pre-built model or human demonstrations is unsolved.
IROSEdgeSpotter: Multi-Scale Dense Text Spotting for Industrial Panel MonitoringReading text on industrial control panels is hard because text varies widely in size, characters crowd together, and the system must work in real time on a small edge device.
IROSNaviFormer: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Transformer-like Model to Holistically Solve the Navigation Problem ↗Most robot navigation systems split the job into two separate pieces — one for planning a high-level route and another for avoiding obstacles moment to moment — which adds complexity and can cause mismatches.
IROSOnline Residual Model Learning for Model Predictive Control of Autonomous Surface Vehicles in Real-World EnvironmentsControlling a boat autonomously is hard because waves, currents, and wind create forces that no pre-built physics model fully captures.
IROSOut-of-Distribution Recovery with Object-Centric Keypoint Inverse Policy for Visuomotor Imitation LearningA robot taught by copying human demonstrations often fails when it ends up in a position that was never shown in the training data.
IROSCan Real-Time Lipreading Improve Speech Recognition? A Systematic Exploration Using Human-Robot Interaction Data ↗Robot ears don't hear well in noisy places, and it's unclear if lip-reading helps fix that when the model was trained on humans, not robots.
IROSModel-Driven Development of Distributed Controllers Using Petri Nets and Low-Code StrategyBuilding controllers for robots and hardware systems is messy because you have to juggle the hardware, the code, testing, and running it on different chips with no single tool.
IROSELPTNet: An Efficient LiDAR-based 3D Pedestrian Tracking Network for Autonomous Navigation Social RobotsTracking many people in 3D using a laser scanner is hard because people change shape constantly as they walk, making standard box-tracking methods lose them.
