IROSMotivational Cognitive Maps Allow Robot Biomimetic AutonomyBrain-inspired navigation models can only follow one goal at a time and ignore the robot's internal state — like being low on battery — so they cannot decide on their own when to stop exploring and go recharge.
IROSPathCluster: Pedestrian Group-Adaptive Social Navigation in Dense CrowdsIn very dense crowds, predicting where every single person is going becomes too slow for a robot to act in real time.
IROSVersatile Demonstration Interface: Toward More Flexible Robot Demonstration CollectionTools for teaching robots by example are each built for only one style of teaching, so you need different hardware for different tasks or teachers.
IROSDistilling 3D distinctive local descriptors for 6D pose estimationA method called GeDi can estimate an object's exact 3D position and orientation from a single image without prior training on that object, but it is far too slow to use in practice.
IROSActive Training Data Selection for Gaussian Process-based Robot Dynamics Learning and ControlLearning a robot's motion model using a method called Gaussian processes normally needs a large number of data points to be accurate, which is slow and expensive to collect.
IROSSensor-Free Self-Calibration for Collaborative Robots Using Tri-Sphere End-Effector Toward High Orientation AccuracyCollaborative robot arms are not very accurate at reaching exact positions and orientations, and fixing this normally requires expensive laser-tracking equipment.
IROSInvestigating the Impact of Humor on Learning in Robot-Assisted EducationNo one knows whether a robot telling jokes during a lesson helps students learn, and if so, whether the timing of those jokes matters.
IROSReinforcement Learning-Based Autonomous Control Methodology of Hydraulic ExcavatorsTeaching a hydraulic excavator to dig on its own is hard because the hydraulic system behaves in complex nonlinear ways, its pump can hit flow limits, and soil resistance changes unpredictably.
IROSRwoR: Generating Robot Demonstrations from Human Hand Collection for Policy Learning without RobotRecording demonstrations for teaching a robot to manipulate objects normally requires the robot itself and specialized equipment, which is expensive and slow to scale.
IROSDemonstration-Enhanced Adaptable Multi-Objective Robot NavigationA robot set up with fixed navigation rules cannot change how it balances competing goals—like staying safe vs. following a user's preferred path—without being fully retrained.
IROSInteractive Expressive Motion Generation Using Dynamic Movement PrimitivesSocial robots have no systematic way to produce lifelike, emotionally fitting motions that work across different robot body types and social situations.
IROSTowards Zero-Knowledge Task Planning via a Language-based ApproachMost robot task planners need hand-written rules or setup specific to each task, so they break down entirely when asked to do something new.
IROSMobile Manipulator For Robotic Lacrosse: Learning to Pass the BallThrowing and catching a small ball with a compliant lacrosse head at speed is hard for robots because the ball-head interaction is difficult to model, and both the throw and the catch must be planned for fast-moving projectiles.
IROSEffect of Haptic Feedback on Avoidance Behavior and Visual Exploration in Dynamic VR Pedestrian EnvironmentIt was not known whether adding touch feedback when a person bumps into virtual pedestrians in a crowd simulation changes how they move or where they look.
IROSGlobal Optimization of Stochastic Black-Box Functions with Arbitrary Noise Distributions using Wilson Score Kernel Density EstimationFinding the best settings for a noisy robotics process is hard when you do not know what kind of randomness the measurements have and you can only afford a small number of tests.
IROSλ: A Benchmark for Data-Efficiency in Long-Horizon Indoor Mobile Manipulation RoboticsTesting how well a robot learns to do long multi-step tasks like fetching things across multiple rooms requires real human demonstrations, but there has been no dataset at a scale a research team can actually collect.
IROSTriple-S: A Collaborative Multi-LLM Framework for Solving Long-Horizon Implicative Tasks in RoboticsWhen a single large language model writes robot control code for tasks with many sequential steps, it produces code with API errors, wrong step order, or bad comments that make the robot fail.
IROSDeep Learning-Based Pig Behavior Captioning for Smart Livestock FarmingAutomated livestock monitoring needs to produce written descriptions of pig behavior, not just label it, but no model or dataset existed for that task.
IROSSIME: Enhancing Policy Self-Improvement with Modal-level ExplorationA robot trying to improve itself by practicing tends to repeat the same moves it already knows, so it rarely collects the varied experience it needs to get better.
IROSLow-effort Iterative Dataset Generation Pipeline for Unknown Object Instance SegmentationBuilding a large labeled dataset for teaching robots to recognize the outlines of objects they have never seen before requires an enormous amount of manual drawing of masks around each object.
IROSNeural Signatures and Decoding of the Various Cognitive Processes Elicited by the Same StimulusBrain-computer interfaces need to tell apart different mental tasks triggered by the same sight or sound, which existing EEG decoding methods were not designed to do.
IROSAutomatic Real-to-Sim-to-Real System through Iterative Interactions for Robust Robot Manipulation Policy Learning with Unseen ObjectsBuilding a simulation of a new object to train a robot usually requires a person to hold a camera and move the object by hand, which is slow and limits what robots can learn on their own.
IROSMultimodal Human Activity Recognition with a Large Language Model for Enhanced Human-Robot InteractionRecognizing what a person is doing from several sensor types at once (camera, microphone, motion sensor) normally needs a separate specialized system for each sensor, making the whole thing fragile if one sensor stops working.
IROSEfficient Hitting with different links of a Redundant Robotic ManipulatorRobot arms that hit objects rather than grasp them are limited to objects within a narrow weight range because only the wrist end is used, and that part may not have the right amount of force for heavier or lighter objects.
IROSDistilling Realizable Students from Unrealizable TeachersTeaching a robot policy that uses only its own sensors by copying from a policy that sees everything is hard because the sensor-limited robot cannot reproduce what the all-seeing policy does.
IROSPyRoki: A Modular Toolkit for Robot Kinematic OptimizationExisting tools for optimizing robot joint positions and motions are locked to specific hardware and cannot easily mix and match different objectives or run on different types of processors.
IROSNavHD: Low-Power Learning for Micro-Robotic Controls in the WildTiny robots cannot fit normal AI navigation systems because they do not have enough memory or battery power.
IROSMasked Autoencoders are Robust Task Offloaders for Timely and Accurate InferenceA small robot in a risky location needs to send camera images to a remote server for analysis, but an unreliable network connection causes delays or lost data that make the analysis wrong or too slow.
IROSEASEIR: Efficient and Adaptive Safe-set Estimation via Implicit Representation for High-dimensional Motion PlanningComputing all the arm positions a robot can reach without hitting anything takes too long for high-degree-of-freedom arms, especially when the environment changes and the calculation must be repeated.
IROSTerraX: Visual Terrain Classification Enhanced by Vision-Language ModelsVisual terrain classification for unmanned ground vehicles is limited by static label sets, semantic ambiguity, and high annotation costs that restrict fine-grained terrain characterization.
IROSIn-situ Value-aligned Human-Robot Interactions with Physical ConstraintsA home robot needs to match what a person actually wants while also following the physical rules of a task, but current AI planners handle only one of these at a time.
IROSTBAP: Tapping-Based Auditory Perception for Identifying Container MaterialsRobots cannot easily tell what a container is made of just by looking at it, and there is no good automated way to tap objects and listen to the sound to figure that out.
IROSVision-Language Navigation with Continual Learning for Unseen EnvironmentsA robot that follows spoken directions in new buildings it has never seen tends to forget what it learned about old buildings once it starts learning about new ones.
IROSRMG: Real-Time Expressive Motion Generation with Self-collision Avoidance for 6-DOF Companion Robotic ArmsRobotic arms that live alongside people look stiff and mechanical, and making them move in an expressive, human-like way in real time while preventing the arm from hitting itself is unsolved.
IROSInverse Attention-Weighted Model with Heterogeneous Spatio-Temporal Interaction Graph for Autonomous Navigation SystemsA robot navigating through a dense crowd tends to freeze or be too cautious because it can't tell which nearby people and obstacles matter most.
IROSApple detection method based on fusion of infrared thermal image and visible-light imageFruit-picking robots miss apples or get confused when sunlight is too bright or comes from behind the fruit, making normal camera images unreliable.
IROSTask-Oriented Token Pruning for Efficient Object Detection and SegmentationVision models waste computing time processing parts of an image that belong to object types the robot doesn't need to detect right now.
IROSad-trait: A Fast and Flexible Automatic Differentiation Library in RustRobotics software written in the Rust programming language had no library for computing derivatives automatically, forcing developers to code derivatives by hand or switch languages.
IROSOmniPose6D: Towards Short-Term Object Pose Tracking in Dynamic Scenes from Monocular RGBTracking an object's exact position and angle from a single regular camera in a moving scene is unreliable because there is not enough varied training data and the tracking stumbles when the object moves unpredictably.
IROS3D Plant Root Skeleton Detection and ExtractionMapping the full 3D shape of plant roots from images is hard because roots are thin, branch densely, and all look the same color and texture.
IROSLearning to Throw-FlipWhen a robot throws an object, unintended spinning during release makes it nearly impossible to control both where the object lands and what face it lands on.
IROSContextCache: Task-Aware Lifecycle Management for Memory-Efficient LLM Agent DeploymentAI agents that run many steps on devices with limited GPU memory waste that memory by keeping cached text context longer than needed or recomputing it too often.
IROSEmoRLTalk: Speech-Driven Emotional Facial Animation With Offline Reinforcement LearningComputer-generated 3D faces driven by speech often move the wrong way emotionally — the face looks neutral when the speech sounds angry or happy.
IROSLAMPS: A Novel Robot Generalization Framework for Learning Adaptive Multi-Periodic SkillsTeaching a robot long tasks like cleaning — which mix many repeated motions with one-off transitions — is hard because there is no general way to break such tasks apart automatically and then put them back together.
IROSA stepwise identification framework for determining the physical feasibility parameters of robot dynamicsWhen you measure a robot's physical properties (like how weight is distributed in each joint) from motion data, the numbers often come out wrong in ways that are physically impossible, such as negative mass.
IROSFailure Forecasting Boosts Robustness of Sim2Real Rhythmic Insertion TasksWhen a robot repeats a precise fitting task many times, small errors add up each cycle until the task fails.
IROSNovel Diffusion Models for Multimodal 3D Hand Trajectory PredictionPredicting where a person's hands will move in 3D from a head-worn camera is hard because the camera itself is also moving, and existing methods only work in 2D.
IROSImproved 2D Hand Trajectory Prediction with Multi-View ConsistencyModels that predict hand movement from a head-worn camera do not use the geometric relationships created when the camera moves, leaving useful information on the table.
IROSUser Experience Estimation in Human-Robot Interaction via Multi-Instance Learning of Multimodal Social SignalsExisting tools for measuring how much a person enjoys or engages with a robot look at mood or attention separately, not as one combined score that changes over time.
IROSAnomaly Detection in Human-Robot Interaction Using Multimodal Models Constructed from In-the-Wild InteractionsRobots powered by large language models sometimes break down in conversation in ways that are hard to catch automatically, and a human operator needs to step in quickly when that happens.
IROSLook Before You Leap: Using Serialized State Machine for Language Conditioned Robotic ManipulationRobots learning to do long sequences of steps by watching examples fail often when the examples do not cover every possible situation the robot might end up in.
IROSRapid and Simultaneous Visual-based Estimation of Kinematic and Hand-eye Parameters of Industrial Mobile ManipulatorsCalibrating a robot arm's exact joint geometry and the position of its camera at the same time is hard because the two calibrations depend on each other.
IROSRobotics Virtual Laboratory Featuring Serial, Parallel, Wheeled Robots, and Autonomous Off-road Vehicles, and Covering Analysis, Control and SensorsRobotics students often lack access to physical labs covering the full range of robot types and topics — arm robots, wheeled robots, off-road vehicles — in one place.
IROSRDMM: Enhancing Household Robotics with On-Device Contextual Memory and Decision MakingHome robots need to understand what is happening, remember past context, and decide what to do next — but the AI models good enough to do this normally require expensive hardware or an internet connection.
IROSAutomated Behaviour-Driven Acceptance Testing of Robotic SystemsChecking that a robot system meets its requirements by hand is tedious and error-prone.
IROSSENIOR: Efficient Query Selection and Preference-Guided Exploration in Preference-based Reinforcement LearningTeaching a robot by asking humans which of two behaviors they prefer wastes many questions on uninformative comparisons, making learning slow.
IROSSnuggle-Pack: Speeding Up Multi-Heuristic Packing Planning of Complex ObjectsFitting many oddly shaped objects tightly into a bin in real time is either too slow or leaves too much empty space.
IROSLanguage-Guided Hierarchical Planning with Scene Graphs for Tabletop Object RearrangementA robot moving objects on a table based on spoken instructions needs to translate vague language like 'put the cup near the book' into precise physical moves.
IROSOnline Imitation Learning for Manipulation via Decaying Relative Correction through TeleoperationWhen someone teaches a robot to move by controlling it from a distance, they need to fix errors many times, which is tiring and slows learning.
IROSDetection for Harvesting with an Active Illumination Camera System and DUTU2-Net+Finding where to pick peppers in a farm is unreliable because sunlight and shadows keep changing, and robots need quick answers.
IROSComparative Analysis of CSP, CSTP, and Max-SNR Filters for P300 Detection in Brain Computer InterfaceBrain-computer interfaces miss brain signals because existing filters don't fully use the space and time patterns hidden in the data.
IROSImproving 6D Object Pose Estimation of Metallic Household and Industry ObjectsRobots picking shiny metal objects fail because reflections and light bounce confuse the vision system.
IROSAn Unsupervised C-Uniform Trajectory Sampler with Applications to Model Predictive Path Integral ControlCurrent sampling methods for robot path planning tend to find the same paths over and over, missing new possibilities in tight spaces.
IROSModel-Mediated Teleoperation with 3D Dynamic Environment Tracking (MMT-DET): A Comparative Study of Task Performance with Time-Domain Passivity ControlRemote robot control over internet loses feel and safety when there's delay, especially when things are moving around.
IROSData-Driven Fault Detection for Wafer Scanner Cable Slabs using Koopman OperatorsCables in chip-making machines bend and twist in complex ways that are hard to predict so faults sneak up unnoticed.
IROSOnline Iterative Learning with Forward Simulation for Sub-minimum End-effector Displacement PositioningA robot arm can only move in steps as small as its motor's minimum resolution—you can not tell it to move one millimeter if the motor steps are one millimeter, so there is a hard precision limit.
IROSFoldPath: End-to-End Object-Centric Motion Generation via Modulated Implicit PathsTeaching a robot multi-step tasks like spray-painting or welding normally requires listing dozens of waypoints and figuring out the order, which is brittle and hard to change if the object is slightly different.
IROSCCDP: Composition of Conditional Diffusion Policies with Guided SamplingImitation learning from demonstrations sometimes copies failed moves, and at test time it has no way to avoid those bad actions, so it fails on parts of the task it never saw succeed.
IROSPersonalized Re-identification through Unsupervised Continual Learning and Parallel TrainingWhen a person being tracked by a robot changes clothes, the tracking system forgets what that person looks like and fails to find them again.
IROSTeleoperated Teaching of Task and Impedance (TTTI): Multi-Modal Interface Extending Haptic Device for Robotic Skill TransferA person controlling a robot remotely can use a haptic device to teach it how to move, but they can't also teach it the task sequence—the timing and order of actions—at the same time.
IROSRECON: Reducing Causal Confusion with Human-Placed MarkersWhen a robot learns by watching a person demonstrate a task, it gets confused by things on the background and doesn't know what to actually pay attention to.
IROSDiegetic Graphical User Interfaces for Robot Control via Eye-gazeControlling a robot by looking at a screen is slow and tiring—the person has to look back and forth between the robot and the screen, and the screen's size limits what commands exist.
IROSQBIT: Quality-Aware Cloud-Based Benchmarking for Robotic Insertion TasksTests of robot assembly only measure pass-or-fail, but factories care about how smoothly the robot inserts parts and how hard it pushes—information that safety and production depend on.
IROSCueLearner: Bootstrapping and local policy adaptation from relative feedbackTeaching robots to learn is slow and hard when you only give them simple yes/no feedback, not full instructions.
IROSGEAR: Gaze-Enabled Human-Robot Collaborative AssemblyFactory robots that hand parts to workers need a way for workers to say which part without using their hands or looking away from what they're doing.
IROSArena-Bench 2.0: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Social Navigation Approaches in Collaborative EnvironmentsNew robot navigation methods are each built for specific situations and there is no fair way to compare different methods across real-world scenarios.
IROSEmbodied Domain Adaptation for Object DetectionWhen a robot moves around indoors, changing lights and room layouts fool its object detector, making it miss things it trained on.
IROSPower Balance-Based Recursive Composite Learning Robot Control With Reduced Computational BurdenTeaching a robot arm with many joints to move precisely takes too much computer time because the math gets very complicated.
IROSContext-Based Meta Reinforcement Learning for Robust and Adaptable Peg-in-Hole Assembly TasksA robot doing peg-in-hole assembly in a new place has trouble because sensors are noisy and no one has taught it to handle the new conditions.
IROSHyperbolic Transformers with LLMs for Multimodal Human Activity RecognitionSystems that recognize what a person is doing from cameras, depth sensors, and motion trackers don't generalize well when tested on new data or new sensor types.
IROSDPSN: Dual Prior Knowledge Induced Tactile paving and Obstacle Joint Segmentation NetworkDetecting bumpy tactile pavement and barriers for blind people is hard because the image pieces don't connect and barriers get mixed up with other things.
IROSIntegrating Offline Pre-Training with Online Fine-Tuning: A Reinforcement Learning Approach for Robot Social NavigationA robot trained on recorded pedestrian data freezes up when real people behave differently during real deployment.
IROSRotation-Equivariant Robot Vision: A Perspective via Correspondence-Matching and Pre-trainingCamera matching methods fail badly when images are rotated.
IROSComplex Robotic Manipulation via Hindsight Goal Diffusion and Graph-based Experience ReplayGoal-conditioned RL for manipulation with obstacles and distant goals fails because standard hindsight goal generation ignores obstacle topology and introduces distance metric bias in experience replay.
IROSEFCWM-Mamba-YOLO: Real-Time Underwater Object Detection with Adaptive Feature Representation and Domain AdaptationFinding objects in murky underwater video is hard because light changes, visibility drops, and training data doesn't match real deployment.
IROSSTACKGEN: Generating Stable Structures from Silhouettes via DiffusionRobots stacking blocks need to find arrangements that won't fall over and match a target shape, but there's no simple rule for which arrangements work.
IROSTraining People to Reward Robots ↗When untrained people show robots how to do tasks through examples, the examples are often bad, so the robot learns poorly.
IROSObject Packing and Scheduling for Sequential 3D Printing: a Linear Arithmetic Model and a CEGAR-inspired Optimal SolverWhen 3D printing objects one after another, the printer needs to arrange them so the print head doesn't crash into already-finished objects. Finding the best arrangement and order is computationally hard.
IROSGaze-Guided Task Decomposition for Imitation Learning in Robotic ManipulationBreaking down movement demonstrations into reusable sub-skills is done by hand and differs between different examples, so skills can't be reused reliably.
IROSKalib: Easy Hand-Eye Calibration with Reference Point TrackingAligning a camera to a robot arm is tedious with markers and hard to redo; deep-learning methods need retraining for each new robot.
IROSEvaluating Human-Robot Collaboration through Online Video: Perspective MattersIt is unclear whether online observers watching robot behavior videos are valid proxies for in-person users when evaluating human-robot collaboration policies.
IROSAdversarial Augmentation for Task-Parameterized Underwater Skill Learning via Digital TwinsTeaching underwater robots from human examples is hard because collecting examples across different underwater conditions is expensive.
IROSM2H: Multi-Task Learning with Efficient Window-Based Cross-Task Attention for Monocular Spatial PerceptionDoing multiple vision jobs at once on small devices is slow and uses too much power, so it usually hurts one job to help another.
IROSReal-World Offline Reinforcement Learning from Vision Language Model FeedbackTraining a learning-based robot policy needs labeled examples of good and bad moves, but labeling real robot data by hand is slow and expensive.
IROSAutonomous Adjustment of Tracking Position in Dynamic Environments for Human-Following Robots Using Deep Reinforcement LearningHuman-following robots stuck in one position (behind, beside, ahead) fail when obstacles block the path or the space is too tight.
IROSAutoMisty: A Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Automated Code Generation in the Misty Social RobotPeople who can't code can't customize a social robot, even though the robot's programming interface is available.
IROSAdaptive Anomaly Recovery for Telemanipulation: A Diffusion Model Approach to Vision-Based TrackingWhen video is cut off (blocked by something, too dark, or signal lost), the operator can't see if the robot is still in the right place, and old interpolation methods can't fill in realistic video.
IROSRobust Offline Imitation Learning Through State-level Trajectory StitchingTeaching a robot from bad or mixed-quality recordings fails because the robot gets confused by the distribution shift and can't reuse helpful parts of bad demos.
IROSAutomatic Machinability Evaluation and Recommendation for Reconfigurable Manufacturing SystemsFactory experts manually decide if a CNC machine can make new parts, slowing down the factory's ability to switch to new products.
IROSTask-Guided and Object-Centric Conditioning for Effective and Adaptive Diffusion PolicyWhen a robot learns to pick things from raw images, it either learns poorly from scratch or uses generic image features that miss task-specific details.
IROSA Natural Human-Robot Interaction System for Teleoperation Based on Noncontact Haptic FeedbackWhen operating a robot from far away, you can't feel what the robot is touching because haptic feedback needs physical contact.
IROSCelebi's Choice: Causality-Guided Skill Optimisation for Granular Manipulation via Differentiable SimulationTeaching robots to dig and level soil is hard because soil doesn't behave in simple math ways, and trying to optimize gets stuck.
IROSA robust MLTD3 path planning algorithm in unknown environmentsRobots can't plan paths in places they've never seen with things moving around because they don't remember what they just saw.
IROSTowards Efficient Image-goal Navigation: A Self-supervised Transformer-based Reinforcement Learning ApproachRobots trying to navigate to a picture goal can't learn to use patterns in their past actions and pictures together.

IROSDRP: A Decomposition-Reflection-Prediction Framework for Long-Horizon Robot Task Planning using Large Language ModelsAI language models can create plans for robots but they don't know what the world actually looks like or what happens when things move, so the plans don't work when the robot tries to execute them.
IROSOnline-HMM with Two-Layer Bayesian Method for Operator's Expected Speed Estimation in Teleoperated Gluing TasksWhen teleoperating robots for precision tasks like gluing, hand shaking ruins the glue lines and standard anti-shake methods can't adapt as the operator changes strategy.

IROSDiff-MSM: Differentiable MusculoSkeletal Model for Simultaneous Identification of Human Muscle and Bone ParametersIt's impossible to measure the exact pull force inside joints, so we can't tune muscle and bone models to match a real person.

Safety and being sure it won't fail 267 papers

The problem

As learned parts and chatbot-style AI enter the control loop, it gets much harder to promise the robot will stay safe: that it will avoid crashes, obey limits, handle crowds and faults, and not be tricked into harmful acts.

The approaches

Math guardrails that block any command that would cross a safety line (control barrier functions), filters that throw out unsafe plans, checks that an AI's plan obeys stated safety rules, careful handling of risk in crowds and under faults, and deliberately trying to trick AI-controlled robots to expose the danger.

How it solves it

The guardrails add provable limits on top of flexible but unproven learned parts, and the trickery studies reveal where the exposure is.

ICRA5cVerifiably Following Complex Robot Instructions with Foundation ModelsRobots need to follow open-ended spoken instructions that involve spatial relationships and timing — like 'go to the red chair before entering the kitchen' — in real spaces, and currently there is no way to confirm the robot actually understood correctly.

ICRA1cHeRo: A State Machine-Based, Fault-Tolerant Framework for Heterogeneous Multi-Robot CollaborationCoordinating groups of different types of robots is hard to program and fails unpredictably when something goes wrong during a task.
ICRA1cForward Invariance in Trajectory Spaces for Safety-Critical ControlSafety rules for robot control either react to danger too late and hurt performance, or plan ahead well but give no hard guarantee that the robot will stay safe.
ICRA1cModeling Uncertainty in 3D Gaussian Splatting Through Continuous Semantic Splatting3D scene reconstruction methods that assign semantic labels (like "wall" or "floor") to parts of the scene give no indication of how confident they are, which is dangerous in safety-critical situations where silent errors are unacceptable.
ICRA1cAn Interactive Hands-Free Controller for a Riding Ballbot to Enable Simple Shared Control TasksA hands-free rider on a self-balancing ball robot can unintentionally fight the robot's speed control by leaning their torso, making shared control unreliable.
ICRA1cEstimating Control Barriers from Offline DataTeaching a robot to know its own safety limits usually requires running many experiments or a simulator, which is not possible when you only have a fixed set of recorded data.
ICRA1cPlanning with Linear Temporal Logic Specifications: Handling Quantifiable and Unquantifiable UncertaintyPlanning robot tasks with formal rules (linear temporal logic) is hard when uncertainty comes in two forms at once: things you can assign odds to and things you can only bound.
ICRA1cGA-TEB: Goal-Adaptive Framework for Efficient Navigation Based on Goal LinesWhen a robot navigating through crowds aims at a single fixed point, it can get stuck when that point becomes blocked and find no alternate path.
ICRA1cSafety-Critical Control with Saliency Detection for Mobile Robots in Dynamic Multi-Obstacle EnvironmentsKeeping a moving robot safe around many dynamic obstacles in real time is expensive to compute because tracking every obstacle adds to the calculation.
ICRA1cRobust Planning for Autonomous Driving via Mixed Adversarial Diffusion PredictionsA self-driving car planner needs to stay safe around risky drivers without being so cautious that it barely moves in normal traffic.
ICRA1cIntelligence Evaluation Methods for Autonomous VehiclesThere is no agreed way to measure how intelligent an autonomous vehicle is across many different driving skills over time.
ICRA1cEfficient Collision Detection Framework for Enhancing Collision-Free Robot MotionRobot arms need to check for collisions with objects and with themselves many times per second, but existing methods are too slow to do this in real time.
IROS1cCollision Mass Map for Safe and Efficient Human-Robot InteractionCurrent methods for estimating how hard a robot would hit a person during a collision are inaccurate, causing robots to either move unsafely fast or slow down far more than needed.
IROS1cCode Generation and Monitoring for Deliberation Components in Autonomous RobotsWriting the planning and decision-making parts of a robot by hand is slow and it is hard to check whether they are safe before the robot runs.
IROS1cDiffusion Policies for Risk-Averse Behavior Modeling in Offline Reinforcement LearningLearning a safe policy from a fixed recorded dataset is hard because the agent faces two types of uncertainty: gaps in the data it was trained on, and genuine randomness in the environment itself.
IROS1cDisentangling Uncertainty for Safe Social Navigation using Deep Reinforcement LearningA robot trained to walk through crowds can act dangerously in new situations because it does not know what it does not know — it cannot tell when its decisions are unreliable.
IROS1cActive Probing with Multimodal Predictions for Motion PlanningA self-driving robot near other moving agents cannot be sure what those agents will do next, and that uncertainty can cause it to act too cautiously or take unsafe risks.
IROS1cRobot Teleoperation Design Requirements from End Users in Nuclear Facilities ↗Robots built for nuclear cleanup are often designed without asking the people who actually operate them, so the machines end up poorly matched to real-world needs.
IROS1cHuman Implicit Preference-Based Policy Fine-tuning for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in USV SwarmGetting human preferences into training for a group of cooperating robots is hard because it is not clear which robot in the group should get the credit or blame for an outcome.
IROS1cRadar-Based NLoS Pedestrian Localization for Darting-Out Scenarios Near Parked Vehicles with Camera-Assisted Point Cloud InterpretationA pedestrian stepping out suddenly from behind a parked car is hidden from the car's sensors until the last moment, and maps that store fixed vehicle positions go out of date as cars park and leave.
IROS1cMerry-Go-Round: Safe Control of Decentralized Multi-Robot Systems with Deadlock Prevention ↗When several robots navigate independently they can block each other and freeze in a standoff that no robot can break on its own.
IROS1cLBAP: Improved Uncertainty Alignment of LLM Planners using Bayesian InferenceRobots that use large language models to plan actions sometimes act on wrong plans with high confidence, which means they fail without asking a human for help when they should.
IROS1cmeSch: Multi-Agent Energy-Aware Scheduling for Task PersistenceWhen a group of robots must keep working at a task for a long time, they all eventually need to recharge at a single charging station, and without coordination they will arrive at the same time and leave gaps in coverage.
IROS1cRoCaRS: Robust Camera-Radar BEV Segmentation for Sensor Failure ScenariosWhen a self-driving car loses one of its sensors (camera or radar), it crashes instead of gracefully using what's left.
IROS1cMPC-based Deep Reinforcement Learning Method for Space Robotic Control with Fuel Sloshing Mitigation ↗A satellite docking autonomously has fuel sloshing around inside its tank in zero gravity, which throws off the control system and makes it impossible to dock reliably.
IROS1cBaTCAVe: Trustworthy Explanations for Robot BehaviorsWhen a neural network tells a robot what to do, no one can see why—whether it's finding a person's face or deciding which way to turn.
IROS1cAnalysis and Mitigation of Inconsistencies in Blockchain-Enabled Robot Swarms ↗When a network breaks and creates two separate groups of robots using blockchain, the shared record gets mixed up and the swarm loses safety guarantees.
IROS1cA Human Reasons-based Supervision Framework for Ethical Decision-Making in Automated VehiclesSelf-driving cars strictly follow traffic rules even when a person would bend them slightly to be safer or more efficient.
IROS1cEfficient Navigation for Quadruped Robots in Post-Disaster ScenariosFour-legged robots in disaster zones with fire, smoke, and broken terrain get tired quickly and risk tipping over.
IROS1cDynamic Residual Safe Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Agent Safety-Critical Scenarios Decision-MakingSelf-driving cars with multiple robots struggle to predict when they might hit each other, so they either stop too often or take unsafe risks.
IROS1cDBaS-Log-MPPI: Efficient and Safe Trajectory Optimization via Barrier StatesPath planning for robots struggles to stay safe in tight spaces while still being able to explore when there's room to move.
IROS1cQuantifying and Modeling Driving Styles in Trajectory ForecastingSelf-driving car training data doesn't capture unusual or aggressive driving styles that happen in edge-case crashes, so the car can't predict dangerous situations.
ICRAPassivity Filters for Bilateral Teleoperation with Variable Impedance Control ↗When a person remotely controls a robot arm and the arm's stiffness changes during the task, the system can become unstable and behave in unsafe ways.
ICRAValidity Learning on Failures: Mitigating the Distribution Shift in Autonomous Vehicle PlanningA self-driving car trained by copying expert drives makes growing errors once it reaches situations the expert never encountered, and there are no expert labels available for those failure states.
ICRAOptimal Framework for Constrained Admittance Path-Following ControlWhen a person guides a robot arm along a path, the arm can drift outside safe boundaries because standard force-following controllers do not enforce strict limits.
ICRAEnhancing Repeatability and Reliability of Accelerated Risk Assessment in Robot TestingSafety testing methods that use smart sampling (importance sampling) to find dangerous robot situations faster are not guaranteed to give the same risk estimate each time you run them, or across different robot designs, which makes it hard to use them as a standard.
ICRAPersonalizing Interfaces to Humans with User-Friendly PriorsA robot's indicator signals (lights, sounds, motions) mean different things to different people, so the robot often fails to communicate what it intends.
ICRAGuaranteed Reach-Avoid for Black-Box Systems through Narrow Gaps via Neural Network ReachabilityWhen a robot's internal physics are unknown, it is very hard to mathematically prove it will reach a goal while staying safe — especially in tight spaces.
ICRAPolyhedral Collision Detection via Vertex EnumerationWhen planning motion paths for robots with flat-sided shapes, there is no smooth, easy-to-compute measure of how far two objects are from touching, which makes math-based path planning unreliable.
ICRAEnhancing 3D Robotic Vision Robustness by Minimizing Adversarial Mutual Information through Curriculum Training3D vision models used in safety-critical robots are easy to fool with small deliberate changes to sensor data, because point cloud data is sparse and high-dimensional.
ICRAFoundation Models for Rapid Autonomy ValidationTesting whether a self-driving car is safe requires running millions of simulation scenarios to find rare crashes, which takes far too much computing time when scenarios are sampled randomly.
ICRASafePCA: Enhancing Autonomous Robot Navigation in Dynamic Crowds Using Proximal Policy Optimization and Cellular AutomataA robot moving through a crowd must avoid people without slowing down so much that it never reaches its goal, and standard learning-based controllers are not good at predicting where risky areas will form.
ICRAParallel-Constraint Model Predictive Control: Exploiting Parallel Computation for Improving SafetyPlanners for safety-critical robots that look several steps ahead often can't guarantee the robot stays out of danger, because a single safety check at one point in the plan isn't enough.
ICRARelAIBotiX: Reliability Assessment for AI-Controlled Robotic SystemsStandard safety and reliability checks do not work for robots controlled by AI because the AI is a black box that changes often, so nobody can say how reliable the system actually is.
ICRATowards Transparent Multi-Agent Autonomous Systems Through Principled Multi-Source Knowledge DistillationMulti-robot navigation policies trained with deep learning are black boxes — engineers and users can't see why the robots make the decisions they do, which makes debugging and trust difficult.
ICRAQuasiNav: Asymmetric Cost-Aware Navigation Planning with Constrained Quasimetric Reinforcement LearningStandard robot navigation training assumes it costs the same to travel in either direction, but real terrain like hills costs more energy one way than the other.
ICRAUA-PnP: Uncertainty-Aware End-to-End Bird's Eye View Visual Perception and Prediction for Autonomous DrivingSelf-driving perception systems that predict future vehicle positions from camera images do not know how confident to be in those predictions, so errors in bad weather or low light pass through the system unchecked.
ICRARisk-Aware Integrated Task and Motion Planning for Versatile Snake Robots Under Localization FailuresSnake robots exploring rough terrain lose track of their position often because their sensors have a limited view, and planning safe paths under that uncertainty is too slow with current methods.
ICRAMulti-Layered Safety of Redundant Robot Manipulators Via Task-Oriented Planning and ControlRobot arms with extra joints working near people or moving objects can hit those objects, and existing systems handle planning and collision response separately rather than together.
ICRAAnomalies-by-Synthesis: Anomaly Detection using Generative Diffusion Models for Off-Road NavigationA robot driving off-road needs to spot unexpected or dangerous things in the scene that it has never seen before, but you cannot train it on examples of every possible danger.
ICRACombined Modal Robust Cascade Control for Wheeled Self-Reconfigurable Robots Under Drive Failure and Safety ThreatRobots made of multiple wheeled modules that can join into different shapes need to keep moving safely even when one of the drive wheels fails or when sensor readings are noisy.
ICRAHGAT-CP: Heterogeneous Graph Attention Network for Collision Prediction in Autonomous DrivingPredicting whether a collision will happen requires understanding how vehicles and road lanes interact with each other over time, but writing rules for all those interactions by hand is hard and incomplete.
ICRAMulti-Task Robustness Enhancement Framework against Various Adversarial PatchesSticking a specially designed printed patch on a car or sign can fool a self-driving vehicle's cameras into misidentifying objects, and most defenses only work against specific known attack styles.
ICRARAIL: Reachability-Aided Imitation Learning for Safe Policy ExecutionRobots trained by copying human demonstrations can still take unsafe actions, and there is no clean way to guarantee they stay safe without retraining them from scratch.
ICRAFedDet: Data Poisoning Attack Detection for Federated Skeleton-based Action RecognitionWhen many devices together train a model to recognize human movements from skeleton data, one bad actor can secretly corrupt the shared training data and break the model.
ICRAThe Impact of Sensor Faults on Connected Autonomous Vehicle LocalizationWhen sensors on self-driving cars malfunction, incorrect position estimates shared between cars can go undetected, creating safety hazards.
ICRARao-Blackwellized POMDP PlanningWhen a robot has to make decisions under uncertainty (a POMDP), tracking possible states with many random samples gets very slow and inaccurate as the number of things to track grows.
ICRASafety-Critical Locomotion of Biped Robots in Infeasible Paths: Overcoming Obstacles During Navigation Toward DestinationTwo-legged robots walking through cluttered spaces will sometimes bump into things they cannot avoid, and standard safety controllers cannot handle those bumps without stopping to re-plan the whole path.
ICRADreamFLEX: Learning Fault-Aware Quadrupedal Locomotion Controller for Anomaly Situation in Rough TerrainsA four-legged robot falls or gets stuck on rough ground when one or more of its joints seize up or overheat, and existing controllers do not know how to adapt to that.
ICRAFault Management System for the Safety of Perception Systems in Highly Automated Agricultural MachinesSelf-driving farm machines can have their cameras and sensors blocked or degraded by mud, sunlight, or rain, and the machine needs to detect this automatically before it causes an accident.
ICRAFuzzRisk: Online Collision Risk Estimation for Autonomous Vehicles Based on Depth-Aware Object Detection via Fuzzy InferenceSelf-driving cars cannot directly tell when their 3D object detector is making errors, so they have no reliable way to warn about hidden collision risk.
ICRACOLA: Characterizing and Optimizing the Tail Latency for Safe Level-4 Autonomous Vehicle SystemsSelf-driving car software sometimes takes much longer than usual to finish a sensing-and-planning cycle, and those rare slow moments can be dangerous because the car is not responding fast enough.
ICRARetinex-BEVFormer: Using Retinex to Enhance Multi-View Image-Based BEV Detector in Low Light ScenesCameras used for self-driving 3D object detection work well in daylight but miss objects at night because low light makes features hard to extract.
ICRAReal-World Automated Vehicle Longitudinal Stability Analysis: Controller Design and Field TestSpeed controllers for self-driving cars are designed assuming the car reacts instantly, but real cars have a delay of about a third of a second, so the controllers behave differently than predicted.
ICRANeural Lyapunov Function Approximation with Self-Supervised Reinforcement LearningIt is too hard to calculate, by hand or standard methods, a stability certificate for complex robot control systems, and neural-network versions miss parts of the state space they have not seen enough of.
ICRAMonLog: MONotonic-Constrained LOGistic Regressions for Automated Safety Curve DesignRobot safety speed limits are currently drawn as straight lines by hand, which is overly cautious and has to be redone whenever the task changes.
ICRAWould You Trust Me Now? A Study on Trust Repair Strategies in Human-Robot CollaborationWhen a robot makes a mistake, it is not known which response — saying sorry, denying fault, or offering compensation — best rebuilds the person's trust, and whether the answer depends on the type of mistake and the person's general trust level.
ICRANeural $\mathcal{L}_{1}$ Adaptive Control of Vehicle Lateral DynamicsKeeping a car in its lane is hard when the car's handling changes in ways that are not measured or modeled.
ICRAAnti-Sensing: Defense Against Unauthorized Radar-Based Human Vital Sign Sensing with Physically Realizable Wearable OscillatorsUltra-wideband radar can measure a person's heart rate through walls without their knowledge or consent, which is a serious privacy risk in spaces where robots operate.
ICRAMulti-Task Invariant Representation Imitation Learning for Autonomous DrivingA driving policy trained by copying human demonstrations learns habits that only work in the training area and makes unsafe choices elsewhere because it has learned irrelevant cues alongside the real ones.
ICRAA Novel Dynamic Motion Primitives Framework for Safe Human-Robot CollaborationTeaching a robot a motion by demonstration and then asking it to repeat that motion in a slightly different situation often produces strange, unsafe movements near a human co-worker.
ICRADistributed Pursuit of an Evader with Adaptive Robust Path Control Under State Measurement UncertaintyWhen multiple robots chase a target in an obstacle-filled space, sensor noise in position measurements can lead to collisions or failure to catch the target.
ICRAOptimal Motion Planning for a Class of Dynamical SystemsPlanning the best path for a robot while guaranteeing it stays safe and actually reaches its goal at the same time is an open theoretical challenge for many types of systems.
ICRAUpdating Robot Safety Representations Online From Natural Language FeedbackRobots working in homes encounter hazards specific to that home that no one could predict or program in advance.
ICRAExplainable Reinforcement Learning via Dynamic Mixture PoliciesNeural network controllers trained by trial-and-error (reinforcement learning) make decisions no one can understand, which blocks their use in situations where safety matters.
ICRAA Fairness-Oriented Control Framework for Safety-Critical Multi-Robot Systems: Alternative Authority ControlWhen multiple robots share a space, they can get stuck or act unfairly if one robot always gets to plan first while others just react to it as if it were a wall.
ICRAOptimal Fault-Tolerant Control for Tugboats Robust Path Following in NearshoreAutonomous tugboats need to stay on course even when ocean waves push them around and one or more thrusters lose power at the same time.
ICRAEvaluating Robotic Performative Autonomy in Collaborative Contexts Impacted by LatencyIt is not known how communication delay affects whether it helps or hurts for a robot to act less capable than it is — a strategy meant to keep the human more engaged and aware.
ICRAExact Imposition of Safety Boundary Conditions in Neural Reachable TubesA method that uses a neural network to compute safe regions for a robot (called DeepReach) gives wrong answers near the edges of those regions because the boundary rules are only loosely enforced during training.
ICRAImpossibility of Self-Organized Aggregation Without ComputationIt was an open question whether a tiny, memoryless robot with no onboard computing could run a fixed rule that always gathers any number of such robots into one group.
ICRADistributed Perception Aware Safe Leader Follower System via Control Barrier MethodsIn a robot formation, each follower must keep the leader inside its camera view at all times or it loses track of where the leader is, but this requirement conflicts with normal movement goals.
ICRAFrom Configuration-Space Clearance to Feature-Space Margin: Sample Complexity in Learning-Based Collision DetectionCollision-detection classifiers trained from data have no clear rule for how many training examples are needed to be reliably accurate enough for safe motion planning.
ICRAA Large-Scale Dataset for Humanoid Robotics Enabling a Novel Data-Driven Fall PredictionHumanoid robots need to predict falls before they happen so they can protect themselves, but no large set of real sensor recordings from actual robot falls existed to train such a predictor.
ICRASemantic and Feature Guided Uncertainty Quantification of Visual Localization for Autonomous VehiclesSelf-driving cars that locate themselves using cameras cannot reliably say how uncertain that location estimate is, especially in bad weather or poor lighting where errors do not follow a simple bell-curve pattern.
ICRADetecting Perception-Based Attacks using Visual Odometry: Inconsistency Modeling and Checking on Robotic StatesRobots can be fooled by attacks that spoof their position signal, hide obstacles, or mislabel objects — and these look very different from each other, making a single detector hard to build.
ICRAUncertainty-Guided Enhancement on Driving Perception System Via Foundation ModelsLarge AI foundation models can improve driving perception but calling them on every image is too expensive in time and money.
ICRAOn the Synthesis of Reactive Collision-Free Whole-Body Robot Motions: A Complementarity-Based ApproachRobot arms with many joints need to avoid collisions across their entire body surface in real time, including when objects around them are moving.
ICRAUncertainty-Aware Probabilistic Risk Quantification of SOTIF for Autonomous VehiclesCurrent safety checks for self-driving cars do not properly measure the risk that comes from uncertain or changing conditions in the environment, which is required for a safety standard called SOTIF.
ICRASafe Control of Quadruped in Varying Dynamics via Safety Index AdaptationA safety rule computed for a robot at one load or condition becomes invalid when that condition changes, such as when a walking robot picks up a heavier object.
ICRASafety Guaranteed Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Hierarchical Control for Connected and Automated VehiclesCoordinating a group of self-driving cars in mixed traffic must guarantee no collisions at every moment, even when sensor readings are noisy or incomplete.
ICRARelevance-Driven Decision Making for Safer and More Efficient Human Robot CollaborationRobots working alongside people cannot tell which nearby objects or people actually matter for the current task, so they waste time on irrelevant things and risk collisions with important ones.
ICRAPrepared for the Worst: Resilience Analysis of the ICP Algorithm via Learning-Based Worst-Case Adversarial AttacksIt is hard to know in advance where a laser-scan localization algorithm called ICP will fail badly when the sensor data is corrupted by bad weather, obstacles, or sensor faults.
ICRAComputationally and Sample Efficient Safe Reinforcement Learning Using Adaptive Conformal PredictionTeaching a robot to control itself safely when the physics are unknown requires both good estimates of uncertainty and enough data to learn efficiently, and existing methods struggle to provide both at once with safety guarantees.
ICRAA Generalized Control Revision Method for Autonomous Driving SafetySafety filters for self-driving cars that use mathematical safety boundaries (Control Barrier Functions) break down when sensor data comes in mixed formats or when many different traffic rules need to be handled at once.
IROSScalable Offline Metrics for Autonomous DrivingTests run without the car on the road often give a passing score to self-driving software that then fails when it actually drives, so the test scores are not useful predictors of real safety.
IROSReliable Multi-Level Optimization for Safe Predictive Control of Autonomous Vehicles to Avoid Uncertain Multimodal PLEVs ↗Self-driving cars need to stay safe around pedestrians and scooter riders who could go in several possible directions at once, but computing a safe path around all those possibilities quickly is very hard.
IROSManeuverGPT Agentic Control for Safe Autonomous Stunt ManeuversSelf-driving cars have no flexible way to perform tricky, high-speed maneuvers like a J-turn on demand without retraining the whole system.
IROSMulti-Robot Coordination in an Adversarial Graph-Traversal GameWhen a team of robots must cross a network of paths and an opponent can change those paths to slow them down, it is unclear how the robots should coordinate.
IROSDeep Equivariant Multi-Agent Control Barrier FunctionsTeaching a group of robots to stay safe around each other using learned safety rules doesn't scale well because the learning ignores the fact that the safety rules look the same no matter how the group is rotated or reordered.
IROSA Simple Approach to Constraint-Aware Imitation Learning with Application to Autonomous RacingWhen a self-driving car learns to drive by copying expert examples, it does not learn to stay within safety limits, so it breaks rules when pushed near the edge of its handling ability.
IROSUncertainty-Aware Multi-Robot Flocking via Learned State Estimation and Control Barrier FunctionsWhen some robots in a swarm move out of communication range, their neighbors do not know where they are, which breaks coordinated flight.
IROSImproved Free Motion Performance for TDPA-Passivated Position-Force Measured Teleoperation ArchitecturesA safety method used in remote robot control (TDPA) keeps adding unnecessary damping even when the robot is moving freely and not touching anything, which makes its motion drift and feel sluggish.
IROSDecentralized Multi-robot Navigation Policy with Enhanced Security Using Graph GRU Policy NetworkWhen many robots navigate together without a central controller, they crash into each other too often because existing learning-based methods give weak safety guarantees.
IROSEmergency Avoidance: Model Predictive Control Based Path Tracking for Unmanned Ground Vehicles with Active Obstacle AvoidanceHigh-level planners are too slow to react to obstacles that appear suddenly, so the vehicle's low-level controller also needs to be able to steer around them safely.
IROSTowards Physically Realizable Adversarial Attacks in Embodied Vision NavigationResearchers could fool a navigation robot in software but had no good way to do the same with a printed sticker in the real world that works from many angles and doesn't look suspicious.
IROSDual-Mode Passive Fault-Tolerant Control for Underwater Vehicles with Actuator Faults and Time-Varying DisturbancesUnderwater vehicles can have thrusters that partially or fully fail while also being pushed around by currents, and a single control scheme can't handle both small and large failures efficiently.
IROSStable Variable Impedance Control via CLF-MPC for Physical Human-Robot InteractionChanging how stiff or springy a robot arm is while a person is touching it can make the arm go unstable and behave dangerously, especially when forces change unexpectedly.
IROSA Real-Time Collision-Avoidance Motion Planner for Robot Soccer ↗Fast-moving soccer robots need to avoid collisions with many other moving robots in real time, but most planners are either too slow or too computationally heavy for that setting.
IROSDecentralized Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Agent Collision Avoidance With Model Predictive Path Integral*When multiple robots navigate near each other using only their own noisy sensors and no shared communication, they can collide because their collision avoidance rules do not account for measurement uncertainty.
IROSTowards Safe Imitation Learning via Potential Field-Guided Flow MatchingAI motion planners that learn from human demonstrations (using diffusion or flow matching) ignore obstacles when generating paths, so they can collide with things in the environment.
IROSWorld Models for Anomaly Detection during Model-Based Reinforcement Learning InferenceLearning-based controllers deployed in real-world robots may encounter out-of-distribution states that could cause unsafe behavior without task-specific anomaly detection.
IROSVision-Based Contact Wrench Estimation in Human-Robot InteractionWhen a person touches a robot at multiple points at once, measuring the exact push and pull forces at each contact is unreliable with joint sensors alone because the math has multiple valid solutions and the robot's own movement adds noise.
IROSA Whole-Body Unified Force-Impedance Control for Non-holonomic Service RobotsService robots on wheels that cannot turn in place need to push or pull on objects with the right force while also moving their whole body smoothly, and no existing control method handles both requirements together.
IROSSafe Probabilistic Planning for Human-Robot Interaction using Conformal Risk ControlRobots that dodge people have safety limits based on guesses of how the person will move, but those guesses are often wrong, so safety breaks down.
IROSSafe Motion Planning and Control Using Predictive and Adaptive Barrier Methods for Autonomous Surface VesselsBoats steering through tight rivers need to avoid crashes fast but can't be too careful or they'll get stuck and can't move.
IROSCDP: Constrained Diffusion Policies with Mirror Diffusion Model for Safety-Assured Imitation LearningWhen a robot learns to move by copying demonstrations using a diffusion model, the actions it generates can cross into forbidden zones like walls or obstacles because nothing in the process enforces hard boundaries.
IROSMADI: Malicious Agent Detection and Isolation in Mixed Autonomy Traffic SystemsIn traffic where self-driving and human-driven vehicles share the road, a bad actor can send false signals or drive to deliberately cause congestion or near-crashes.
IROSWhat Really Matters for Robust Multi-Sensor HD Map Construction?Systems that build detailed road maps by combining camera and LiDAR data work well in normal conditions but fail badly when sensors are dirty, blocked, or damaged.
IROSMitigating Hallucinations in YOLO-based Object Detection Models: A Revisit to Out-of-Distribution DetectionPopular YOLO object detectors sometimes detect objects that are not there, and the test sets used to measure this problem contain mislabeled images that make the detectors look worse than they really are.
IROSAS2FM: Enabling Statistical Model Checking of ROS 2 Systems for Robust AutonomyBefore deploying a robot system built with ROS 2, engineers cannot easily check whether safety and reliability requirements will hold in all possible operating conditions.
IROSEvaluating Robot Program Performance with Power Consumption-Driven Metrics in Lightweight Industrial RobotsThe usual ways to judge whether one robot program is better than another look at CPU usage and speed, but ignore how much energy the robot physically uses and how much wear it puts on its own parts.
IROSAdaptive Cartesian Position Control with a Switching Strategy for Robotic Manipulator with Mixed Rigid-Elastic JointsRobot arms that have both stiff and springy joints wobble and don't hold position well at the target, because uncertain motor and joint stiffness values make the end of the arm hard to stabilize.
IROSAll-in-one Defensive Network (ADNet): Trustworthy Segmentation of Complex Maritime Environments for Unmanned Surface Vessels (USVs)Cameras on unmanned boats can be deliberately degraded—by lens smears, glare, or camouflage paint—tricking the vision system into misidentifying ships and threatening navigation safety.
IROSRisk Euclidean Distance-based Model Predictive Path Integral to Safety-Critical Obstacle AvoidanceA popular sampling-based planning method (MPPI, which tests many random future paths to pick the best one) often finds only locally good paths and leaves too little space between the robot and moving obstacles.
IROSLow-Latency Privacy-Aware Robot Behavior guided by Automatically Generated Text DatasetsA robot needs to detect whether what it sees is private in real time, but collecting labeled images of private scenes raises ethical problems and large vision-language models are too slow.
IROSRobots that Suggest Safe AlternativesA robot trained to reach goals by copying human examples may do something unsafe or fail entirely when asked for a goal it has never seen before.
IROSAnalyzing Human Perceptions of a MEDEVAC Robot in a Simulated Evacuation ScenarioIt was unknown how the speed and autonomy level of a medical evacuation robot affect how safe people feel around it, whether they are the person being rescued or a bystander.
IROSSignal Temporal Logic Compliant Co-design of Planning and ControlGetting a robot to follow complex rules about where to be and when — such as 'reach zone A before time 10, avoid zone B always' — while also respecting its own physical movement limits is very hard to solve together.
IROSDisturbance Observer-based Control Barrier Functions with Residual Model Learning for Safe Reinforcement LearningSafety filters that keep a learning robot within safe limits assume the robot's movement model is accurate, but real-world disturbances like wind and model errors can break those safety guarantees.
IROSA Deep Reinforcement Learning based End-to-End Control Framework for Lower Limb Exoskeletons with Smooth Movement TransitionsLeg exoskeleton controllers built as fixed state machines switch between walking modes in sudden jumps, which is uncomfortable and can be unsafe for users.
IROSThe Constitutional Filter: Bayesian Estimation of Compliant Agents ↗Tracking moving agents like ships is hard when those agents are supposed to follow rules such as traffic laws, because standard tracking methods ignore those rules entirely.
IROSMCE-based Direct FTC Method for Dynamic Positioning of Underwater Vehicles with Thruster RedundancyWhen one thruster on an underwater vehicle fails, detecting the fault and adjusting the remaining thrusters is hard without a detailed internal model of what went wrong.
IROSPrescribed-Time Safe Pursuit Control with Dynamic Obstacle and Occlusion AvoidanceA robot chasing a moving target must not hit obstacles, must keep the target in view, and must finish the task by a set deadline — doing all three at once is hard.
IROSFrom Learning to Mastery: Achieving Safe and Efficient Real-World Autonomous Driving with Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement LearningTeaching a self-driving car by trial and error on real roads is dangerous and takes too long because the car makes risky mistakes while learning.
IROSA Skill-Based Hierarchical Framework with Dangerous Action Masking for Autonomous Navigation of Jumping RobotsJumping robots navigating on their own get stuck or tip over often because jumps are hard to control and the robot can't see much of its surroundings.
IROSPoint Cloud-Based Control Barrier Functions for Model Predictive Control in Safety-Critical Navigation of Autonomous Mobile RobotsMobile robots need to avoid both standing obstacles and moving ones in real time, and they need a mathematical guarantee that they won't crash, not just a hope.
IROSReactive Temporal Logic Planning for Safe Human-Robot InteractionLab robots need to change their task order on the fly when something unexpected happens, while always keeping safety rules that were written in advance.
IROSSafe and Efficient Navigation for Differential-Drive Robots in Dynamic Pedestrian EnvironmentsRobot navigation systems around people often play it so safe that the robot moves slowly and takes long detours, making it impractical for time-sensitive tasks.
IROSCORENet: Cross-Modal 4D Radar Denoising Network with LiDAR Supervision for Autonomous Driving4D radar is useful in bad weather but its point clouds are too sparse and noisy to detect objects well, while lidar is accurate but breaks down in rain or fog.
IROSMMCD: Multi-Modal Collaborative Decision-Making for Connected Autonomy with Knowledge DistillationSelf-driving car systems that share data between vehicles break down when a sensor type is missing or a teammate vehicle is absent.
IROSDeep Learning-based Proactive Hazard Prediction for Human-Robot Collaboration with Sensor MalfunctionsIn settings where robots work next to people, a broken or noisy sensor may not be caught in time, and standard fault detectors do not predict whether the fault will actually cause a dangerous robot action.
IROSClosing the intent-to-behavior gap via Fulfillment Priority LogicTurning a list of competing goals — such as move fast but use less energy — into a single reward number for a learning agent is slow and breaks easily when goals conflict.

Soft and body-inspired machines 250 papers

The problem

Hard, rigid robots cannot bend, cushion, or squeeze through tight spaces the way a soft body can, which limits where they can go and how safely they can touch people or delicate tissue.

The approaches

Build bendable parts that can change how stiff they are, arms pulled by cables, robots that grow from their tip to snake through narrow passages, printable stretch sensors, muscle-like parts driven by electricity and fluid, and designs copied from living creatures.

How it solves it

A body that can flex and soften reaches and works safely in places a rigid machine cannot, and stays gentle when it touches people or tissue.
