ICRAVibrotactile Haptics with Soft Magnetoresponsive Surface InterfaceMaking a thin, flexible surface produce precise vibrations that a person can feel at specific spots is difficult with current wearable haptic devices.
ICRAMaterials Matter: Investigating Functional Advantages of Bio-Inspired Materials via Simulated Robotic HoppingRobot legs are almost always made from a single uniform material, even though the legs of animals have material properties that change gradually from top to bottom, and no one knows whether that matters for robot performance.
ICRACompliance Control with Dynamic and Self-Sensing Hydraulic Artificial Muscles for Wearable Assistive DevicesSoft wearable robots that help people move their arms use fluid-driven muscles that are hard to control precisely, and adding position sensors makes the device heavier and more complicated.
ICRADesign and Experimental Validation of Woodwork-Inspired Soft Pneumatic GrippersSoft robotic grippers that grip by inflating air pouches usually need high air pressure to hold a heavy load securely.
ICRAModel-Free Safety Filter for Soft Robots: A Q-Learning ApproachKeeping a robot safe when its exact physical behavior is unknown is hard because most safety tools require a precise mathematical model of the robot.
ICRADesign of a Novel Pneumatic Soft Gripper for Robust Adaptive GraspingSoft air-powered grippers are gentle and adaptable but usually cannot grip hard enough to handle heavier or trickier objects.
ICRADuolingo: Dynamics Utilization for Online Translation of ActionsSoft robots change how they move over time as their materials fatigue or stretch, so a controller trained on the original robot starts working poorly without any retraining.
ICRAPhysics-Informed Hybrid Modeling of Pneumatic Artificial Muscles ↗Muscles made of air-filled tubes (pneumatic artificial muscles) behave in ways that are hard to predict: simple physics equations miss important effects, and pure machine-learning models overfit to training data.
ICRAA Neural Network-Based Framework for Fast and Smooth Posture Reconstruction of a Soft Continuum ArmFiguring out the full shape of a flexible robotic arm from just a few position sensors along its length is slow with existing methods—too slow for real-time use.
ICRAImplicit Physics-aware Policy for Dynamic Manipulation of Rigid Objects via Soft Body ToolsUsing a soft tool like a rope to move a rigid object requires knowing the physical properties of the environment, which cannot be seen directly and can vary.
ICRASelf-Supervised Learning of Reconstructing Deformable Linear Objects Under Single-Frame Occluded ViewFiguring out the full shape of a rope or cable when part of it is hidden from the camera is hard, and existing methods either need lots of labeled training data or lack the big-picture context to handle occlusions.
ICRABraided Artificial Muscle with Programmable Body Morphing and its Application to Elbow Joint FlexionStandard pneumatic artificial muscles (air-powered muscles) can only shrink by a fixed maximum amount, limiting how well they can be tuned for wearable assistive devices that help people move their joints.
ICRANezha-Mb: Design and Implementation of a Morphing Hybrid Aerial-Underwater VehicleVehicles that need to fly in air and swim underwater struggle because the best shape for one environment — wide arms for flying — is the worst shape for the other.
ICRAGeometric Design and Gait Co-Optimization for Soft Continuum Robots Swimming at Low and High Reynolds NumbersDesigning a soft, flexible swimming robot's body shape and movement pattern at the same time — across both slow and fast fluid flows — is computationally very hard.
ICRAA Novel Under-Actuated Gripper Based on Passive-Locking Mechanism for Stable Gripping Under Environmental ConstraintsGripper fingers that adapt to object shape using passive joints can slip or drop an object if the object is swung or pushed sideways, because the joints can move after gripping.
ICRASoft Robotic Dynamic in-Hand Pen SpinningGetting a soft robot hand to spin a pen quickly and reliably is hard because soft fingers deform in ways that are hard to model mathematically.
ICRADeformable Multibody Modeling for Model Predictive Control in Legged Locomotion with Embodied ComplianceStandard motion controllers for legged robots treat the body as completely rigid, so they do not work well when the spine or limbs can actually bend.
ICRAA Variable Stiffness and Transformable Entanglement Soft Robotic GripperSoft robot grippers that grab objects by tangling flexible fingers around them fail on simple shapes like balls, cubes, and cylinders, and cannot hold heavy things.
ICRAA Novel Hybrid Hysteresis Modeling Method for Multiloop-Asymmetry Hysteresis Behavior of Nonlinear Compliant ActuatorsSoft and compliant actuators have a complex springback behavior (hysteresis) that is different on the push and pull strokes and changes shape across multiple cycles, and no existing model captures this accurately.
ICRAComposite Learning Neural Network Tracking Control of Articulated Soft RobotsSoft robots driven by paired muscles that can change stiffness are highly unpredictable, making it hard to control their movement accurately without a precise mathematical model of how they work.
IROSNezha-Morphing: Design and Experiments of a Seabird-Inspired Hybrid Aerial Underwater VehicleA vehicle that needs to both fly and swim faces a conflict: the wing and rotor layout that works best in air creates too much drag underwater, and shrinking for underwater operation makes flying unstable.
IROSTowards an Extremely Robust Baby Robot With Rich Interaction Ability for Advanced Machine Learning AlgorithmsLearning-by-trial-and-error (reinforcement learning) on a real robot requires many thousands of attempts, and most robots break long before the learning finishes because they are too fragile.
IROSDesign and Wrench-Feasible-Workspace Analysis for a Novel Cable-driven Parallel Robot with Movable Anchor WinchesRobots moved by cables are limited to a fixed region of space because the points where cables attach to the frame cannot move after the robot is built.
IROSStudy on Thunniform Robot Propulsion by Tail-flapping Speed ChangeA robotic fish that beats its tail at a fixed rate through each stroke cannot go as fast or use energy as well as it could.
IROSReal-Time Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Tasks with a Parallel Soft RobotSoft robots are hard to control because their bodies bend and deform in complicated ways, making standard control math and standard trial-and-error learning impractical on the real machine.
IROSA Ribbed Hybrid Rigid-Flexible Tail with Graded Stiffness and Anisotropic Friction for Enhanced Robot Locomotion and Fall Damage PreventionA climbing robot's tail needs to both press firmly against a surface to stop the robot from tipping backward and conform closely to that surface for grip — but making a tail stiff enough for one goal makes it too rigid for the other.
IROSOn the Design, Analysis, and Experimental Validation of Pneumatically-Actuated, Soft Robotic, Telescopic StructuresSoft inflatable telescoping tubes that extend when pumped with air have poorly understood relationships between their physical dimensions and how fast, far, and smoothly they extend, making intentional design difficult.
IROSMultimodal Deformation Estimation of Soft Pneumatic Gripper During OperationKnowing the exact shape of a soft inflatable gripper while it is moving is hard because the gripper bends in complex 3D ways that a single sensor can't capture accurately.
IROSModeling The States of Liquid Phase Change Pouch Actuators by Reservoir ComputingSoft pouches that expand using liquid-to-gas phase change are hard to model or control precisely because their inflation behavior is highly nonlinear and changes in complex ways.
IROSOsmosis-Driven Large-Scale Actuation for Shape-Shifting MechanismsSoft untethered robots need a way to move or change shape without carrying a battery or being connected to a power source.
IROSDevelopment of an Efficient Stiffness Modulation Mechanism in Fish-like Robots for Enhanced Swimming PerformanceA fish-like robot needs its tail to be stiffer at high speeds and more flexible at low speeds to swim efficiently, but adding a dedicated motor just to change stiffness adds weight and cost.
IROSAccurate Simulation and Parameter Identification of Deformable Linear Objects using Discrete Elastic Rods in Generalized CoordinatesSimulating flexible cables and wires accurately enough for robot training requires either a standalone simulator that cannot interact with other objects, or the built-in cable model in popular simulators like MuJoCo, which is not accurate enough.
IROSDMPBot: A high-speed, high-precision, omnidirectional, insect-scale piezoelectric robotTiny robots the size of insects powered by piezoelectric materials can either move fast or move precisely, but not both at the same time, and they usually cannot go in every direction.
IROSThree-DOF controlled flight in palm-scale micro robotic blimp driven by flapping wingsTiny blimps are hard to control in three directions without making them large and heavy or adding many moving parts.
IROSRobotic Manipulation of a Rotating Chain with Bottom End Fixed ↗A robot arm had no reliable way to shift a spinning chain from one stable spinning pattern to another.
IROSData-driven Visual Servoing of Flexible Continuum Robots in Constrained EnvironmentsSoft, flexible robots are hard to steer using cameras because their motion is hard to model mathematically and they bend in unpredictable ways when they touch walls or obstacles.
IROSStress-Driven Algorithm for Fiber Alignment in Smart Materials for Controlled Deformation in 4D-Printed Soft RoboticsIt was hard to figure out exactly how to print soft grippers so that they bend into the right shape, because the print path controls how the material curves.
IROSNeural-Link: Non-Overlapping MPC Fusion and Passive Inertial Sensing on Soft PlatformsSoft robots bend and flex, which shifts the cameras relative to each other in ways that standard sensor fusion math assumes never happens — so position and speed estimates go wrong.
IROSInstantaneous Contact Localization on A Magnetically Transduced Tapered WhiskerA whisker-like sensor can feel that something touched it, but figuring out exactly where along the whisker the touch happened from bending forces alone is mathematically ambiguous — the same bending can come from many different contact spots.
IROSA Novel Gripper with Semi-Peaucellier Linkage and Idle-Stroke Mechanism for Linear Pinching and Self-Adaptive GraspingMost parallel grippers move their fingertips in an arc rather than a straight line, so the fingers scrape the table surface or require the arm to lift before closing.
IROSViaTac: A High-Resolution Piezoresistive Tactile Sensor Array with Conformal Contact Surface for Shape ReconstructionTouch sensors for robots usually can't have both fine spatial detail and the ability to bend and conform to curved object surfaces at the same time.
IROSUnderstanding the Impact of Modeling Abstractions on Motion Planning for Deformable Linear ObjectsPlanning motions for flexible objects like cables or ropes is unreliable because the simulation model breaks down when the object is compressed and starts to buckle unpredictably.
IROSComputing forward statics from tendon-length in flexible-joint hyper-redundant manipulatorsLong snake-like robot arms driven by cables need to hold a position against gravity, but you cannot reliably measure cable tension during open-loop control, so computing the needed forces is very hard.
IROSEvaluating Computational Approaches to Metabolic Cost Estimation in Gait Assistance with a Passive Exosuit*Measuring how much energy a person saves while wearing a passive leg-assist suit normally requires lab equipment that most people cannot carry around.
IROSDesign of An Electromagnetically Modulated Resistance Mechanism to Realize Compact Passive Force-Feedback Wearable DevicesWearable devices that push back against your fingers to simulate touch or resistance are usually too bulky to carry because they need pumps or large motors.
IROSAntagonistic Physical-Virtual Framework for the Development of Soft ActuatorsSoft actuators — which bend or squeeze like muscle — behave in complicated ways that are hard to predict with math, so testing new designs takes many slow physical build-and-break cycles.
IROSModel Predictive Control for Cable-Driven Remote Actuation Systems with Friction and ComplianceRobots that use cables routed through flexible sheaths to move a distant joint are hard to control precisely because friction and springiness in the sheaths are usually ignored by the controller.
IROSTouch-Sensitive Hand Interactions for Social Robots Using Fiber Bragg Grating SensorsSocial robots need to tell apart many kinds of physical contact from people — like a tap, a handshake, or a hit — and simple sensors often cannot make those fine distinctions.
IROSSelf-Sensing Liquid Crystal Elastomer Actuator with Magnetic-Thermal SynergySoft robot actuators that can both move and sense their own position usually need separate components for each, which makes the design more complex and easier to break.
IROSTransSoft: The Low-Cost, Adaptable, and Radial Reconfigurable Soft Hand for Diverse Object GraspingSoft robot hands are usually built for one type of object and struggle badly with objects of very different sizes or shapes.
IROSMODUR: A Modular Dual-reconfigurable RobotRobots made of many connectable modules need to both change how modules link together and change the shape of each module — but most designs only support one of those two things.
IROSBio-Skin: A Cost-Effective Thermostatic Tactile Sensor with Multi-Modal Force and Temperature DetectionExisting touch sensors for robot hands measure only one type of force, cannot sense temperature, and are too expensive to put on many fingers.
IROSDesign of a Six-Bar Linkage-Inspired Reversible Wing for Stopped-Rotor VehiclesAircraft that stop their rotors mid-flight and glide need wings that can flip their leading and trailing edges—but flipping must not make the wing floppy under air load.
IROSA Novel Aerial-Aquatic Locomotion Robot with Variable Stiffness Propulsion ModuleA single robot that must fly in air and swim underwater needs propellers that work well in both settings, but propellers optimized for one medium perform poorly or cause harm in the other.
IROSA Compliant Tube for Series Elastic Actuators to Generate High Output TorqueActuators that use a spring between the motor and the load need springs that are both compact and capable of handling high torque, but standard spring shapes can't do both at once.
IROSHigh DOF Tendon-Driven Soft Hand: A Modular System for Versatile and Dexterous ManipulationBuilding a soft robot hand with many joints that can also be reconfigured for different tasks is very hard because fingers are not interchangeable and controlling many joints at once is complex.
IROSObservation of Snails and a Bionic Snail Robot Crawling with Distributed SuctionNo robot has yet combined wave-like body movement for propulsion with suction-cup grip to crawl on ceilings and vertical walls at the same time.
IROSOffline Reinforcement Learning with Koopman Operators for Control of Soft RobotsSoft robots are hard to control because their motion is highly nonlinear, and teaching a controller by trial-and-error in the real world or in simulation is slow and risky.
IROSVision Guided Cable Installation in Constraint Environments Utilizing Parametric Curve RepresentationInstalling a flexible cable in a cluttered space is hard because the cable bends unpredictably and robots cannot rely on precise physical models of the parts around it.
IROSAnalysis and Design of a Bistable Tail for a Hybrid Throwbot in a Step-Overcoming ScenarioA robot that can be thrown and then drive needs a tail that bends out of the way when it is a ball but locks rigid when it is rolling, and existing rigid tails get in the way during the ball phase.
IROSStability Enhancement in Variable Morphing Multi-body AUVs for Underwater Structure MaintenanceAn underwater robot made of linked segments that can change shape risks tipping over or losing its orientation when ocean currents change or it shifts its own geometry.
IROSDesign Optimization of Three-Dimensional Wire Arrangement Considering Wire Crossings for Tendon-driven RobotsLaying out the cables that pull a robot's joints in 3D is very hard to optimize because existing tools either flatten the problem to 2D or ignore wires crossing each other, leaving many designs untested.
IROSDynamic-Characteristics-Based Continuous Impact-Minimizing Rolling Locomotion for Variable Topology TrussTruss robots that reconfigure their structure to move forward have to stop and reset between each step, which makes them slow and causes hard joint impacts.
IROSDevelopment of an under-actuated tendon-driven planar elephant robot based on synergistic motion analysisControlling an elephant trunk-like robot requires managing many joints, which normally demands one motor per joint and quickly becomes impractical.
IROSOn the Design of Fast-Response Variable-Stiffness Continuum Robot with Electro-permanent Magnet-based Ball JointsFlexible robots that can change their stiffness switch between soft and rigid states too slowly, which rules them out for tasks that need a quick change.
IROSEducational SoftHand-A: Building an Anthropomorphic Hand with Soft Synergies using LEGO® MINDSTORMS®Students and educators rarely get hands-on experience with advanced robotic hand designs because real research hands are expensive and fragile.
IROSA Wearable Centaur Robot with Wheel-Legged Transformation for Enhanced Load-Carrying AssistanceCarrying heavy loads over long distances on varied terrain tires people out and raises the risk of injury, and current assistive robots cannot switch smoothly between wheels and legs.
IROSOrigami-Inspired Pneumatic Continuum Manipulator: Stiffness Modeling and ValidationKnowing how stiff an air-powered flexible robot arm will be under load — so it can be controlled precisely — is difficult because the arm can stretch a lot and its stiffness changes with pressure.
IROSArtificial Muscle: A Sarcomere-inspired Magnetic ApproachSoft robot muscles do not move the way real muscles do because they lack the layered, directional internal structure that real muscle fibers have.
IROSThe Parallel Pneumatic Artificial Muscle Platform Based on RBF Neural Network CompensationAir-powered artificial muscles are hard to control precisely because they are naturally nonlinear and real-world disturbances are difficult to model exactly.
IROSOccupancy-belief Planning of Plant Manipulation for StakingRobots staking plants in a nursery have to deal with floppy, unpredictable plant movement, making it hard to plan where to push without knowing where the plant will end up.
IROSMulti-Functional Granular Propulsion: Bio-Inspired Orientation Control and Local Fluidization for Crawl-To-Dig TransitionsNo existing robot can both drive on the surface of sand or gravel and then dig straight down into it using the same hardware.
IROSAbdominal Undulation with Compliant Mechanism Improves Flight Performance of a Biomimetic Robotic ButterflyIt was unclear whether moving the abdomen up and down — the way real butterflies do — actually helps a robotic butterfly fly better, because no one had built and tested it properly.
IROSAccelerating Inverse Kinematic Solutions for a Cable-Driven Soft Robotic Manipulator via Physics-Informed Neural NetworkFiguring out how much to pull each cable to put a soft robot arm in a desired position takes too long for real-time control because the arm bends in complex ways.
IROSVision-Based Tactile Sensor Using Light-Conductive Plate for Enhanced Force Sensing CapabilityTouch sensors on robot fingers are not sensitive enough to detect very small forces on soft or delicate objects.
IROSDesign of scalable orthogonal digital encoding architecture for large-area flexible tactile sensing in roboticsWiring up thousands of touch sensors on a flexible surface requires so many cables and takes so long to read that it becomes impractical.
IROSStatic Analysis and Modeling of a Trunk-Like Robot Capable of Adjustable Multi-Turn Helical DeformationA new mechanism that makes a soft robot arm curl into a tight helix is not well understood, so designers cannot predict how it will deform or optimize it.
IROSAchieving Lift-to-Weight Ratio >3.5 in Piezoelectric Direct-Driven Insect-Scale Flapping-Wing MAVsTiny flapping-wing drones driven by piezoelectric crystals cannot flap their wings wide enough to generate enough lift to carry any payload.
IROSGRIP: A General Robotic Incremental Potential Contact Simulation Dataset for Unified Deformable-Rigid Coupled GraspingLarge datasets for robot grasping only cover rigid objects because simulating soft or squishy objects during grasping takes too long to do at scale.
IROSCATCH-FORM-3D: Compliance-Aware Tactile Control and Hybrid Deformation Regulation for 3D Viscoelastic Object ManipulationControlling how hard a robot presses on soft, springy materials and how much those materials deform is very difficult because these materials both resist and slowly release force in ways that standard rigid-body models cannot capture.
IROSA Bio-inspired Stiffness-programmable Robotic Flexible Joint Based on Electro-adhesive ClutchesCurrent variable-stiffness joints change stiffness in all directions at once, so you cannot make one side of a joint stiff while keeping another side flexible.
IROSDesign and Performance Study of an Underwater Soft Snake-like RobotIt is not well understood how the phase timing between body segments, the stiffness of the tail, and how fast voltage ramps up together affect how fast and efficiently a soft snake robot swims.
IROSFlexible Electronic Device with Multifunctional Tactile Perception for Enhanced Robotic InteractionWearable controllers for AR/VR and robot teleoperation are either too bulky or can only measure one type of touch signal, making precise control hard.
IROSA Flexible Bending Sensor Based on C-Shaped FBG Array for Curvature and Gesture RecognitionMeasuring how much a robotic joint or finger is bending accurately requires a sensor that is very thin, sensitive, and not disrupted by nearby electrical signals.
IROSTowards the Benchmarking of Embodied Sensors for Pose Tracking in Octopus-inspired Robotic ArmsSoft continuum robot arms need sensors to know their own shape, but nobody has systematically compared different sensor types under the same conditions, especially underwater.
IROSA Bio-inspired Robotic Electric Ray Design of Multimodal Locomotion with Grasping FunctionUnderwater robots that use only one way of swimming trade off speed against turning ability, and most also cannot pick up objects.
IROSToward Dynamic Control of Tendon-driven Continuum Robots using Clarke TransformBuilding a physics model for a flexible robot arm driven by many cables is complicated because you have to track every cable and make sure they stay within their limits at all times.
IROSAnalysis and Experiment of a Pneumatic Linear Actuator Actuated by both Positive and Negative PressuresAir-powered linear actuators driven by pressure in only one direction cannot push or pull very hard, which limits where they can be used.
IROSStretchable and High-Precision Optical Tactile Sensor for Trajectory Tracking of Parallel MechanismsStretchy touch sensors cannot usually achieve fine position resolution because stretching distorts the sensor's signal in ways that are hard to separate.
IROSTarget Handling Modalities with Obstacle Avoidance for Planar Soft Growing Manipulator DesignDesign tools for inflatable growing robots treat target objects as points in space, which ignores that real objects have size and the robot must approach them in specific ways.
IROSNovel Cable Driven Fitness Gym Devices for Whole Body Weight TrainingGym equipment can't adjust how hard it pushes based on how you move, and there's no version that works both strapped to your leg and in a gym.
IROSNumerical Optimization-based Kinematics with Pose Tracking Control for Continuum RobotsBendy robot arms are hard to control because you can't easily measure how they're bent or calculate how they should move.
IROSFeedback Control of a Two-Degree-of-Freedom Electromagnetic Reluctance Precision Motion SystemTiny mirrors used in chip printing need to move left-right and tilt slightly at the same time in a space barely bigger than a grain of rice.
IROSLITHE-joint: Variable Stiffness Compliant Spherical Contact Joint in an Under-Actuated SystemSoft robot joints that bend two ways usually need two motors, making them heavy and complex.
IROSA Fast-moving Underwater Wall-climbing Robotic Fish Inspired by Rock-climbing FishUnderwater robots that climb walls move slowly or lose grip easily or get knocked off by water currents—the rock-climbing fish in nature solve all three problems, but that design has not been used for robots yet.
IROSBraking Control in Clutched-Elastic Robots: Coordinating the Underactuation-to-Actuation TransitionA robot arm with springs and a clutch needs to stop safely when the clutch is off and the arm is limp, then switch the clutch back on without breaking anything.
IROSCan Real-to-Sim Approaches Capture Dynamic Fabric Behavior for Robotic Fabric Manipulation? ↗It's unclear whether methods for measuring fabric properties in the real world and using them in simulation actually work well enough for robots to fold or shake fabric correctly.
IROSContrastive Autoencoder for Robust State Modelling of Soft Robots in Incomplete and Noisy EnvironmentsSoft robots with many sensors can't estimate their state when some sensors stop working or send corrupted data due to damage and material squishiness.
IROSSoft Actuators with Integrated Electrohydrodynamic Pump and Intrinsic ElectroadhesionSoft robot grippers need a pump to push fluid, a flexible arm to bend, and a way to grip—but putting all three together takes multiple separate pieces, making robots bulky and complex.
IROSWAVE: Worm Gear-based Adaptive Variable Elasticity for Decoupling Actuators from External ForcesRobot grippers need to be soft enough to protect things they grab, but the motor gets beaten up by forces from outside, and one design cannot do both.
IROSBlueKoi: Combining a Tuna-Inspired Tail and Koi-Inspired Body Bending for ManeuverabilityFish-like robots are fast with a stiff tail but cannot turn tight, and flexible bodies turn well but are slow.
IROSDevelopment of a Soft Robotic Fish with Stiffness Modulation and Wriggling LocomotionRobotic fish with stiff bodies cannot change how rigid they are, so they struggle to adapt to different swimming situations and cannot squeeze through tight spaces.
IROSHierarchical Collision-Free Configuration Planning for a Soft ManipulatorSoft arms have many ways to bend, so it is hard to avoid obstacles, follow a path, and stay in a good shape for grabbing all at the same time.
IROSMarkov Parameters Generation for Data-based Modeling of Tensegrity Robots Considering Finite Word-Length EffectsComputer rounding errors in digital simulation mess up the math when trying to learn the robot's behavior from data, making the model wrong.
IROSSoft Electrohydraulic Actuators with Intrinsic ElectroadhesionSoft robot fingers that move by pushing liquid can't stick to things, so they can't hold objects without squeezing hard the whole time.
IROSDesign of a Module for a Modular Snake Robot with 3D LocomotionWhen a snake-like robot made of pieces tries to connect and disconnect from other pieces, someone has to manually plug and unplug them.
IROSSoft-Rigid Coupled Blade Leg Achieves Spatio-temporal Terrain Classification with Minimal Sensor ConfigurationWalking robots need to know what kind of ground they're on (mud, rock, sand) but most systems need many different sensors or active probing, which adds weight and power use.
IROSPNEUmorph: a shape-morphing interface comprising a pneumatic membrane constrained by variable-length tendonsSoft surfaces that morph by pumping air into them can only bend and change shape so much because the fixed outer layer stops them.
IROSAutonomous Obstacle Avoidance for a Snake Robot with Surface Pressure SensingSnake robots bump into obstacles because they don't know what's around them and can't change how they move automatically.
IROSOpen-loop Deep Reinforcement Learning Control of Soft Robotic In-hand ManipulationsSoft gripper fingers bend and flex unpredictably, making it hard to control exactly what they do, especially if the robot can't adjust based on what it sees.
IROSDistributed Contact Sensing Enabled by Vibration Propagation on Robot End-EffectorRobots cannot touch things with full feedback across their entire gripper without adding too many sensors and electronics.
IROSPose Estimation of a Cable-Driven Serpentine Manipulator Utilizing Intrinsic Dynamics via Physical Reservoir ComputingIn flexible cable-driven robot arms, the cables sag and stretch, and the links bend, so where the tip actually is does not match the math calculations.
IROSDesign and Control of a 6-DOF Fully Actuated Aerial-Aquatic Robot with Thrust VectoringRobots that work in both air and water don't work well in either medium because their bodies have to compromise.
IROSCrawler Robot with Movable Bending Point for Enhanced TraversabilityCrawler robots with a fixed bend cannot squeeze through tight spaces or climb over steps and gaps.
IROSDesign of a swimming microrobot powered by a single piezoelectric benderTiny underwater robots that can fit in tight spaces need enough power to swim well, but they're so small there's barely room for any motor.
IROSA Lightweight 3-axis Permanent Magnetic Sponge-based Self-Adapting Tactile SensorTouch sensors for robots can't easily sense both gentle and strong contact at the same time without being reset or recalibrated.
IROSUnderwater Exosuit Actuator Design for Unrestricted Bidirectional Hip Assistance During Flutter KickingDivers need wearable devices that help them kick without restricting movement when the device is off.
IROSZS-Puffin: Design, Modeling and Implementation of an Unmanned Aerial-Aquatic Vehicle with Amphibious WingsVehicles that fly and swim need separate engines for air and water, adding weight, complexity, and risk to animals in the water.
IROST-Touch: a Soft Thermal-haptic Multimodal Fingertip Wearable Device for Immersive Virtual RealityGloves for VR feel clunky, strain your hand, and only buzz—they don't feel hot or cold.
IROSPneuChip: A Compact Pneumatic Controller for Large-scale Soft Artificial MusclesSoft robots with many air muscles get too complicated to control because you need a separate tube for each one.
IROSAn insect-scale multimodal amphibious piezoelectric robotTiny robots that work both on land and water are limited to one way of moving and need lots of separate actuators to switch modes.
IROSBioinspired Directional Adhesives Enable High Stiffness Layer Jamming in Soft Actuators *Soft grippers bend and squish too easily under load, so they cannot grip with force or precision without deforming wildly.
IROSA Bionic Robotic Hand Designed with Multiple Grasping Modes and Magnetic-tactile PerceptionRobotic hands can only grab one way, and they can't feel whether they're holding something tight or what the object is like.
IROSEDeformNet: Estimating Fishing Net Deformations from Sparse ObservationsFishing boat crews can't see exactly what shape their nets are underwater when the nets are deployed.
IROSDesign and Characterization of a Thermal-electrostatic Dual-modal Soft Pouch MotorSoft robot arms can either move slowly with lots of force or quickly with little force, but not both in one gripper.
IROSRoboNotonecta: A Backswimmer-inspired Swimming Miniature Robot with Efficient Low-power Propulsion and Agile Aquatic ManeuverabilityTiny swimming robots can't combine both strong, efficient pushing and sharp turning for exploring water and monitoring environments.
IROSA Soft Active Surface Gripper for Safe In Hand Manipulation of Fragile ObjectsPicking up and sliding delicate things (like eggs) around in your hand is risky—they crack if you squeeze too hard or rub them wrong.
IROSUni-Zipper: A Multi-modal Perception Framework of Deformable Objects with Unpaired DataAdding new sensors to a robot (vision, touch, depth) needs tons of matching data of both types, which is slow and costly to collect.
IROSDual-Modal Magnetic Skin for Robust Tactile SensingTouch sensors that use magnets get confused by stray magnetic fields in real workplaces, giving wrong readings.
IROSSoft Tactile Sensors for Robot Grippers Using Acoustic SensingGrippers with touch sensors are expensive and hard to build, so many robots can't afford good feel.
IROSMuxHand: A Cost-Effective and Compact Dexterous Robotic Hand Using Time-Division Multiplexing MechanismRobotic hands need many expensive motors to move each finger independently, making them costly and large.
IROSAn Inflatable Deployable Origami Grasper for Adaptive and High-Load GraspingRobot grippers need to pick up all kinds of shapes and sizes, stay simple to build, and hold heavy things all at the same time.
IROSSkB-Hand: A Skeleton Bionic Hand with Dual-Tendon for General Purpose Robotic Grasping TasksRobotic hands that are light, cheap, and can grab many different shapes the way human hands do don't really exist yet.
IROSForce-Sensor-free Contact Estimation for Lower Limb Exoskeleton Robots Based on Probabilistic Modeling and FusionLeg exoskeletons need to know if the foot is touching ground on rough terrain, but they usually don't have force sensors installed.
IROSNUSense: Shear Based Robust Optical Tactile SensorTouch sensors based on light usually just measure how much the surface moves, missing important sliding forces that tell you how something feels.
IROSSPARK Hand: Scooping-Pinching Adaptive Robotic Hand with Kempe Mechanism for Vertical Passive Grasp in Environmental ConstraintsRobot grippers can pinch or scoop, but not both without extra motors, so they struggle with flat or thin objects against walls.
IROSTactile sensing soft fingertip with dual air bag structure for an anthropomorphic robotic handRobot hands need touch sensors in their fingers to feel things like texture and hardness, but cheap soft sensors don't work well.
IROSUncertainty-aware Motion Planning based on Stochastic Forward/Inverse Kinematics Models for Tensegrity Manipulators ↗Soft cable-driven manipulators are hard to control because their shape and stiffness change unpredictably as they move.
IROSM3D-skin: Multi-material 3D-printed Tactile Sensor with Hierarchical Infill Structures for Pressure SensingMaking touch sensors that fit any robot shape usually needs special tools and factories.
IROSA Convex Formulation of Material Points and Rigid Bodies with GPU-Accelerated Async-Coupling for Interactive SimulationSimulating squishy materials touching hard objects in real-time for robot gripping is too slow with current methods.
IROSEnhancing Continuum Robot Mobility: Design and Control with Integrated Dual Rotational DOFsSoft bendy robots can't twist along their length or fully control the hand's angle, limiting what they can do.
IROSPersonalized Reinforcement Learning Control of Soft Robotic Exosuit for Assisting Human Normative Walking with Reduced EffortSoft robotic exosuits can't adjust their help to match each person's unique walking style without knowing exactly how the suit and person interact.
IROSDesign and Dynamic Modeling Analysis of Undulatory Propulsion Underwater Robot with Rotational Passive Degrees of Freedom in Fin RaysUnderwater robots with wavy fins don't move well and it's hard to measure how water pushes on them.
IROSDesign and Development of a Propulsion Induced Rolling Spherical Tensegrity RobotCable-and-strut ball robots move by squeezing and bending, which wastes power and makes them unstable.
IROSA Crab-Inspired Soft Gripper with Single-Finger Dexterous Grasping CapabilitiesSoft grippers with many fingers can't squeeze into tight gaps or hold thin rods.

Medicine and surgery 340 papers

The problem

Medical jobs break the standard methods with their own troubles: tissue that shifts and deforms, curved anatomy that a straight tool cannot follow, narrow passages inside the body, and views from tiny cameras that are hard to rebuild in 3D.

The approaches

Control that accounts for soft tissue moving, steerable drilling and growing robots that follow curved paths, simulators that can cut and stitch soft tissue, and scene rebuilding tuned for inside-the-body views.

How it solves it

The basic sense-decide-move loop still applies; each medical setting just needs its own specific troubles handled directly and gently.

ICRASC-Former: A Segmentation Convolution Transformer for Lung Surgery RobotsSurgical robots need to find the faint lines between lung lobes in CT scans to plan cuts, but current methods produce too many false detections in areas with complex texture.
ICRAAutonomous Continuous Capsulorhexis Based on a Force-Vision-Guided Robot SystemCutting a precise circular opening (about 6 mm) in the lens capsule of the eye during cataract surgery requires extreme accuracy that takes surgeons years to develop and is hard to do consistently.
ICRAMinimally Invasive Endotracheal Inside-Out Flexible Needle Driving System Towards Microendoscope-Guided Robotic TracheostomyMaking a breathing hole in the throat (tracheostomy) by pressing from the outside is dangerous because the surgeon cannot see the inside of the airway, risking injury to the back wall of the windpipe.
ICRAAutonomous Bimanual Manipulation of Deformable Objects Using Deep Reinforcement Learning Guided Adaptive ControlMoving soft, deformable objects with two robot arms — as in surgery — is hard because the objects bend in complex unpredictable ways, and neither pure math models nor pure trial-and-error learning alone handles this well.
ICRAGeometry-Aware Volumetric Data Stitching Using Local Surface Mapping and Robot Optical Coherence TomographyA medical scanner called OCT can only image a tiny patch of tissue at a time, so scanning a large area produces many disconnected small images that must be stitched together accurately.
ICRATowards Autonomous Verification: Integrating Cognitive AI and Semantic Digital Twins in Medical RoboticsMedical robots struggle to check on their own whether they completed a task correctly when handling small, clear objects, without being retrained each time.
ICRAEfficient Optimization of a Permanent Magnet Array for a Stable 2D Trap ↗Holding a tiny medical robot in place using only permanent magnets is normally impossible because physics prevents a static magnetic field from trapping an object stably in free space.
ICRAWeakly-Supervised Learning via Multi-Lateral Decoder Branching for Tool Segmentation in Robot-Assisted Cardiovascular CatheterizationMarking every pixel of surgical tools in X-ray videos to train a tool detector is extremely time-consuming, but using only partial labels normally leads to poor detection.
ICRAOMASTAR Optimal Magnetic Actuation System ArrangementThe magnet rigs used to steer tiny medical robots inside a patient's body are too large to fit in a normal clinical room and still move the robot over the full area needed for treatment.
ICRAImage-Guided Surgical Planning for Percutaneous Nephrolithotomy Using CTRs: A Phantom-Based StudyChoosing the best entry point through the skin to remove a kidney stone with a thin tube robot requires planning software that has been validated on realistic physical models before it can be trusted in surgery.
ICRAAdvanced $X \theta$ Reluctance Electromagnetic Micropositioning System for Precision Motion ControlMoving a small component both sideways and rotationally with high precision in one compact unit — for example, to steer a laser beam — is hard to achieve in a single actuator.
ICRASurgPose: Generalisable Surgical Instrument Pose Estimation Using Zero-Shot Learning and Stereo VisionTracking the exact position and angle of surgical tools during robot-assisted surgery fails on tools the system was not trained on, because existing methods depend on markers or tool-specific labeled data.
ICRANon-Conservative Obstacle Avoidance for Multi-Body Systems Leveraging Convex Hulls and Predicted Closest Points ↗Collision avoidance on robots with many body segments moves too conservatively and can suddenly jump to a very different path when the closest pair of points between the robot and obstacle switches discontinuously.
ICRAIntegrated Motion State Prediction for Sit-to-Stand and Stand-to-Sit Motions Toward Effective Power Assist ControlA powered assistive device helping elderly people sit down or stand up needs to know they are about to move 300 ms before it happens, which is hard to do reliably from muscle signals.
ICRALearning-Based Tip Contact Force Estimation for FBG-Embedded Continuum RobotsMeasuring the push force at the tip of a thin flexible medical robot is difficult because conventional sensors do not fit inside such a small instrument.
ICRAMiniature Dielectric Elastomer Actuator Probe Inspecting Confined Spaces Embedding a CMOS SensorInspecting very narrow spaces in aircraft or the body requires a probe thinner than 2 mm that can still bend in multiple directions and see what it is looking at.
ICRARemote: Real-Time Ego-Motion Tracking for Various Endoscopes via Multimodal Visual Feature LearningTracking exactly how an endoscope camera is moving in real time is hard across different types of endoscopes because scenes look very different inside different body cavities.
ICRATowards Evaluating the User Comfort and Experience of a Novel Steerable Drilling Robotic System in Pedicle Screw Fixation Procedures: A User StudyIt was not known whether surgeons could comfortably and intuitively guide a steerable drilling robot along a curved path through bone during spine surgery.
ICRAAutomated Video Object Detection of Motile Cells Under MicroscopyDetecting moving cells like bacteria or sperm in microscope video is hard because motion blur, low contrast, and similar-looking background particles cause standard video detectors to fail.
ICRASLAM Assisted 3D Tracking System for Laparoscopic SurgeryTracking an organ in 3D during keyhole surgery is hard because the organ moves fast, is partly hidden, and the surgeon has no touch feedback.
ICRADesign and Evaluation of High-Performance Motion-Decoupled Cable Transmission ModulesPulling wires through curved tubes (Bowden cables) to control robot joints loses force to friction that grows sharply with how much the cable bends, but the low-friction alternative (capstan routing with ball bearings) is hard to set up for multiple cables.
ICRASelf-Sufficient 5-DoF Discrete Global Localization for Magnetically-Actuated Endoscope in BronchoscopyFinding the exact position and orientation of a magnetically steered endoscope inside the airways currently requires extra scanners or built-in sensors that make the device too large.
ICRAUnlocking Potential: Gaze-Based Interfaces in Assistive Robotics for Users with Severe Speech and Motor ImpairmentPeople who cannot speak or move their limbs have no good way to control a robot arm to do everyday tasks for them.
ICRAIntroducing Collaborative Robots as a First Step Towards Autonomous Reprocessing of Medical EquipmentAfter endoscopes are sterilized, trained staff must handle them through many precise steps to store them safely, and those steps are tedious, must stay sterile, and are hard to automate near people.
ICRASemi-Autonomous 2.5D Control of Untethered Magnetic Suture NeedleGuiding a tiny needle through tissue using only a magnetic field—with no wire attached to it—is hard to control precisely enough for surgical stitching.
ICRASampling-Based Model Predictive Control for Volumetric Ablation in Robotic Laser SurgeryA surgical robot burning away tissue with a laser needs to plan a precise sequence of laser pulses that removes the right volume without hitting surrounding healthy tissue, which is hard because the tissue's exact response to laser light varies.
ICRAA Simple Dynamics Model for Cable Driven Continuum Robots with Actuator CouplingFlexible robots driven by cables are hard to control in real time because accurate physics models of how they move are either too simple or too slow to compute.
ICRASim2real Within 5 Minutes: Efficient Domain Transfer with Stylized Gaussian Splatting for Endoscopic ImagesA camera inside the body looks very different from a 3D model built from a CT scan, so vision-based navigation trained on CT models fails when used during real procedures.
ICRAETSM: Automating Dissection Trajectory Suggestion and Confidence Map-Based Safety Margin Prediction for Robot-Assisted Endoscopic Submucosal DissectionIn a surgical procedure that removes tissue growths through an endoscope (endoscopic submucosal dissection), it is hard to automatically plan where the cutting tool should go while also marking which areas are safe to cut and which are risky.
ICRAIntraoperative Trocar-Based Eyeball Rotation Estimation Using Only 2D Microscope ImagesDuring eye surgery, tracking how the eye is rotated is very hard because the surgical microscope has a narrow view and the room lights are dimmed.
ICRAA Robust Deep Reinforcement Learning Framework for Image-Based Autonomous Guidewire NavigationAI systems trained to steer a thin medical wire through blood vessels in simulations fail when faced with real patient anatomy or conditions they have not seen before.
ICRAError-Subspace Transform Kalman Filter Based Real-Time Gait Prediction for Rehabilitation ExoskeletonsPredicting how a person's legs will move in real time during walking is hard because people walk differently from each other and change speed, and outside forces can disturb the pattern.
ICRATracking Everything in Robotic-Assisted SurgeryTracking tissue and tool motion across a whole surgical video is unreliable because surgical video has fast motion, things blocking the view, and blur.
ICRAHybrid Deep Reinforcement Learning for Radio Tracer Localisation in Robotic-Assisted Radioguided SurgeryDuring certain cancer surgeries a robot must find a tiny radioactive marker inside the body, but there is no camera view and the gamma-ray signal is noisy and hard to interpret.
ICRARobotic Tissue Manipulation in Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection Via Visual FeedbackDuring a type of gut surgery called endoscopic submucosal dissection, it is hard for a surgeon to hold tissue at the right angle in a very small space.
ICRARAR-6: An Optimized Reconfigurable Asymmetric 6-DOF Haptic Robot for Gross and Fine Motor TasksRehabilitation robots that use parallel arm structures are stiff and precise but have a small range of motion, which limits whether one machine can help with both big-movement and small-movement therapy tasks.
ICRASelf-Deformable Magnetic Miniature Robot for Traction Assistance in Endoscopic Submucosal DissectionA surgical technique that removes tissue from inside the stomach requires keeping steady tension on the tissue while cutting, but there is no small enough tool to do this through the same tube as the camera scope.
ICRAThree-Dimension Tip Force Perception and Axial Contact Location Identification for Flexible Endoscopy Using Tissue-Compliant Soft Distal Attachment Cap SensorsWhen a flexible endoscope touches tissue inside the body, doctors cannot feel how hard it is pressing or exactly where along the tip the contact is, which makes safe navigation difficult.
ICRACTS: A Consistency-Based Medical Image Segmentation ModelDiffusion-based models produce high-quality medical image segmentations but need many repeated computation steps at test time, making them too slow for clinical use.
ICRAEnsemble Control of a 2-DOF Parallel Link Arm in a Capsule Robot Using Oscillating External Magnetic FieldsDriving motors inside a swallowed capsule robot with a rotating magnetic field makes the whole capsule spin along with the motors, so the arm attached to it cannot move independently.
ICRACommand Filtered Cartesian Impedance Control for Tendon Driven Continuum Manipulators with Actuator Fault CompensationFlexible cable-driven robot arms need to feel soft and compliant to their environment, but when one or more cables fail or slip, the control system breaks down and the arm loses accuracy.
ICRAModel-Based Robotic Cell Aspiration: Tackling the Impact of Air SegmentWhen a robot pipette sucks up a single cell like a sperm cell, a small air gap inside the pipette acts as a spring that makes the cell's motion unpredictable, so the cell often ends up in the wrong spot.
ICRAIn-Plane Manipulation of Soft Micro-Fiber with Ultrasonic Transducer Array and MicroscopeMoving tiny flexible fibers (far thinner than a human hair) without touching them is very hard because existing sound-wave trapping tools were designed for rigid beads or cells, not long stretchy strands.
ICRAA Modified Resistance Model for Magnetic Honeycomb Robots to Navigate in Low Reynolds Number FluidsExisting math models for tiny swimming robots were not accurate enough to guide a honeycomb-shaped microrobot precisely through slow-moving fluids, which matters for tasks like delivering medicine inside the body.
ICRAThe qPCRBot: Combining Automated Data Handling, Standardization, and Robotic Labware Transport for Better qPCR MeasurementsLab technicians running qPCR tests (a method for measuring DNA) make manual errors moving samples, record data in inconsistent ways, and produce results that are hard to compare across labs.
IROSUsing virtual input rejection to improve control of a platform for characterizing the mechanical properties of human oocytes ↗Precisely pressing a tiny sensor against a human egg cell for medical testing is hard because small unwanted forces keep pushing the sensor off the right position.
IROSDesign Optimization of a Single-DoF Gait Rehabilitation Robot for a Domestic EnvironmentHome-use leg rehabilitation machines are usually complicated to set up and need a trained therapist to adjust them for each patient.
IROSEnhancing Multi-Task Motion Planning Based on Improved DMPs for Lower Limb ProsthesesProsthetic leg controllers built from textbook human-motion models tend to fail when the person stumbles or changes the kind of movement they are doing.
IROSPolicy Learning for Social Robot-Led Physiotherapy ↗A robot guiding physical therapy must adjust how hard it pushes each patient based on how tired or strained they are, but collecting data from real patients to train that behavior is difficult.
IROSVisual-Haptic Model Mediated Teleoperation for Remote UltrasoundDoing an ultrasound scan with a remote-controlled robot arm fails when the connection delay exceeds about one second, because the operator gets force feedback and video that are too far behind reality to work safely.
IROSEvaluating the Pre-Dressing Step: Unfolding Medical Garments via Imitation Learning ↗Robots that help people put on medical gowns assume the garment is already spread out flat, but gowns and aprons come out of storage folded, so there is a missing first step.
IROSWeight Regression for a Generalized Motion Primitive Formulation in Cooperative Hand Placement Tasks with Upper-Limb ProsthesesPeople who have lost an arm above the elbow need a prosthesis that can guide smooth reaching movements to any target, not just the specific targets it was trained on.
IROSWebRTC and 5G Based Remote Control System for a Vascular Intervention RobotPerforming remote surgery inside blood vessels requires sending control commands and live video with very low delay, and existing systems have not proven safe enough for real clinical use.
IROSHaptic Feedback Control Strategy for Microswarm Navigation in Flowing EnvironmentsWhen an operator remotely steers a swarm of tiny magnetic robots through moving fluid inside the body, they have no sense of what the swarm is doing, making precise control very difficult.
IROSProbabilistic Motion Model Learning for Tendon Actuated Continuum Robots with BacklashSoft robots driven by cables have slack and friction that cause the tip to end up in different positions even with the same cable inputs, making accurate tip-position prediction hard.
IROSSurgiPose: Estimating Surgical Tool Kinematics from Monocular Video for Surgical Robot Learning ↗Teaching a robot to perform surgery from video requires knowing exactly how the surgical tool was moving at each moment, but real operating-room videos have no such position or angle labels attached.
IROSSurgical D-Knot: Augmented Dexterity for Tying Double Knots by Monitoring Optical Flow in Monocular Attention WindowsTying a double knot during surgery using only a single camera is very hard because the camera gives no depth information and the thread must be handled with great care across many small steps.
IROSMethod for Sensing Lateral Force and Skidding on the Tool Tip in Surgical Robot Deep Bone DrillingWhen a robot drills deep into bone, the thin drill bit can slip sideways because of side forces at the tip that no existing sensor can measure at that depth.
IROSDesign of DNA Origami-Engineered Tetrahedral NanorobotsTiny robots made from folded DNA strands are not stable enough inside the body and do not release medicine reliably.
IROSVibration-Based Energy Metric for Restoring Needle Alignment in Autonomous Robotic UltrasoundWhen a needle drifts out of the slice of tissue shown in an ultrasound image, the robot loses track of it because the image becomes too noisy to see the needle.
IROSVisual Anomaly Detection for Reliable Robotic Implantation of Flexible Microelectrode ArrayWhen a robot inserts a tiny flexible electrode into brain tissue, it must catch micro-scale problems in real time — things like a bent needle or a bad attachment — even as lighting and camera angles change.
IROSMagnetic Microswarms with Controlled Locomotion in Liquid and Air EnvironmentsTiny magnetic robot swarms that could deliver drugs or fill tissue gaps need to work in both liquid and air, but swarms designed for one environment usually can't move well in the other.
IROSA VisuoMotor Human-Robot Interaction Framework for Attention-Motion-Integrated TrainingRehabilitation robots that train arm movement don't account for the fact that patients must also pay attention to a visual task at the same time, so the training doesn't match what real daily activities demand.
IROSHuman-In-the-loop Optimisation in Robot-Assisted Gait Training ↗Every person walks differently, so a one-size-fits-all exoskeleton assistance setting does not work well for gait rehabilitation.
IROSDevelopment of a Novel Miniaturized Dexterous Manipulator with Variable Stiffness for NOTESSurgical tools that enter the body through natural openings need to be very thin, yet also bend in many directions and carry enough load — existing designs cannot do all three at once.
IROSAutomatic Alignment of the Micropipette for Efficient and Precise Cell MicromanipulationAligning a glass pipette tip to the right spot under a microscope for handling individual cells is slow and error-prone by hand because the view is tiny and small manufacturing differences move the tip off-axis.
IROSNeural network control method for target tracking of magnetically actuated capsule endoscopic robots with obstacle avoidance and noise-resistant capabilitiesA swallowable camera capsule guided by magnets from outside the body is hard to steer precisely because its motion is highly nonlinear and the gut is a cramped space with obstacles.
IROSTFRR: A Novel Tensegrity-Based Fracture Reduction Robot with Force SensingWhen a robot repositions broken bones, it must keep the forces between bone fragments within safe limits, but measuring and controlling those contact forces precisely is difficult.
IROSVideo-Rate 4D OCT Segmentation Based on Motion-Aware Probabilistic A-Scan SamplingSurgeons could benefit from live 3D tissue scans during an operation, but processing the full 3D scan data fast enough to keep up with video rates is too slow for current computers.
IROSSpatiotemporal Motion Prediction of Intraocular Microsurgical Robot in Non-Visible RegionsDuring robot-assisted eye surgery, the surgical tool passes through parts of the eye that cameras cannot see, so the robot loses track of where the tool tip is.
IROSA Safe and Convenient Feeding Assistive Robotic Based on Multi-modal Interaction MethodRobots that help people eat struggle to handle unclear requests, detect when the person is still chewing, or respond quickly in an emergency without constant manual input.
IROSRegistration After Completion: Towards Sparse and Partial Point Set Registration for Computer-Assisted Orthopedic SurgeryDuring bone surgery, aligning a 3D scan of the patient's bone to a reference model is unreliable because the surgeon can only collect a small, partial set of surface points.
IROSHaptic-Informed ACT with a Soft Gripper and Recovery-Informed Training for Pseudo Oocyte ManipulationRobots that automate cell transfer (oocyte manipulation) fail silently when the grasp goes wrong because they rely only on camera images and cannot feel whether they are holding anything.
IROSA Physics-Informed Neural Network for the Calibration of Electromagnetic Navigation SystemsTiny robots steered by magnetic fields need accurate models of those fields, but standard neural network models can produce predictions that violate the laws of physics, reducing control accuracy.
IROSA Gait Phase Detection and Gait Spatio-temporal Features Extraction Method Based on the Inertial Measurement Unit*Stroke patients need a way to measure their walking quality at home, but clinical tools are not available outside a hospital.
IROSHead-mounted Robotic Needle Positioning: Learning from Augmented Reality Demonstration of Neuronavigation and PlanningTeaching a robot to position a needle for brain surgery is hard because surgeons operating a remote control do not have a clear view of the target, so their demonstrations are poor.
IROSAutonomous Suturing Method for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive SurgeryA surgical robot doing sutures on its own needs to grip the needle at exactly the right angle and place each stitch correctly, without a surgeon guiding it in real time.
IROSImplicit Disparity-Blur Alignment for Fast and Precise Autofocus in Robotic Microsurgical ImagingAutofocus on a surgical microscope either searches slowly through many positions or gets confused about which direction to move because blur alone does not tell you how far off focus you are.
IROSMicro-robotic Swarm of Silicone Oil-based Ferrofluid's MicrodropletsDelivering drugs or doing tiny procedures inside the body with microscale robots requires something that is safe for the body, small enough to move through narrow passages, and steerable.
IROSAn Improved A-Star Algorithm for Path Planning in Robot-Assisted Long Bone Fracture ReductionWhen a robot helps align broken bones during surgery, it needs a path through 3D space that avoids the surrounding bone fragments, but current methods are either too slow or not accurate enough.
IROSOn-Chip Dynamic Mechanical Characterization: from Cells to NucleusIt's slow and hard to test how hard cancer cells are to squeeze because you need special gear and can't mimic how cells act in a body.
IROSDesigning a Magnetic Endoscope for In Vivo Contact-Based Tissue Scanning Using Developable RollerEndoscopes steered by external magnets can only move in five directions, and rolling along their own axis — which is needed to scan tissue in a controlled pattern — is one they cannot do.
IROSTwo-dimensional Trajectory Tracking of a Magnetic Continuum Robot by Optimal Magnet ManipulationSteering a flexible magnetic robot through narrow blood vessels requires moving an external magnet in exactly the right position and angle, and this is hard to compute because the magnet both bends and pulls the robot at the same time.
IROSCapsDT: Diffusion-Transformer for Capsule Robot ManipulationTiny pill-sized robots that a doctor steers with magnets inside a patient's stomach cannot yet follow spoken or typed instructions to do useful diagnostic or treatment tasks on their own.
IROSGaze-Guided 3D Hand Motion Prediction for Detecting Intent in Egocentric Grasping TasksAn assistive robot watching through a person's own camera needs to predict where that person's hand is going and what object they intend to grab, before the grab happens, without knowing the object in advance.
IROSPhysics-Embedded Neural Networks for sEMG-based Continuous Motion EstimationEstimating continuous joint motion from muscle electrical signals (sEMG) either needs a complex body model that is hard to set up per person, or relies on pure data-driven methods that can produce physically impossible results.
IROSOn-Demand Motion Conversion of Magnetic Helical Microrobots Using Chemistry- and Microstructural-Modified Surface Wettability ModulationTiny magnetic spiral robots swimming in liquid cannot switch how they move on demand, and there is no easy way to tell one robot in a group to stop while the others keep going.
IROSNonlinear Viscoelastic Model-based Deformation Optimization for Robotic Micropuncture in Retinal Vein CannulationWhen a robot needle enters a retinal vein, the eye tissue pushes back and deforms in a nonlinear way that simple linear models cannot predict, leading the robot to press too hard and deform the tissue too much.
IROSDeep Reinforcement Learning-Based Levitation Control of Wireless Capsule Endoscope by Robotically Driven Permanent MagnetSteering a tiny camera capsule inside the body by moving an external magnet is hard to control because the magnetic forces are highly nonlinear and no simple math model captures them well enough for a traditional controller.
IROSEdge-Guided Lighting Adaptation: Real-Time Detection of Transparent Objects for Cell Culture RobotRobots that handle lab equipment struggle to detect clear glass and plastic containers because light passing through them blurs their edges and creates misleading reflections.
IROSHigh-Precision Parallel Manipulation of Multi-Particle System Using Optoelectronic TweezersMoving dozens of tiny particles at the same time with high accuracy is hard because coordinating the light patterns that push each particle and tracking all of them in real time is very complex.
IROSModel Predictive Control for 3D Steerable Needles: A Hierarchical Approach to Reduce Tissue TraumaSteering a thin flexible needle through 3D tissue requires spinning it, but sudden full spins tear tissue and current controllers do this too often.
IROSMultiphysics Model and Hysteresis Compensation for Control of Electroactive ActuatorsA type of flexible plastic actuator used in small surgical tools behaves unpredictably because its position depends not just on the current signal but also on its past signals, making precise control very hard.
IROSA Situation-Aware Autonomous Camera Alignment for Enhanced Suturing in Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive SurgeryDuring robot-assisted surgery, surgeons have to stop what they are doing to move the camera themselves, which slows them down and adds mental load.
IROSAn Open-Source Snake Hole-Digging Inspired Safety-Critical Insertion Planning and Replanning Framework for Continuum RobotsFlexible tube robots (continuum robots) cannot reshape their tail while being pushed into a space, and they cannot quickly replan a safe path when something moves into their way.
IROSOscillation Suppression of Acoustic Trapping: A Disturbance Observer-based ApproachMicroscopic particles held in place by sound waves (acoustic tweezers) keep vibrating because the sound forces are nonlinear and unpredictable, and a fixed sound field cannot compensate for them.
IROSsEMG-Based Continues Motion Prediction of Shoulder exoskeleton Control Using the VGANet ModelPredicting continuous arm angles from muscle electrical signals to control a shoulder exoskeleton requires capturing both which muscles fire together and how they change over time, which existing models handle poorly.
IROSDesign and Control of Soft Robotic Wearable with SMA-based Artificial Muscle Fibers for Ankle AssistanceAnkle-assist wearables need to be light and comfortable while still producing enough force to help with walking, which is hard to achieve with rigid motors.
IROSPhysics-Informed LSTM for Shape and Contact Force Prediction of a Flexible Surgical Robot*Knowing the exact shape and tip forces of a thin flexible surgical robot in real time is difficult, and attaching force sensors to the tip is not practical for procedures inside the body.
IROSEvaluating Generative Models for Inverse Kinematics of Concentric Tube RobotsThin flexible robots made of nested tubes used in surgery can reach a target position in many different ways, but there is no agreed method to check whether an AI model is finding a good spread of those solutions.
IROSTowards Deformation Modeling and Simulation of a Soft and Inflatable Endoscopic Vision-Based Tactile Sensing Balloon for Cancer DiagnosisDesigning the right balloon shape and material for an endoscopic cancer-sensing device requires many physical prototypes to test how it deforms under pressure, which is expensive and slow.
IROSDevelopment and Characterization of an Adaptive Baromorphic End-Effector for Precision Agricultural HandlingStandard harvesting machines grip with fixed force and shape, which damages delicate crops that vary in size and softness.
IROSDevelopment of a hard matter crushing peristaltic bioreactor inspired by an avian gizzard structure for Fermentation AccelerationStandard peristaltic bioreactors (devices that mix and process biological material by squeezing) cannot break up hard materials like agar gel well enough to speed up fermentation.
IROSSubject-Independent sEMG-Based Prosthetic Control Using MAMBA2 with Domain AdaptationControlling a prosthetic hand from muscle electrical signals (sEMG) works well for the person it was trained on, but the signals differ enough between people that the system must be retrained for each new user.
IROSManip4Care: Robotic Manipulation of Human Limbs for Solving Assistive TasksAssistive robots that help with bathing or dressing need to grasp and reposition human limbs safely, but no existing system handles the joint limits of the human body or the fact that the person may move.
IROSHigh-Precision Pose Estimation of Medical Targets Using a Distortion Compensation Model for Robotic Surgical NavigationCamera lens distortion causes position errors when a vision system tries to locate a surgical target such as a small hole in a bone implant, and those errors are too large for safe clinical use.
IROSDesign and Kinematics for the Cystoscope of a Transurethral Continuum Surgical Robotic SystemSurgeons need a bendable tool that curls sharply enough to reach any spot inside the bladder, but there was no math formula to tell the tool how to position itself.
IROSDesign and Integration of an Optical Frequency Domain Reflectometry (OFDR) Sensor with a Flexible Pedicle Screw for Biomechanical EvaluationDoctors cannot see in real time how much a new flexible screw bends as it goes into the spine.
IROSHandheld Confocal Endomicroscope System with Tremor Compensation for Retinal ImagingDoctors' hands shake when holding microscope cameras near the eye, and the lens keeps drifting out of focus, blurring the image.
IROSDevelopment of a 4-DOF Mobile Manipulator for Repetitive Gait Training on the Track for Stroke PatientsWalking-track therapy for stroke patients does not fix uneven or slow gait because nothing guides the patient's hand to give their nervous system steady touch-and-position signals while they walk.
IROSA Variable-stiffness Neck Exoskeleton with Pneumatic-driven Actuators for Prolonged Head Flexion AssistanceSurgeons who hold their heads bent forward for long operations develop neck and shoulder pain, and no existing device supports the neck without also blocking the head from moving freely.
IROSGaussian Splatting with Reflectance Regularization for Endoscopic Scene ReconstructionInside a body cavity, the camera and its light source move together, creating uneven lighting that makes it hard for 3D reconstruction software to tell the difference between surface shape and surface shine.
IROSHigh temperature sterilization resistant and enclosed three-axial force-sensing surgical instrument integrated with step-reduced FBGFiber-optic force sensors used in surgical robots need to survive repeated high-temperature steam sterilization and wet conditions, which destroys most current sensor housings.
IROSA Bio-inspired Spherical Soft Magnetic Millirobot for Gastrointestinal ApplicationsPill-sized cameras that doctors swallow cannot move on their own inside the stomach because surfaces there are wet and slippery.
IROSEnhanced Rolling Motion of Magnetic Microparticles by Turning Interface LubricationTiny magnetic robots that roll along surfaces move at speeds that are hard to control because a thin fluid layer between the robot and the surface keeps changing unpredictably.
IROSMechanism Design, Optimization, and Experimental Validation of an Ultrasound-Guided Series-Parallel Hybrid Robot for Prostate Transperineal PuncturePlacing a needle through the skin into the prostate by hand is technically demanding, and doing it accurately enough to hit small targets requires more practice than most clinicians can get.
IROSReinforcement Learning Assist-As-Needed Control Promotes Recovery of Walking Speed Following Ankle Weight PerturbationsAn ankle exoskeleton for rehabilitation needs to reduce its help as the patient improves, but fixed controllers cannot adjust to each person's changing ability.
IROSAn Evidence-Based Tri-Branch Cross-Pseudo Supervision Method for Semi-Supervised Medical Image SegmentationLabeling medical images is expensive, so models trained on very few labeled images produce bad guesses for unlabeled images, reducing accuracy in identifying structures like heart chambers for surgical robots.
IROSLip Geometry-Constrained Smooth Sliding Path Planning for Robotic Negative Pressure Therapy on ExtremitiesPlanning where a suction therapy head should slide along an arm or leg is difficult because the limb surface is irregular and the suction cup can only make a seal within a narrow angle.
IROSEIC Framework for Hand Exoskeletons Based on a Multimodal Large Language ModelHand exoskeletons can only do a fixed list of preset movements, so they fail when a user wants something not on that list.
IROSContactless and Economical Chemical Reaction Platform Based on Ultrasonic FieldStandard lab equipment for mixing tiny amounts of chemicals either requires complex chip fabrication, large sample volumes, or physical contact that can contaminate the sample.
IROSMultimodal Upstream Motion of Magnetically Controlled Micro/Nano Robots in High-Viscosity FluidsTiny magnetic robots meant to deliver drugs through blood vessels move much slower than expected because blood is thick and blood cells get in the way.
IROSDual-Bubble Coordinated Acoustic Micromanipulator for Multidirectional Object RotationSpinning a tiny object in three dimensions without touching it — and without complicated electronics — has not been achieved at the microscale.
IROSMultiple-scale augmented reality markers for positioning of robotic micromanipulationRobotic tools that need to work at both normal room scale and tiny microscope scale have no single marker system that covers both, making precise cross-scale positioning hard.
IROSDesign of a Soft Automatic Anchoring System for Enhanced Mobility and Stability in Colonoscopy RobotsColonoscopy robots slide out of place when pushed or pulled because they can't grip the colon wall reliably without knowing how much to inflate.
IROSIterative Learning Motion Control of Continuum Robots Based on Neural Ordinary Differential EquationsSoft snake-like robots are hard to control precisely because their physics change over time and learning good models usually needs a lot of data.
IROSMagnetically Actuated Steerable Catheter with Redundant DoF for Cardiovascular InterventionsSteering the tip of a catheter precisely inside blood vessels is hard because changing the tip angle with a magnet also moves the tip's position, making fine control difficult.
IROSNon-Buoyant Microrobots Swimming with Near-Zero Angle of Attack ↗Tiny swimming robots that are denser than water sink as they move, so they can't swim in a straight level path through thick fluids.
IROSModel-Free Catheter Delivery Strategy for Robotic Transcatheter Tricuspid Valve ReplacementRobots that guide thin tubes into hearts rely on simple 2D camera views, need to know the exact math of how the tube bends, and must be recalibrated for each patient and camera angle.
IROSAdjusting Tissue Puncture Omnidirectionally In Situ with Pneumatic Rotatable Biopsy Mechanism and Hierarchical Airflow Management in Tortuous Luminal PathwaysBiopsy catheters that travel through winding body passages cannot change the direction of the biopsy needle once inside because there is not enough space to turn the whole catheter and friction prevents pushing or pulling to rotate it.
IROSTowards Surgical Task Automation: Actor-Critic Models Meet Self-Supervised Imitation Learning*Teaching a surgical robot through reinforcement learning normally requires expert recordings that include labeled actions, which are expensive and risky to collect in an operating setting.
IROSUsing Upper Limb Carrying Exoskeleton with Dual-Model Torque Control Strategy to Reduce Load ImpactArm exoskeletons do not help accurately enough when a person carries a changing load because guessing what the person intends to do from muscle signals is not precise.
IROSTowards Accurate Brain Electrode Implantation via Cross-modality Fusion of White-light and Photoacoustic MicroscopySurgeons planning where to insert a brain electrode can only see the surface of the brain through a standard microscope, so they cannot see blood vessels hidden just below the surface and risk damaging them.
IROSUnsupervised Liver Deformation Correction Network Using Optimal Transport for Image-Guided Liver SurgeryDuring liver surgery the organ shifts and deforms, so a 3D scan taken before the operation no longer matches what the surgeon sees on the table, making image guidance inaccurate.

Flying, underwater, and outdoor field robots 293 papers

The problem

Flying, underwater, and outdoor field work each break the standard methods with their own troubles: wind that shoves a drone, murky water, rough ground, GPS that does not work, and no big datasets to learn from.

The approaches

Take the core tools and adapt them for each setting: learned flight control that shrugs off disturbances and flies through clutter, drones that perch on tree branches, physics-based underwater simulators and datasets, and new outdoor field datasets.

How it solves it

The core loop still applies; each setting just needs its own specific troubles handled directly, plus the datasets and simulators to learn from.
