ICRA2cMochiSwarm: A Testbed for Robotic Micro-Blimps in Realistic EnvironmentsResearchers studying swarms of tiny flying robots had no open, reusable test platform that could run many robots at once without needing external cameras or tracking systems to tell each robot where it is.
ICRA2cLightweight Yet High-Performance Defect Detector for Uav-Based Large-Scale Infrastructure Real-Time InspectionDetecting cracks and defects on bridges or towers from a drone in real time requires a model small enough to run on drone hardware while still catching defects at many different sizes and contrast levels.
ICRA2cDetection of Fast-Moving Objects with Neuromorphic HardwareDetecting fast-moving objects in real time at low power is needed for robots, but it was not clear whether current neuromorphic chips (specialized low-power processors that mimic how neurons fire) are actually fast and efficient enough to do this.
IROS2cMemGS: Memory-Efficient Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time SLAM3D scene mapping methods that use many small 3D blobs (Gaussian splatting) use too much GPU memory, making them impractical on small robots like drones.
IROS2cImpedanceGPT: VLM-driven Impedance Control of Swarm of Mini-drones for Intelligent Navigation in Dynamic EnvironmentA group of small drones needs to avoid both people and objects, but bumping into a person is far more dangerous than bumping into a box, so the drones need to understand what they are near and adjust how cautiously they move.
IROS2cAn Online Optimization-Based Trajectory Planning Approach for Cooperative Landing TasksCoordinating a drone and a ground robot so the drone can land on the ground robot in real time — without knowing in advance where or when to meet — has no clean solution.
IROS2cCross-modal State Space Modeling for Real-time RGB-thermal Wild Scene Semantic SegmentationLabeling every pixel in outdoor camera images using both color and heat-sensor data in real time is too slow and costly for small field robots.
IROS2cExperimental Evaluation of Safe Trajectory Planning for an Omnidirectional UAVFlying a drone that can point in any direction through tight, cluttered spaces means constantly trading off speed against the risk of hitting something.
IROS2cAnyTSR: Any-Scale Thermal Super-Resolution for UAVThermal cameras on drones produce blurry, low-resolution images, and current methods for sharpening them only work at one fixed zoom level.
IROS2cAirSwarm: Enabling Cost-Effective Multi-UAV Research with COTS dronesResearching drone swarms normally needs expensive custom drones and special motion-capture rooms, putting it out of reach for most labs and classrooms.
IROS2cAutonomous 3D Moving Target Encirclement and Interception with Range MeasurementDefending against hostile drones without GPS or radar is very hard when you only have noisy distance readings to work with.
IROS2cFalconGym: A Photorealistic Simulation Framework for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Vision-Based Quadrotor NavigationDrone control policies trained in computer simulators often fail on real hardware because simulated camera images look too different from real ones.
IROS2cDesign and Control of an Actively Morphing Quadrotor with Vertically Foldable ArmsDrones with fixed shapes cannot pick things up or fit through tight spaces.
IROS2cTACO: General Acrobatic Flight Control via Target-and-Command-Oriented Reinforcement LearningDrone acrobatics controllers are designed for one trick at a time and can't switch between flips and rolls, or change the maneuver while flying.
IROS2cDA-MPPI: Disturbance-Aware Model Predictive Path Integral via active disturbance estimation and compensationA prediction-based controller (MPPI) fails when wind, external bumps, or a bad movement model surprise it because it only compensates for what it predicted, not what actually hit.
IROS2cVision-Based Cooperative MAV-Capturing-MAVCatching a rogue flying drone with multiple pursuer drones requires them to work together and track the target all from onboard cameras with no communication towers or GPS.
ICRA1cA Complete and Bounded-Suboptimal Algorithm for a Moving Target Traveling Salesman Problem with Obstacles in 3DPlanning a route for a drone to intercept multiple moving targets in a 3D space full of obstacles, while hitting each target only in its time window, had no algorithm that was both guaranteed to find an answer and guaranteed to be close to optimal.
ICRA1cReliable Aerial Manipulation: Combining Visual Tracking with Range Sensing for Robust GraspingWhen a drone descends to pick up an object, the object disappears from the camera's view just before the grab, causing the drone to miss.
ICRA1cFlying Quadrotors in Tight Formations Using Learning-Based Model Predictive ControlDrones flying very close together disturb each other's airflow in ways that are hard to predict from physics equations, causing formation errors.
ICRA1cEvMAPPER: High-Altitude Orthomapping with Event CamerasDrone cameras that take regular photos fail to make good maps when the sun is too bright, the scene is too dark, or objects are moving fast.
ICRA1cTowards Safe and Energy-Efficient Real-Time Motion Planning in Windy Urban EnvironmentsSmall drones flying low over cities can be blown off course by wind, wasting energy or crashing, and they have no way to know the wind ahead of time.
ICRA1cDecentralized Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for Safe Collision Avoidance in Quadrotor Teams with Limited Detection RangeA group of drones flying without a central coordinator must avoid hitting each other and obstacles, but each drone can only sense things within a limited range, which makes safety guarantees hard to maintain.
ICRA1cFrom Ceilings to Walls: Universal Dynamic Perching of Quadrotors on Surfaces with Variable OrientationsSmall flying robots cannot reliably land and grip onto surfaces at different angles — ceilings, walls, or tilted surfaces — and nobody had worked out how the robot's size or leg spring stiffness affects whether that landing works.
ICRA1cSafe Quadrotor Navigation Using Composite Control Barrier FunctionsFlying a small drone safely through a room packed with thousands of obstacles in real time is hard because checking every obstacle separately is too slow and can leave the safety system without a valid solution.
ICRA1cSelf-Supervised Meta-Learning for All-Layer DNN-Based Adaptive Control with Stability GuaranteesControl systems that use neural networks to adapt to sudden forces or disturbances can only update a small part of the network online, which limits how fast and how well they adapt.
ICRA1cSafe Interval Motion Planning for Quadrotors in Dynamic EnvironmentsPlanning real-time flight paths for drones around moving people or objects is hard because the safe spaces shift over time and standard path-smoothing gets stuck in dead ends.
ICRA1cEfficient Non-Myopic Layered Bayesian Optimization for Large-Scale Bathymetric Informative Path Planning ↗Planning underwater drone paths to map the seafloor using statistical models (Bayesian optimization) is too slow for large areas and tends to plan only one step ahead.
ICRA1cDGTR: Distributed Gaussian Turbo-Reconstruction for Sparse-View Vast ScenesReconstructing a large outdoor area in 3D from only a few photos is very slow when a single computer or drone has to do all the work, and existing fast methods produce low-quality results over large areas.
ICRA1cCGTrack: Cascade Gating Network with Hierarchical Feature Aggregation for UAV TrackingTracking objects from a drone using a small, fast neural network is hard because making the network smaller also makes it worse at finding targets when they are blocked or viewed from odd angles.
ICRA1cPredictive Kinematic Coordinate Control for Aerial Manipulators Based on Modified Kinematics LearningA flying robot arm cannot position its end tool precisely because the standard geometric model of its joints ignores how flying and arm motion interact and leaves out other real-world errors.
ICRA1cMicroASV: An Affordable 3D-Printed Centimeter-Scale Autonomous Surface VehicleSmall cheap water robots for swarm research don't yet exist in a fully self-contained form that can move in any direction on the water surface.
ICRA1cDense Fixed-Wing Swarming Using Receding-Horizon NMPCFlying many fast fixed-wing drones close together without collisions is hard because each drone must plan moves quickly while accounting for what the others will do.
ICRA1cRisk-Aware Energy-Constrained UAV-UGV Cooperative Routing Using Attention-Guided Reinforcement LearningSending a drone-and-ground-vehicle team to cover a large area is hard because wind makes fuel use unpredictable and the drone could run out of energy mid-mission.
ICRA1cAutonomous Drone for Dynamic Smoke Plume TrackingTracking a moving smoke plume with a drone is hard because wind makes the plume twist and shift in ways a simple fixed controller cannot follow.
ICRA1cOptimal Trajectory Planning for Cooperative Manipulation with Multiple Quadrotors Using Control Barrier FunctionsPlanning a path for several drones carrying a load on cables through a room full of obstacles is very hard because you have to keep every drone, every cable, and the load itself from hitting anything, all at the same time.
ICRA1cEfficient Submap-based Autonomous MAV Exploration using Visual-Inertial SLAM Configurable for LiDARs or Depth CamerasA small flying robot exploring a large unknown building tends to build up map errors over time and has to start over if you swap its sensor type.
ICRA1cReactive Collision Avoidance for Safe Agile NavigationA fast-flying drone needs to dodge obstacles in real time using only its own onboard computer, with no pre-made map of the space.
ICRA1cAstroLoc2: Fast Sequential Depth-Enhanced Localization for Free-Flying RobotsA small robot floating inside the ISS needs to know exactly where it is in real time, using very limited computing power, even when people and equipment move around it.
ICRA1cVizFlyt: Perception-centric Pedagogical Framework For Autonomous Aerial RobotsTeaching students to program flying robots using real hardware risks crashes, and cheap simulators do not look real enough to test vision-based code properly.
ICRA1cDynamic Compact Consensus Tracking for Aerial RobotsTracking a moving object in real time on a drone is too slow when the tracker updates its template of what to look for, because standard transformer attention is expensive.
ICRA1cGradient Guided Search for Aircraft Contingency Landing PlanningPlanning an emergency landing path for a fixed-wing aircraft is hard because the path must match strict angle and heading requirements while also avoiding populated areas, all in 3D space with uncertain wind.
ICRA1cAirflow Source Seeking on Small Quadrotors Using a Single Flow Sensor ↗Tiny drones under 100 grams cannot carry gas sensors good enough to reliably track a chemical plume to its source.
ICRA1cRapid Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance for UAVs Enhanced by DVS and Neuromorphic ComputingAvoiding fast-moving objects with a drone requires reacting in milliseconds, which standard cameras and conventional neural networks are too slow to do.
ICRA1cTowards Safe and Efficient Through-the-Canopy Autonomous Fruit Counting with UAVsCounting fruit in an orchard automatically requires a drone to fly inside dense tree canopies, which is hard to plan and navigate without damaging trees or missing fruit behind leaves.
ICRA1cSafety-Critical Online Quadrotor Trajectory Planner for Agile Flights in Unknown EnvironmentsA fast-flying drone needs to plan a safe path in real time through spaces it has never seen before, with no pre-built map available.
ICRA1cAerial Grasping by Multi-Limbed Flying Robot SPIDAR Based on Vectored Thrust ControlFlying robots with multiple arms need to grab large objects, but the object itself blocks airflow to some rotors, reducing the thrust needed to stay stable and grip firmly.
ICRA1cA Cooperative Bearing-Rate Approach for Observability-Enhanced Target Motion EstimationTracking a fast-moving target in 3D using only the direction to the target (bearing) from cameras gives too little information to estimate speed and position accurately.
ICRA1cJRN-Geo: A Joint Perception Network Based on RGB and Normal Images for Cross-View Geo-LocalizationMatching aerial drone photos to ground-level images for navigation is hard because the same place looks very different from above versus from the ground.
IROS1cMM-Geo: Multi-Scale and Multi-Positive UAV-View Geo-LocalizationFiguring out where a drone is by matching its camera image to a satellite map is hard when the drone can fly at very different heights, because the same area looks very different at different altitudes.
IROS1cServo-Driven Flapping Robot that Uses Its Tail for Self-Standing TakeoffMost flapping-wing robots need an external stand or a person to hold them up before they can take off, which adds parts or limits where they can be used.
IROS1cAerial Grasping via Maximizing Delta-Arm Workspace UtilizationA delta arm mounted on a flying drone can only reach certain positions, and the shape of that reachable space is complicated, making it hard to plan good grasping paths automatically.
IROS1cAsynchronous Harmony-based Decentralized Auctions Method for Scalable UAV SwarmBuilding detailed 3D surface maps of large outdoor areas from drone photos is very slow and falls apart when objects move or lighting changes.
IROS1c3D Gaussian Splatting for Fine-Detailed Surface Reconstruction in Large-Scale SceneBuilding detailed 3D surface maps of large outdoor areas from drone photos is very slow and falls apart when objects move or lighting changes.
IROS1cLearning-Based Passive Fault-Tolerant Control of a Quadrotor with Rotor FailureWhen one rotor on a four-rotor drone stops working, the drone must keep flying stably without knowing exactly how bad the failure is or having to switch between different pre-set controllers.
IROS1cSuMag: Suspended Magnetometer Survey for Mineral Data Acquisition with Vertical Take-off and Landing Fixed-wing AircraftSensitive magnetic sensors mounted on drones pick up electrical noise from the drone itself and move around too much, making the readings poor for finding minerals underground.
IROS1cUAV See, UGV Do: Aerial Imagery and Virtual Teach Enabling Zero-Shot Ground Vehicle RepeatGetting a ground robot to follow a specific path in a place it has never been requires someone to first drive it along that path in person, which is slow and sometimes dangerous.
IROS1cModel-Based External Wrench Estimation for Underwater RobotsSmall underwater robots need to sense pushes and twists from currents or contacts, but water drag behaves in a complicated nonlinear way that makes standard force-estimation methods inaccurate.
IROS1cA Multi-Sensor Fusion Approach for Rapid Orthoimage Generation in Large-Scale UAV Mapping ↗Generating accurate overhead maps from drone footage is slow and unreliable over flat, featureless terrain like farmland because standard image-matching methods cannot find enough distinctive points to work with.
IROS1cDesign and Flight Control of a Novel Thrust-Vectored Tricopter Using Twisting and Tilting RotorsA three-rotor drone with steerable motors is hard to control stably because the rotors are not placed symmetrically and tilting the arms creates forces that fight each other.
IROS1cSkyVLN: Vision-and-Language Navigation and NMPC Control for UAVs in Urban EnvironmentsDrones flying through city environments cannot reliably follow spoken or written directions while also avoiding obstacles.
IROS1cFLOAT Drone: A Fully-actuated Coaxial Aerial Robot for Close-Proximity OperationsDrones that can push and pull in any direction tend to blow air sideways onto whatever they're working near, and are often too big to get close enough to do useful work.
IROS1cDL-Clip: Online D-Learning with Clipping Operation for Fast Model-Free Stabilizing ControlMaking a robot stable using only sensor readings — without knowing the robot's physics and without a reward signal — normally takes too long to converge.
IROS1cQLIO: Quantized LiDAR-Inertial OdometryTracking a robot's position using a laser scanner and motion sensor requires more computing power and memory than small embedded computers can provide.
IROS1cSemi-distributed Cross-modal Air-Ground Relative LocalizationFinding the relative position between a flying drone and a ground robot is hard when they carry different sensors and the system is tightly tied to a shared mapping process.
IROS1cLearning Point Correspondences In Radar 3D Point Clouds For Radar-Inertial OdometryCheap radar sensors produce sparse, noisy 3D point clouds that standard matching methods cannot link accurately from one scan to the next, causing position drift.
IROS1cOnline Concurrent Multi-Robot Coverage Path PlanningWhen using many robots to cover an area, robots had to sit idle while the system figured out the next path for them, wasting time.
IROS1cReal-time Photorealistic Mapping for Situational Awareness in Robot TeleoperationWhen a person remotely pilots a robot, the 3D map shown on screen is not photorealistic, making it hard to understand the environment quickly.
IROS1cActive Disturbance Rejection Control for Trajectory Tracking of a Seagoing USV: Design, Simulation, and Field ExperimentsBoats moving on the ocean drift off course because waves and currents push them around, and the standard control method (PID) can't handle these surprises well.
IROS1cAutomated UAV-based Wind Turbine Blade Inspection: Blade Stop Angle Estimation and Blade Detail Prioritized Exposure AdjustmentDrones inspecting wind turbine blades guess wrong about which angle the blade is at due to sunlight and noise, and pictures come out too bright or too dark.
IROS1cSafety-Aware Optimal Scheduling for Autonomous Masonry Construction using Collaborative Heterogeneous Aerial RobotsCoordinating flying robots to build with blocks requires meeting glue deadlines, following build order, and not crashing into each other at the same time.
IROS1cSecure Safety Filter: Towards Safe Flight Control under Sensor AttacksDrone autopilot systems can crash if someone feeds false sensor data, and today's safety tools assume perfect sensors.
IROS1cLLM-CBT: LLM-Driven Closed-Loop Behavior Tree Planning for Heterogeneous UAV-UGV Swarm CollaborationPlanning tasks for mixed teams of flying and ground robots is hard because each type of robot does different things and situations change fast.
IROS1cPI-WAN: A Physics-Informed Wind-Adaptive Network for Quadrotor Dynamics Prediction in Unknown EnvironmentsPredicting how a flying drone moves when carrying different loads and fighting wind gusts is hard for both pure physics formulas and pure learning from data.
IROS1cShape-Adaptive Planning and Control for a Deformable QuadrotorFlying robots that change shape need to plan paths that work as they bend, so they can fly through tight spaces.
IROS1cMulti-UAV-UGV Collision-Free Tracking Control via Control Barrier Function-Based Reinforcement LearningFlying and rolling robots chasing a target together is hard because they have to split assignments, catch the target, and not crash into each other—all without knowing their exact physics.
IROS1cD4orm: Multi-Robot Trajectories with Dynamics-aware Diffusion Denoised DeformationsPlanning paths for many robots to move together is slow because checking whether each path is actually possible to follow takes a lot of computing power.
IROS1cMixed Integer Conic Programming for Multi-Agent Motion Planning in Continuous SpacePlanning for many robots moving without hitting each other or walls, and making paths nearly optimal, is very hard with existing math approaches.
IROS1cImproving Drone Racing Performance Through Iterative Learning MPCDrones racing through gates have to be super fast but also can't miss the gates, and computers can't calculate fast enough for perfect paths.
ICRADistributed Loitering Synchronization with Fixed-Wing UAVs ↗When a group of fixed-wing drones must orbit the same circle before a mission, they need to spread out evenly, but fixed-wing drones cannot hover or slow down easily and each drone can only talk to its neighbors.
ICRAOn the Necessity of Real-Time Principles in GPU-Driven Autonomous RobotsWhen a drone uses its GPU for multiple jobs at once, safety-critical tasks like detecting obstacles may not finish on time because other jobs take up the GPU first.
ICRAHook-Based Aerial Payload Grasping from a Moving Platform ↗A flying robot trying to hook a payload on a moving platform must time the grab precisely, and it must do so despite uncertainty in its own dynamics and wind disturbances.
ICRAMultirotor Target Tracking through Policy Iteration for Visual ServoingA flying drone needs to keep a moving, shape-changing target centered in its camera, which is hard because the target's appearance keeps changing.
ICRAContingency Formation Planning for Interactive Drone Light ShowsWhen a drone swarm is used as a live display that responds to audience input, the swarm cannot know which image it will need to show next, so it can be too slow to rearrange in time.
ICRAIndoor Localization of UAVs Using Only Few Measurements by Output-Sensitive Preimage IntersectionLocating a drone indoors using only a handful of downward distance readings and movement estimates is hard because the math requires finding where several complex geometric regions overlap in a four-dimensional space.
ICRASIMP: Real-Time Energy and Time-Efficient 3D Motion Planning for Bio-Inspired AUVsSnake-like swimming robots had no planner that could pick routes through cluttered 3D water in real time while keeping both energy use and travel time low.
ICRACloudTrack: Scalable UAV Tracking with Cloud SemanticsA search-and-rescue drone needs to find and follow a specific person described in words, but drones have limited computing power and existing trackers require training on each new target.
ICRATowards Perpetually-Deployable Ubiquitous Aerial Robotics: An Amphibious Self-Sustainable Solar Small-UASSmall drones run out of battery quickly and cannot land on water, so they cannot stay out for more than a few hours at a time.
ICRAFlapping-Wing Flying Robot with Integrated Dual-Arm Scissors-Type Flora Sampling SystemBird-like flying robots cannot safely cut and collect plant samples in the field because their cutting tools are exposed and dangerous during flight.
ICRASafe Radial Segregation Algorithm for Swarms of Dubins-Like RobotsSorting a mixed group of robots — drones, wheeled robots, underwater vehicles — into separate circular areas by type is hard when each robot can only turn with a minimum turning radius and cannot spin in place.
ICRAAn Efficient NSGA-II-Based Algorithm for Multi-Robot Coverage Path PlanningSplitting an area among many robots so that every spot gets covered is hard to do well when you want to minimize both the longest single robot's travel time and the average travel time at the same time.
ICRAMixing Data-Driven and Geometric Models for Satellite Docking Port State Estimation Using an Rgb or Event CameraA spacecraft trying to dock with another spacecraft needs to find and track the docking port using only a camera, under harsh lighting conditions, without knowing what the target satellite looks like in advance.
ICRAV-Pilot: A Velocity Vector Control Agent for Fixed-Wing UAVs from Imperfect DemonstrationsTeaching a fixed-wing drone to control its speed and direction using trial-and-error learning is very hard because the drone must make many decisions over a long time, and the human flight examples it learns from are often low quality.
ICRALearning Time-Optimal Online Replanning for Distributed Model Predictive Contouring Control of QuadrotorsReplanning the fastest possible path for a group of drones 100 times per second on the drone itself is too slow using standard math-based optimization alone.
ICRADragonfly Drone: A Novel Tilt-Rotor Aerial Platform with Body-Morphing CapabilityDrones cannot change their physical shape in flight, so they cannot squeeze through oddly shaped gaps or press flat against uneven surfaces.
ICRAAir-FAR: Fast and Adaptable Routing for Aerial Navigation in Large-Scale Complex Unknown EnvironmentsPlanning a 3D flight path through a large unknown space with thousands of obstacles in real time is too slow with standard graph-search methods.
ICRAAn Active Perception Game for Robust Information GatheringRobots picking where to look next use an estimate of how much information each viewpoint will provide, but that estimate is often wrong because it ignores how earlier observations will change what later ones reveal.
ICRAEAR-SLAM: Environment-Aware Robust Localization System for Terrestrial-Aerial Bimodal VehiclesVehicles that can both drive and fly lose track of where they are when they switch modes, because the camera view changes dramatically and the wheels behave differently on slopes.
ICRAThe Automation of Uncrewed Aircraft Systems Traffic Management Calibration Based on Experimental Platform DataThe safety rules that govern drone airspace — things like how much gap to leave between drones — are set by guesswork rather than by measuring how real drones actually fly.
ICRAMulti-Drone-Truck Collaborative Delivery with En Route Operations: A Hierarchical MARL-Based ApproachCoordinating many drones that launch and land on a moving truck for package delivery involves too many interacting decisions for a single planner to handle efficiently.
ICRALearning Robust Policies via Interpretable Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability-Guided DisturbancesRobot control programs trained with reinforcement learning often fail when they encounter unexpected pushes or sensor errors, and it is hard to train them to handle such disturbances without using a separate learned adversary that is hard to understand or trust.
ICRADesign, Contact Modeling, and Collision-Inclusive Planning of a Dual-Stiffness Aerial RoboT (DART)Flying robots that can absorb crashes by being flexible lose flight stability, while rigid ones absorb crashes poorly — no existing design handles both needs.
ICRATrofyBot: A Transformable Rolling and Flying Robot with High Energy EfficiencyRobots that can both drive and fly waste a lot of battery on the ground because tilting the body to steer also pushes the robot upward, fighting gravity for no reason.
ICRADynamic Perception-Enhanced Motion Planning and Control for UAVs Flights in Challenging Dynamic EnvironmentsDrones flying through spaces with many moving people or objects cannot safely plan paths in real time because standard maps do not separate moving obstacles from static ones.
ICRAEffective Heterogeneous Point Cloud-Based Place Recognition and Relative Localization for Ground and Aerial VehiclesGround robots and drones see the world from very different angles, so existing place-recognition methods built for ground vehicles fail when trying to match locations across both.
ICRASOF-E: An Energy Efficient Robot for Collaborative Transport and Placement of Mechanical Meta-Material ModulesRobots meant to assemble structures in space need to be light and simple while still able to move and place structural pieces together.
ICRAEmbedded Robust Model Predictive Path Integral Control Using Sensitivity Tubes and GPU Acceleration ↗A popular sampling-based controller called MPPI breaks down when its internal model of the robot has wrong parameter values, because the controller does not account for how those errors grow during flight.
ICRAQVIO2: Quantized Map-Based Visual-Inertial OdometrySmall devices like drones or AR glasses need to send camera and motion data to estimate their position, but the wireless bandwidth available is too narrow for the full-resolution sensor stream.
ICRAE2B: A Single Modality Point-Based Tracker with Event CamerasEvent cameras output data very differently from regular cameras — as a stream of individual pixel changes — and converting that stream into frames throws away the speed and sparsity advantages, while large pre-trained networks are too heavy for battery-limited robots.
ICRAFeedback RoI Features Improve Aerial Object DetectionDetecting objects in aerial photos taken through fog, rain, or sensor noise is hard because standard feature extractors treat all images the same regardless of quality.
ICRAFlying Through Moving Gates without Full State EstimationFlying a drone through moving gates fails when the drone does not have a map of the environment or a full estimate of its own position and speed.
ICRAReal-Time UAV Tracking: A Comparative Study of YOLOv8 with Object Tracking AlgorithmsTracking a flying drone in real time requires pairing a detection model with a tracking algorithm, but it was not clear which combination gives the best balance of speed and accuracy on low-power hardware.
ICRAReal-Time Sampling-based Online Planning for Drone InterceptionIntercepting a fast-moving drone requires computing the fastest possible flight path in real time, which is normally too slow because the math involved is expensive to solve.
ICRAA Map-Free Deep Learning-Based Framework for Gate-to-Gate Monocular Visual Navigation Aboard Miniaturized Aerial VehiclesA drone weighing less than 50 grams has almost no computing power, yet must fly through a series of gates it has never seen before using only its camera.
ICRAOnline Nonlinear MPC for Multimodal LocomotionA robot that can both walk and fly needs one controller that handles all its movement modes and transitions between them, which is hard because the physics of walking and flying are very different.
ICRAMERLION: Marine ExploRation with Language guIded Online iNformative Visual Sampling and EnhancementUnderwater robots recording video have limited storage and poor transmission speed, and murky water makes it hard to pick out the frames that actually show what a user is looking for.
ICRADecentralized Drone Swaps for Online Rebalancing of Drone Delivery TasksDrones pile up at some depots while other depots run short, and simply sending individual drones across the network is slow and hard to coordinate.
ICRAIntroducing KUGE: A Simultaneous Control Co-Design Architecture and its Application to Aerial Robotics Development ↗When designing a flying robot, engineers usually pick the physical shape first and then figure out the control system afterward, which means the two are never truly optimized together.
ICRALeveraging Symmetry to Accelerate Learning of Trajectory Tracking Controllers for Free-Flying Robotic SystemsTraining a control policy for a robot that floats freely in space (like a spacecraft or drone) is slow because the state space is very large.
ICRAMonotone Subsystem Decomposition for Efficient Multi-Objective Robot Design ↗Picking the best set of components for a robot means searching through an astronomically large number of combinations while also balancing several competing goals at once.
ICRAMulti-Agent Ergodic Exploration Under Smoke-Based Time-Varying Sensor Visibility ConstraintsCoordinating a swarm of drones to search for survivors in a wildfire is hard because smoke constantly moves and blocks what each drone's sensors can see.
ICRATowards Survivability in Complex Motion Scenarios: RGB-Event Object Tracking via Historical Trajectory PromptingTrackers that combine normal cameras with event cameras (which record only pixel-level brightness changes) lose track of objects that move very fast or in complex paths.
ICRAMulti-View Stereo with Geometric Encoding for Dense Scene ReconstructionReconstructing a detailed 3D scene from multiple photos is less accurate than it should be because the matching step between views doesn't encode enough information about the 3D shape of surfaces.
ICRAEnabling In-Flight Metamorphosis in Multirotors with a Center-Driven Scissor Extendable Airframe for Adaptive NavigationA drone with a fixed body size cannot shrink to fit through a tight gap or grow to carry more weight during the same flight.
ICRALAFNET: Lightweight Aerial Fire Detection Model for Onboard Edge ComputingDetecting fire from a drone requires a model that runs fast and uses little memory on the limited hardware a drone can carry.
ICRAAPA-BI: Adaptive Partition Aggregation and Bidirectional Integration for UAV-View Geo-LocalizationMatching a drone's camera view to a ground map requires very distinctive image features, but current methods miss large-scale scene meaning and fail to highlight the structural patterns that stay consistent across views.
ICRAGate-Aware Online Planning for Two-Player Autonomous Drone RacingIt was too hard to plan fast, safe paths for two racing drones at the same time when each gate on the track faces a different direction.
ICRAA Method for Constructing Building Structure Grid Map Based on a Climbing AlgorithmRobots that fly and walk indoors get confused when furniture or other movable objects change position, because standard maps treat those objects the same as permanent walls.
ICRARobust 4D Radar-Aided Inertial Navigation for Aerial VehiclesDrones lose accurate position tracking in dust, rain, or darkness because cameras and laser sensors fail in those conditions.
ICRAEfficient Scale-Uniform 3D Visual Coverage Algorithm for UAV Based on Elastic Photogrammetric ConstraintsWhen a drone photographs hilly terrain, valleys and peaks cause the camera to be at very different heights above the ground, making images blurry or inconsistent in scale and causing the drone's path to bunch up in low areas.
IROSExponentially Weighted Instance-Aware Repeat Factor Sampling for Long-Tailed Object Detection Model Training in Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Surveillance ScenariosObject detectors trained on drone footage miss rare objects — such as a person in an emergency — because the training data has far more images of common things than rare ones, so the model rarely learns from the rare cases.
IROSSpatio-Temporal Hyperbolic Aggregation Neural Network for Human Action RecognitionRecognizing human actions from body-joint position data is harder than it should be because standard neural networks do not capture the natural branching structure of the skeleton (trunk splits to limbs, limbs to fingers).
IROSDetecting Obstacles on Railroads Using Computer Vision on UAVsChecking train tracks for fallen debris after a disaster is slow and dangerous when done by people on the ground.
IROSSelf-Supervised Monocular Visual Drone Model Identification through Improved Occlusion HandlingLearning a drone's flight model from video normally requires an external motion-capture room to provide ground-truth positions, which is expensive and limits where you can collect data.
IROSUAV Chain Network Creation in Cluttered Environments with Flocking Rules and Routing DataGetting a group of drones to arrange themselves into a communication relay chain between two distant points in a space full of obstacles — without any central coordinator — is hard to do while keeping signals from being blocked.
IROSReal-Time Guaranteed Monitoring for a Drone Using Interval Analysis and Signal Temporal LogicChecking in real time whether a drone's path is safe is hard when sensor readings have errors, because most methods assume a statistical model of the errors rather than a hard bound.
IROSPEACE: Prompt Engineering Automation for CLIPSeg Enhancement for Safe-Landing Zone SegmentationDrone landing systems that use fixed text descriptions to identify safe landing spots fail when the scene looks different from what those descriptions were written for.
IROSPhysics-Based Gas Mapping with Nano Aerial Vehicles: The ADApprox Algorithm ↗A small flying robot collecting gas readings in a large space gets only a few scattered measurements, and existing methods to fill in the gaps between readings ignore how gas actually spreads through the air.
IROSRapid Flight Trajectory Planning for Autonomous Terrain Avoidance via Generative LearningAn aircraft that is about to fly into a mountain needs a safe escape path computed in seconds, which standard planning methods are too slow to do.
IROSDW-VIO: Deep Weighted Visual-Inertial OdometryCombining camera images and motion sensors to track a robot's position breaks down when one sensor is unreliable, and current methods do not have a good way to automatically reduce the weight of bad sensor data.
IROSCODE: COllaborative Visual-UWB SLAM for Online Large-Scale Metric DEnse MappingMultiple drones mapping a large area together without GPS need to know the true physical scale of the map and must stay globally consistent, which is hard using cameras alone.
IROSLearning to Initialize Trajectory Optimization for Vision-Based Autonomous Flight in Unknown EnvironmentsComputing a safe flight path for a drone in real time is slow because the math solver often starts from a bad guess and has to run many steps to find a good answer.
IROSPrecision Autonomous Landing of UAV on High-Speed Vehicles Based on Enhanced Gimbal Stabilization and Smooth Trajectory GenerationA drone trying to land on a fast-moving vehicle kept missing because camera-mount wobble threw off its position estimate and delayed its steering commands.
IROSATARS: An Aerial Traffic Atomic Activity Recognition and Temporal Segmentation DatasetTraffic datasets filmed from the road can't say exactly when each small action (like a left turn or a pedestrian crossing) starts and ends when viewed from above a drone.
IROSMulti-UAV Deployment in Obstacle-Cluttered Environments with LOS ConnectivitySpreading a group of drones through a cluttered space while keeping them able to talk to each other without obstacles blocking the signal is hard to guarantee.
IROSA Two-Stage Swarm Planning Framework for Efficient Multi-Drone Waypoint TraversalGetting a group of drones to fly through a set of waypoints quickly and safely is slow to compute, prone to getting stuck, and requires too much communication between the drones.
IROSFocus Bug: Learning Environmental Awareness for Efficient Mapless NavigationVery small robots have almost no power budget, so they can't run standard navigation software that processes every sensor reading.
IROSPartial Feedback Linearization Control of a Cable-Suspended Multirotor Platform for Stabilization of an Attached LoadA drone hanging from a cable with a load attached underneath is hard to control because the drone and load influence each other in complex ways, especially when wind or other forces push them.
IROSReal-Time Initialization of Unknown Anchors for UWB-aided NavigationSmall radio beacons (UWB anchors) help robots navigate precisely indoors, but currently someone must measure and enter each beacon's exact position by hand before the system works.
IROSSafety-Compliant Navigation: Navigation Point-Guided Planning with Primitive TrajectoriesAI planners trained by copying human actions build up small errors over time, which can lead to unsafe paths in high-stakes settings like aircraft ground operations.
IROSSwept Volume-Based Continuous Object Gathering Trajectory Generation for Tethered Robot DuoPlanning paths for two robots connected by a tether to sweep and collect floating debris is hard because the tether limits how far apart they can move and the swept area must cover everything without gaps.
IROSSFExplorer: A Surface-Frontier-based Efficient UAV Exploration Method for Large-Scale Unknown EnvironmentsDrones exploring large unknown areas spend too much time generating camera viewpoints and planning routes, and move jerkily between exploration steps.
IROSEdgeSR: Reparameterization-Driven Fast Thermal Super-Resolution for Edge Electro-Optical DeviceMaking thermal camera images sharper on a small, low-power edge device in real time is too slow with existing high-quality models.
IROSManipulation of Elasto-Flexible Cables with Single or Multiple UAVsGetting drones to carry and move a stretchy, bendable cable accurately is hard because the cable's shape is difficult to model and planning smooth paths for it takes a lot of computing.
IROSEnabling On-Chip Adaptive Linear Optimal Control via Linearized Gaussian ProcessDrones flying in complex airflows need data-driven models of air forces to control accurately, but full statistical models (Gaussian processes) are too slow to run on the small computer chips drones carry.
IROSHeteroscedastic Bayesian Optimization-Based Dynamic PID Tuning for Accurate and Robust UAV Trajectory Tracking ↗A drone's speed controller (PID) works well with fixed settings only in calm, predictable conditions; different winds or maneuvers need different settings, but retuning by hand every time is not practical.
IROSHigh-fidelity Model and Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for Flip Maneuvers of Tailless Flapping-Wing Robots ↗Getting a small flapping-wing robot with no tail to do a full 360-degree flip is hard because the aerodynamics are complex and no accurate simulation existed to plan the move.
IROSA System for Multi-View Mapping of Dynamic Scenes Using Time-Synchronized UAVsBuilding a 3D model of a moving outdoor scene from multiple camera angles requires all cameras to capture frames at exactly the same instant, which is very hard without a fixed rig.
IROSEstimation of Aerodynamics Forces in Dynamic Morphing Wing FlightKnowing the exact air forces on a flapping bat-like wing during flight is necessary for precise control, but those forces are hard to measure or calculate because the wing constantly changes shape.
IROSLoL-NMPC: Low-Level Dynamics Integration in Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for Unmanned Aerial VehiclesDrone controllers that plan optimal moves assume the drone instantly responds to commands, but real drones have internal PID speed controllers and motor delays that cause the drone to fall behind at high speeds.
IROSFull Pose Tracking via Robust Control for Over-Actuated MultirotorsDrones with more than four motors can control position and orientation independently, but designing a controller that handles disturbances and respects motor limits across many different drone layouts is complex.
IROSTowards Safe Reinforcement Learning with Reduced Conservativeness: A Case Study on Drone Flight ControlSafety systems added to RL-trained drone controllers block too many actions because they assume the worst possible disturbance at all times, even when the real environment is much calmer.
IROSNezha-T: a Bi-floating State Lightweight Tail-sitter HAUVBuilding a vehicle that can fly in air and swim underwater is hard to do while keeping the vehicle light and making the switch between the two domains stable.
IROSPlanning and Control for Active Morphing Tensegrity Aerial Vehicles in Confined SpacesDrones that can change shape to fit through tight spaces are usually built from rigid links that can break on contact and are hard to control when their shape changes mid-flight.
IROSRobust Reinforcement Learning based on Momentum Adversarial TrainingMaking a robot's control policy resistant to disturbances in its actions (like a motor not responding exactly as commanded) has been largely ignored compared to making it resistant to bad sensor readings.
IROSUAV Video Deblurring via Motion-Aware Diffusion: A Path to Robust Target DetectionFast drone movements smear video frames with motion blur, which makes it much harder for object detection software to spot targets.
IROSWLuav: An Air-Ground Robot with High Ground Adaptability and Trajectory Tracking PerformanceRobots that can both fly and drive typically have complicated mechanical designs, adapt poorly to uneven ground, and don't follow planned paths precisely.
IROSBuilding Hybrid Omnidirectional Visual-Lidar Map for Visual-Only LocalizationDrones with limited computing power need to know exactly where they are using only cameras, even when approaching from any direction, but the pre-built maps they fly into were made with a laser scanner the drone does not carry.
IROSDecentralized Model-Free Monitoring of Multi-UAV-Multi-USV Systems Using Sparse Data and Bayesian Learning ↗Tracking a group of boats from drones is hard when the boats do not share their data with each other, the drone sensors are noisy, and the behavior of the boats is not known in advance.
IROSMARS-FTCP: Robust Fault-Tolerant Control and Agile Trajectory Planning for Modular Aerial Robot SystemsFlying robots made of multiple modules that can dock and undock tend to shake and become unstable when a module fails or detaches, and there was no single solution that handles both failure recovery and path planning for any shape of assembly.
IROSDroneKey: Drone 3D Pose Estimation in Image Sequences using Gated Key-representation and Pose-adaptive LearningFiguring out a drone's exact position and orientation from camera images is hard because propeller tips look almost the same no matter which way the drone is pointing.
IROSAn RGB-D Camera-Based Multi-Small Flying Anchors Control for Wire-Driven Robots Connecting to the EnvironmentA robot that moves by pulling on wires needs to attach those wires to points in an unknown space on its own, but no one had shown a robot doing this automatically in an unplanned environment.
IROSDecision Transformer-Based Drone Trajectory Planning with Dynamic Safety-Efficiency Trade-OffsDrone path planners require an expert to hand-tune several parameters to trade off between flying safely and flying fast, and those settings do not adapt when the environment changes.
IROSA Spatiotemporal Downwash Modeling for Agile Close-Proximity Multirotor FlightWhen drones fly close together, the air pushed down by one drone (downwash) disturbs the others, and existing models for that disturbance break down once drones move faster than about half a meter per second.
IROSSPLiCE: Single-Point LiDAR and Camera Calibration &amp; Estimation Leveraging Manhattan WorldSmall drones can only carry a very simple laser rangefinder that measures one distance point at a time, and existing methods for aligning that sensor with a camera require a full dense laser scan.
IROSWave-Aware Control of Workspace-Constrained Shipboard Robots for Motion Compensation in Rough SeasRobots on ships must cancel out wave-induced motion in real time, but pure feedback control fails in rough seas and full model-based planning is too slow to run live.
IROSLanding-Aware Multi-Drone Routing in Last-Mile Delivery ServicesWhen one delivery drone lands, other drones cannot land nearby at the same time, so they waste time flying in circles waiting instead of delivering packages.
IROSThermal Updraft Profiling with an Array of Show DronesMeasuring how fast hot air rises in atmospheric columns is hard without special wind sensors on the drones.
IROSScalable Outdoors Autonomous Drone Flight with Visual-Inertial SLAM and Dense Submaps Built without LiDARDrones flying outdoors need light sensors to stay small, but they also need to navigate large areas safely when they loop back and the map suddenly shifts.
IROSCVD-SfM: A Cross-View Deep Front-end Structure-from-Motion System for Sparse Localization in Multi-Altitude ScenesFiguring out where a camera was from just a few photos taken at very different heights — some on the ground, some from a drone — is hard because the same scene looks completely different from each altitude.
IROSSix-DoF Hand-Based Teleoperation for Omnidirectional Aerial RobotsFlying robots that can move and tilt in any direction are hard to control precisely for tasks like picking up objects because standard controllers do not use the full range of hand motion a person can make.
IROSA Two-Stage Lightweight Framework for Efficient Land-Air Bimodal Robot Autonomous NavigationA robot that can both drive on the ground and fly needs a path planner that is small enough to run on its own computer and can handle switching between the two modes.
IROSWireless Collaborative Inference Acceleration Based on Distillation for Weed Detection and Instance SegmentationA weeding robot does not have enough computing power to identify weeds precisely on its own, but sending the whole image to a server over a wireless link is too slow when the connection changes.
IROSGeoSafe: A Unified Unconstrained Multi-DOF Optimization Framework for Multi-UAV Cooperative Hoisting and Obstacle AvoidanceFlying multiple drones carrying a shared load through a narrow gap is hard because the team must rotate its formation to fit, and existing planners cannot handle that rotation.
IROSReducing Scene Graph Generation Parameters Towards UAV Understanding of Structured EnvironmentsAI models that map out which objects are near each other in a drone's camera view are too large to run on the limited computing power a drone carries.
IROSReal-Time Occupancy Grid Mapping Using RMM on Large-scale and Unstructured EnvironmentsBuilding a live map of a large area with a drone is hard because storing and updating the map takes too much memory and computing power, and sensor noise leaves blank holes in the map.
IROSEDSOD: An Encoder-Decoder, Diffusion-model, and Swin-Transformer-based Small Object DetectorDetecting small objects in drone photos is hard because important details get lost when the image is shrunk down through standard detection networks.
IROSSeamless Transition Control in Spring-Legged Quadrotors: A Hybrid Dynamics Perspective with Guaranteed FeasibilityRobots that both fly and walk on spring legs can only handle one type of landing stance, making it impossible to plan smooth paths across all the ways the robot could move.
IROSEAROL: Environmental Augmented Perception-Aware Planning and Robust Odometry via Downward-Mounted Tilted LiDARDrones flying inside open-top spaces like collapsed buildings lose track of where they are and can't see obstacles ahead of them because their laser sensor points straight down.
IROSEANS: Reducing Energy Consumption for UAV with an Environmental Adaptive Navigation StrategyDrones following a fixed navigation strategy burn more energy than necessary because conditions change — open space, dense obstacles, wind — and the strategy is not adjusted to match.
IROSMulti-Robot Ergodic Trajectory Optimization with Relaxed Periodic ConnectivityWhen planning paths for a team of searching robots, methods that produce thorough coverage often produce paths where robots lose radio contact with each other.
IROSMultitask Reinforcement Learning for Quadcopter Attitude Stabilization and Tracking using Graph PolicyTeaching a single drone controller to both follow smooth angle commands and recover from wild tumbles is hard because the two tasks require very different types of training situations.
IROSTRACER: Thrust Auto-calibration and Ground Effect Estimation Using Onboard Force Sensitive Resistor Array for MultirotorsCalibrating how hard each rotor pushes and how the ground affects that push normally requires a lab bench and expensive test rigs, making in-field recalibration impractical.
IROSA Novel Large-Scale Collaborative Mapping Framework with Heterogeneous Point Clouds for Aerial-Ground RobotsAerial and ground robots scan the same area from very different angles, so their point cloud maps overlap only partially and it is hard to align them into one consistent map.
IROSRobust and Efficient Embedded Convex Optimization through First-Order Adaptive CachingTiny microcontrollers running real-time motion control have to redo expensive math from scratch every time a tuning parameter changes, which is too slow.
IROSQuadrotor Morpho-Transition: Learning vs Model-Based Control StrategiesA drone that physically changes shape mid-air to land on the ground is very hard to control because the physics during the transition are complex and existing model-based controllers do not transfer well from simulation to the real drone.
IROSTK-Planes: Tiered K-Planes with High Dimensional Feature Vectors for Dynamic UAV-based ScenesExisting 3D scene reconstruction methods lose quality on drone footage that shows small moving objects like people from high altitude.
IROSSwarm Active Audition with Robots and Drones: Real-World Performance ValidationA single drone listening for survivors in a large disaster area cannot hear well enough or reach all the spots that matter, especially when rubble blocks line-of-sight.
IROSVINS-MLD2: Monocular Visual-Inertial SLAM With Multi-level Detector and DescriptorCamera-and-gyroscope navigation systems either use hand-crafted features that break down in hard conditions, or deep-learned features that are too slow to run in real time.
IROSAeroBuoy: A Drone Deployable, 3D Printed, Autonomous Robotic Buoy for Environmental Inspection in Remote and Hazardous River SystemsRivers in remote or dangerous areas are hard to monitor because boats cannot get there and manual sampling is unsafe.
IROSMultimodal Obstacle Detection and Adaptive Neural Control for Autonomous DronesDrones can't navigate safely in the dark or complicated areas because their sensing and control fall apart in bad conditions.
IROSLearning Robust Agile Flight Control with Stability GuaranteesFast-flying drones need tight control that doesn't break when motors hit their limits or wind pushes them, and has to work right away without tuning.
IROSTransformer-Based Motion Model for Robust Target Tracking under Intermittent and Noisy MeasurementsTracking something when you only get glimpses through gaps and the readings are noisy makes standard tracking fail.
IROSIntegrating Opinion Dynamics into Safety Control for Decentralized Airplane Encounter Resolution ↗Airplane collision-avoidance systems that work without a control center can stop planes from crashing but sometimes leave them stuck in deadlock instead of finding a way forward.
IROSDecentralized Declustering of Multiple Underactuated Autonomous Surface Vehicles: Managing Robot Swarms in the FieldWhen boats are launched from one spot, they get in each other's way because they can't steer sharply and the water pushes them around.
IROSFully Autonomous Dual Arm Aerial Delivery Robot for Intralogistics: the euROBIN Nancy Competition Flight DatasetA delivery drone needs to see where it is, grab items with two arms, and listen to voice orders all at once without human help.
IROSVisLanding: Monocular 3D Perception for UAV Safe Landing via Depth-Normal SynergyDrones landing in unknown places need to find a safe flat landing zone using only a camera, without extra depth sensors.
IROSGO-Flock: Goal-Oriented Flocking in 3D Unknown Environments with Depth MapsTraditional force-field methods for flying drones get stuck or loop forever in obstacle-filled spaces.
IROSRainforestDepth: Monocular Depth Estimation Targeting Rainforest EnvironmentsDepth maps that work in cities and offices fail in dense forests because flying robots have never been trained to see through all that vegetation.
IROSA Bioinspired Framework for Person Detection and Tracking using Events and Frames on Flapping-Wing Aerial RobotsFlying robots that flap their wings shake so much that cameras get blurry pictures and can't spot people accurately.
IROSDynamics-Invariant Quadrotor Control using Scale-Aware Deep Reinforcement LearningA flying robot controller that works for one size or weight often fails when the robot is twice as heavy or twice as light, or when wind pushes it around.
IROSEnhancing UAV Energy Efficiency and Versatility through Trimodal Ground, Hovering, and Fixed-Wing Locomotion ModesDrones built only to fly waste a lot of power on missions that mix flying and ground travel across rough terrain.
IROSEagle-Scale Flapping-Wing Robot with Aggressive Roll Maneuverability: Bio-Inspired Actuation, Fluid-Structure Interaction Simulation and Flight ExperimentBig flying robots with flapping wings can't roll and turn as sharply as birds do, because the wing and shoulder design isn't right.
IROSDynamic Quadrupedal Legged and Aerial Locomotion via Structure RepurposingA robot that walks and flies needs conflicting leg designs—stiff for running, flexible for thrust.
IROSA Dual Tiltrotor UAV with Foldable Wings for Passive Perching and Belly/Back TakeoffDrones need extra parts to land on branches and can't take off from different orientations, making them heavier and more complex.
IROSView-aware Decomposition and Unification for Fast Ground-to-Aerial Person SearchWhen searching for a person using both a drone camera and ground camera, the huge viewpoint difference breaks person recognition systems trained on single views.
IROSAerobatic Maneuver Planning for Tilt-rotor UAVs Based on Multi-Modal Consistent Dynamic ModelDrones that switch from helicopter mode to airplane mode can't do tricks because there's no math model that covers all three flight modes smoothly.
IROSUAV-MaLO: Mamba-Augmented YOLO Hybrid Architecture for UAV Micro-Object Detection in Autonomous RoboticsMicro-object detection from UAVs faces extreme scale variation, low resolution, and dense occlusion under real-time computation constraints.
IROSRSSS: Robust Structural Semantic Segmentation for Autonomous Drone Delivery to DoorDrone delivery can't find doors reliably when lighting or weather changes because the recognition system was only trained on one condition.
IROSA Safety-Adjusted Policy Optimization Algorithm and Application for Obstacle Avoidance in the QuadcopterTeaching a drone to dodge obstacles is tricky because you want it to do the task well AND stay safe, but those two goals fight each other.
IROSTHE-SEAN: A Heart Rate Variation-Inspired Temporally High-Order Event-Based Visual Odometry with Self-Supervised Spiking Event Accumulation NetworksEvent cameras fire data very fast, and most systems waste effort trying to figure out where they are at every moment, even when nothing is changing.
IROSBridging the Reality Gap: Communication-Aware Task Allocation with Multi-Objective Asynchronous Policy LearningSplitting jobs between flying robots wastes a lot of radio time talking to each other, but most learning systems assume perfect communication and don't work in real life.
IROSDistributed Oscillatory Guidance for Formation Flight of Fixed-Wing DronesFlying drones in formation is hard because a plane's speed is locked to a narrow range, so you can't speed up or slow down much to adjust spacing between drones.
IROSEfficient and Precise Drone Rephotography for Video SequencesMost drone cameras fix their shot to match one still photo, which is slow and doesn't handle videos where the camera keeps moving.
IROSDesign and Implement of Large-scale Tail-sitter VTOL UAVMaking a tail-sitting aircraft that hovers and flies forward is risky when it gets bigger because the structure can fail and it's hard to keep the plane stable in all flight modes.
IROSA Mole-inspired Incisor-Burrowing Robotic Platform for Planetary ExplorationExploring underground on distant planets means the robot must be tiny and use very little power.
IROSDistributed Autonomous Safe Flight Planning for Multiple UAVs in Unknown EnvironmentsFlying robots exploring unknown areas need to avoid each other and move in ways their hardware can actually do, but each robot can only talk to nearby neighbors.
IROSTVFET-VD:Time-Varying Formation Encircling and Tracking Control Based on Visual DetectionA team of flying robots must spot a moving vehicle on the ground, figure out where it is, and circle around it in formation while it moves.
IROSAutonomous UAV Control for Maritime Applications using Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Image OptimisationDrones inspecting boats need to position themselves and angle their cameras to get the best pictures, but there's no rule for the right viewpoint.
IROSRobust Wrench-Feasible Control for Multiple UAVs Aerial Transportation System with Adaptive Cable ConfigurationWhen drones carry something on cables, they need the cables angled just right to stay within their power and angle limits, but wind and other forces keep changing the balance.
IROSMulti-target Association and Localization with Distributed Drone Following: A Factor Graph ApproachWhen multiple drones follow targets from different angles, they have to figure out which drone sees which target and where the target really is, all at the same time.
IROSPathfinder for Low-altitude Aircraft with Binary Neural NetworkRoad maps from online sources are incomplete because many paths are not labeled, and low-flying cameras must spot roads fast to fill in the gaps.
IROSLIM: A Low-Complexity Local Feature Image Matching Network for Real-Time Embedded ApplicationsImage matching systems work well but run too slow on phones and drones where there's not much computing power.
IROSAn Online Motion Planning Framework for Navigating Torpedo-shaped Autonomous Underwater Vehicles in Unknown Underwater EnvironmentsTorpedo-shaped underwater drones can't steer sideways much and need to plan paths in real-time through unknown murky water without maps.

IROSOnline Anti-Swing Trajectory Refinement for Variable-Length Cable-Suspended Aerial Transportation RobotFlying drones carrying stuff on cables swing wildly when following normal paths because of the cable's physics.
IROSDesign and Control of SeparaTrek: A Hybrid Aerial-Ground Robot with Separable and Combinative Locomotion PartsFlying robots that run on ground have their air and ground parts glued together, so they cannot switch modes or work separately.
IROSFASTEX: Fast UAV Exploration in Large-Scale Environments Using Dynamically Expanding Grids and Coverage PathsFlying drones exploring large areas are slow because fixed grid maps do not shrink when areas are fully explored, causing wasted computation and the drone re-checking old places.
IROSMapless Collision-Free Flight via MPC using Dual KD-Trees in Cluttered EnvironmentsFlying drones hit things when the map is built after the route is planned, and this causes slow flight and wrong turns.
IROSJumping Mechanism Assists Takeoff for Large-Sized Flapping-Wing RobotsLarge flying robots with flapping wings cannot take off on their own because the flapping motion alone is not strong enough to lift the robot off the ground.
IROSUVS: A Novel Underwater Vehicle with Integrated VCMS-Thrusters Hybrid Architecture for Enhanced Attitude RegulationUnderwater robots need to change their orientation cheaply, but thrusters alone use too much energy and may not give the full range of tilting angles needed.
IROSFIELD: Fast Information-driven Autonomous Exploration using Larger Perception DistanceDrones exploring unknown spaces pick bad viewpoints and miss parts of the map because they only look close.
IROSParameterized Motion Planning for Aerial Manipulators in Contact with Unstructured SurfacesPlanning movement for a flying robot arm that stays touching a bumpy surface is too slow in normal space but loose in compressed space.
IROSSTORM: Spatial-Temporal Iterative Optimization for Reliable Multicopter Trajectory GenerationIt's hard to plan safe drone paths that follow all the rules and compute fast at the same time.
IROSReal-Time Optimization-Based Quadrotor Trajectory Generation with Kinodynamic Constraints in Unknown EnvironmentsFast-moving drones need to avoid surprise obstacles but also need to turn smooth and can't move faster than their physics allows, and you need all this in real-time.
IROSAutomatic Generation of Aerobatic Flight in Complex Environments via Diffusion ModelsDrones can't do flips and complex maneuvers on their own through spaces with obstacles because there's no automatic way to plan those movements.
IROSOnline Motion Planning for Quadrotor Multi-Point Navigation Using Efficient Imitation Learning-Based StrategyComputing the quickest path through multiple spots for a flying drone takes too long to do in real time.

The two conferences compared

Two Big Robotics Meetings, One Field: ICRA 2025 vs. IROS 2025

*A plain-words look at what the two largest robotics meetings of 2025 share, and where they pull apart. ICRA had 1,604 papers; IROS had 1,985. Together, about 3,589.*

What they share

Read side by side, the two meetings tell the same story. Both are, above all, about seeing. Work on making sense of camera and sensor data (perception) is the single biggest pile at each — 644 papers at ICRA, 817 at IROS — and both push the same two goals: make seeing accurate and make it cheap enough to run on the robot's own small computer. Both lean on the same newer trick for storing the 3D world as many tiny colored blobs of light (Gaussian Splatting), and both carry a heavy load of self-driving-car work (247 papers at ICRA, 277 at IROS).

Both are also deep into the new AI brains. Chatbot-style AI that turns a spoken goal into robot steps (large language models), and models retrained to output robot movements instead of words (vision-language-action models), show up in force at both — foundation-model work covers 251 papers at ICRA and 307 at IROS. Both share the same caution about it: do not trust the AI's plan directly, make it write a checkable plan and test each step.

And both fight the same four background troubles. Everything must run fast on a small computer. Everything must learn from few examples, because collecting real robot data is slow and costly. Nothing may hurt people. And methods should carry over to new robots and jobs. These are not side notes; they are the reason most papers exist. Teaching robots by showing them examples (imitation learning: 168 papers at ICRA, 187 at IROS) and closing the gap between a computer copy and the real machine (sim-to-real: 227 at ICRA, 236 at IROS) are large at both meetings for exactly this reason.

Where they differ in emphasis

The tag sizes show a clear tilt. IROS leans toward the body and the physical world; ICRA leans toward the AI brain and toward naming the risks.

Soft, bendable robots. This is the sharpest single gap. IROS has 223 papers on soft robotics; ICRA has 131. IROS is full of robots that grow from their tip to snake through the spine, steerable drills that follow curved bone, and stiffness-changing arms. ICRA has this streak too, but at IROS it is a headline.

Medicine and surgery. Almost as sharp: 219 papers at IROS against 121 at ICRA — nearly double. IROS carries surgical scrub-nurse robots, soft-tissue cutting-and-stitching simulators, and ultrasound spine scanning. Medicine is where IROS's soft-robot and body-first character shows most.

Flying robots. IROS has 185 aerial papers to ICRA's 134. IROS is thick with drone swarms holding formation, drones flying through clutter, and drones that perch on tree branches. Its most-cited paper of either meeting, by a wide margin, is a program for spotting small objects in pictures taken from drones.

Turning AI plans into working systems, safely. Both weigh planning heavily, but the flavor differs. IROS pushes language-driven robots into concrete jobs faster — an office assistant, a surgical tool handler, a spoken-direction drone — and its top planning paper is specifically about how these AI planners chase finishing the job and skip safety. ICRA, by contrast, holds the sharpest safety warning of either meeting: a paper showing a language-model robot can be tricked into harmful acts. So IROS builds safety into the planner; ICRA more often exposes the danger.

Where the citation weight sits. ICRA's headline papers are the AI-brain and touch results — end-to-end self-driving from a stripped-down scene (its most-cited paper), two-handed work by feel, sharpening a model's 3D sense. IROS's headline papers are more about the sensing pipeline and the hardware — small-object spotting from drones, shrinking 3D blob-maps to run live, mapping without a heavy graphics chip, and a real-time rig to puppet two dexterous hands. Put simply, ICRA's most-noticed work is about the decision-making mind; IROS's is about the eyes, the hands, and running cheap.

Making your own data. Both want cheaper training examples, but IROS adds a strong "just make it in the computer" streak — large fake-data generators for seeing, and pipelines that scan real objects into computer copies by picking them up. ICRA leans a little more toward better ways to record real people doing tasks.

None of these are disagreements. They are differences of weight. The same methods, the same worries, the same loop — sense, decide, move — run through both.

Five plain takeaways about robotics in 2025

  • Seeing is still the biggest job, and the fight is cost. The most common complaint at both meetings is "right but too slow or too costly to run live on the robot's own computer." A lot of 2025's best work is about making a good-but-heavy method light enough to actually use.
  • Chatbot-style AI is now a standard part, but nobody trusts it alone. Across both meetings, language models turn spoken goals into robot steps — and across both, the plan is forced into a checkable form and tested before the robot acts. The pattern is "AI proposes, a strict checker disposes."
  • The real bottleneck is data, and the field is attacking it from every side. Better ways to record people, automatic ways to multiply a few examples, and — especially at IROS — making large batches of fake data inside a computer. Cheap examples matter more than clever methods right now.
  • The two meetings split the field between mind and body. ICRA carries more of the newest AI-brain and decision work and the loudest safety alarms; IROS carries more of the soft machines, medicine, flying, energy, and hardware, and folds safety into the planner. Read both to see the whole field.
  • Safety is named far more than it is solved. As learned and language-driven parts move into the control loop, being able to *promise* a robot won't fail is falling behind how fast these systems are deployed. One meeting shows the danger; the other builds guardrails into the planner — but at neither is the gap closed.
